12304320.label: Project Objectives
12304320.value: To design and synthesize small molcular Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts for NADH regeneration NADH is a critical cofactor involved in a broad range of enzymatic reduction reactions in pharmaceutical industries, where a wide range of chiral intermediates and rely heavily on bioreduction with enantioselectivity using oxidoreductases as biocatalysts and NADH as a reducing agent. Effective procedures to regenerate NADH are essential given the high cost of this component. This stimulates us to developed new methods for NADH regeneration at an industrially acceptable level in the future with interdisciplinary efforts from chemists, engineers, biologists, and industrial partners. The photocatalytic regeneration of NADH, mimicking natural photosynthesis, is very promising based on its sustainable, economical and efficient characteristics. Herein, we are going to construct small molecular Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts for property and mechanism study, in which porphyrin acts as photosensitizer to produce electrons, (N^N)Rh(III) complex as catalyst center to facilitate NADH regeneration. To design and synthesize COF-based Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts for NADH regeneration Metal-organic-frameworks (MOF) and covalent-organic-frameworks (COFs) have been increasingly investigated in artificial photosynthesis, since MOFs and COFs might provide a highly tunable platform to combine photosensitizer and transition-metal catalysts to drive multicomponent organic photoreactions. Typically, the periodic arrangements in COFs definitely facilitate an efficient electron transfer to accelerate the catalytic cycle. Moreover, COFs photocatalysts can be readily recycled and reused. Therefore, we proposed to prepare COF-based Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts from building blocks of porphyrin as photosensitizer and rhodium complex as catalytic center, and apply them for visible light driven NADH regeneration. To systematically investigate photocatalytic NADH regeneration property and sort out the state-of-the-art photocatalyst for commercialization To investigate the applicability of the synthesized photocatalysts, a photolysis experiment was performed. TEOA was used as a sacriﬁcial donor in a 0.1 M aqueous buﬀered sodium phosphate solution to enhance the stability of both the NAD+ and the NADH present in the sample, which was necessary due to the relatively long irradiation time. A distinct absorbance band with a maximum at 340 nm will be formed upon the light irradiation at λ ≥ 390 nm, which indicates the successful photocatalytic formation of NADH. Additionally, the reduction product NADH will be further conﬁrmed by measuring the ﬂuorescence spectrum upon excitation at 340 nm. The NADH yield, initial reaction rate, turnover number (TON) and turnover frequency (TOF) will be evaluated accordingly. To theoretically study structure-property relationship for Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts We will collaborate with Dr. Lau at CityU HK to perform theoretical calculations to study the photophysical and electrochemical properties of rhodium-based porphyrin complexes and to establish the structure-property relationships of the complexes. Electron transfer efficiency of the rhodium-based porphyrin complexes will be investigated by correlating the reduction potentials with the electronic and steric parameters of the complexes when various ligands and spacer are used. The computational results will provide fundamental insight and facilitate us to design and synthesize state-of-the-art Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) system for photocatalytic applications. To apply TSSSU to scale up and commercialize the state-of-the-art photocatalyst We will keep in close communication with the Knowledge Transfer Office at HKBU, and apply for financial support, e.g via the Technology Start-up Support Scheme for Universities (TSSSU) that permits us to scale up and commercialize the state-of-the-art photocatalyst that we will develop in this project. The research will involve the training and inspiration of the undergraduate and research postgraduate students.

12304320.label: Realisation of objectives
12304320.value: The research project has successfully realized all its objectives outlined in the original application. The following achievements highlight the comprehensive fulfillment of the project goals: 1. A series of small molecular Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts have been successfully designed and synthesized, demonstrating promising capabilities for photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH regeneration. a) To address (ACQ) of photoluminescence in porphyrins, we explore self-assembled Pt(II)-tetrakis(pentafluorophenyl)porphyrin (SA-PtPFTPP) and Pt(II)-tetraphenylporphyrin (SA-PtTPP) as candidates. We find that SA-PtPFTPP via F⋯F interaction effectively restricts aggregation caused quenching (ACQ) in the solid state, whereas SA-PtTPP shows noticeable ACQ due to intermolecular π–π (C⋯C/C⋯H) interactions. Compared with SA-PtTPP, SA-PtPFTPP demonstrates a longer τPL value and higher photoluminescence quantum yield. Moreover, SA-PtPFTPP exhibits more efficient charge separation and better dispersibility in water with a low water contact angle. The favorable photophysical properties of SA-PtPFTPP enable a direct electron transfer from the photoexcited porphyrin moiety to the proton in cocatalyst-free PHE. As a result, SA-PtPFTPP shows a much higher PHE rate (ηH2) of 400.0 μmol g−1 h−1 compared to SA-PtTPP (5.0 μmol g−1 h−1) under heterogeneous conditions. Importantly, SA-PtPFTPP also demonstrates high photostability under prolonged irradiation, as evidenced by the consistent ηH2 production in each photocycle and unchanged morphology before and after light irradiation. This research provides a valuable insight into the design of self-assembled porphyrins with hindered ACQ, offering potential applications in cocatalyst-free PHE. This work was published in J. Mater. Chem. A, 2024,12, 2924-2931. b) Tetraphenylethylene (TPE)-conjugated porphyrin TPE-ZnPF is synthesized in high yield and characterized by single-crystal X-ray diffraction. The propeller-shaped TPE groups not only enable exceptional aggregation-induced emission (AIE) in the solid state but also abolish the strong π-π stacking of porphyrin moieties and thus prohibit aggregation-caused quenching (ACQ). TPE-ZnPF aggregates feature long-lived photoexcited states, which subsequently suppress non-radiative decay channels and enhance emission intensity. Moreover, its aggregates show more efficient light-harvesting ability due to the Förster resonance energy transfer from the TPE energy donor to the porphyrin core energy acceptor, well-defined nanosphere morphology, and more efficient photoinduced charge separation than the porphyrin Ph-ZnPF, which possesses ACQ and agglomerated morphology. As a result, an excellent photocatalytic hydrogen evolution rate (ηH2) of 56.20 mmol g‒1 h‒1 is recorded for TPE-ZnPF aggregates, which is 94-fold higher than that of the aggregates of Ph-ZnPF (0.60 mmol g‒1 h‒1) without the TPE groups. See Aggregate 2023, 4 (5), e364. c) A T-Ir complex was conjugated to a porphyrin ring via a phenylene linkage to afford a new ZnP-T-Ir photosensitizer which exhibits aggregation-induced emission (AIE) for the T-Ir unit, inhibition of aggregation caused by quenching (ACQ) of the porphyrin unit and an efficient Förster resonance energy transfer (FRET) from the T-Ir energy donor to the porphyrin energy acceptor. The ZnP-T-Ir system exhibits highly efficient cocatalyst-free photocatalytic hydrogen evolution (PHE) with a rate (ηH2) of 1.42 mmol g−1 h−1, which is 71-fold higher than that of the related control porphyrin, ZnP-T (0.02 mmol g−1 h−1) that does not contain the Ir-complex. The high ηH2 of ZnP-T-Ir in cocatalyst-free PHE can be ascribed to the conjugation of the T-Ir moiety along with the synergistic effect of AIE, ACQ inhibition, and FRET, which further led to efficient UV-visible light-harvesting, a longer photoexcited electron lifetime, and thereby a more efficient electron transfer rate from the photoexcited porphyrin to the proton used for water reduction. See Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2022, 10 (8), 4440-4445. 2. Some COF-based Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts have been developed, leveraging the unique properties of metal-organic-frameworks and covalent-organic-frameworks to drive visible light-driven photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH regeneration efficiently. a) Covalent triazine frameworks (CTFs) with two-dimensional conjugated structures and a high nitrogen content have potential for photocatalytic hydrogen evolution (PHE). Herein, we show a strategy to boost the photocatalytic performance of a CTF containing bipyridine (bpy) units (PhBp-CTF). Through a postcomplexation reaction of the PhBp-CTF with Ir2(ppy)4(μ-Cl)2, the Ir complexes of [Ir(bpy)(ppy)2]3+ are successfully embedded inside to form PhBp-CTF-Ir. The accurate content and valence state of Ir have been confirmed by advanced spectroscopies. PhBp-CTF-Ir shows a PHE rate of 4805 μmol g–1 h–1, while its precursor without Ir complexes has a rate of 3175 μmol g–1 h–1. The enhanced photocatalytic performance is attributed to the Ir complexes inside PhBp-CTF-Ir, which act as not only an effective photosensitizer but also a proton reduction catalyst. 3. The photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH regeneration property of the synthesized photocatalysts has been systematically investigated, leading to the identification of state-of-the-art photocatalysts suitable for commercialization. a) Developing visible-to-near-infrared light-harvesting porphyrin photosensitizers is very important for efficient photocatalytic hydrogen evolution (PHE) since most of the tetra-meso-substituted porphyrins absorb up to the visible region only. Herein, two new A-π-D-π-A porphyrins ZnP-CPDT and ZnP-BT have been prepared which are capable of absorbing in the region of 370 to 800 nm in solution and 300 to 1100 nm in the solid state indicating their visible-to-near-infrared light-harvesting ability. As a consequence, the ZnP-CPDT porphyrin produced a PHE rate (ηH2) of 1.80 mmol g−1 h−1 which is 4.5-fold higher than that of the ZnP-BT porphyrin (0.40 mmol g−1 h−1). Under the same photocatalytic conditions, the typical zinc(II)-tetraphenylporphyrin (ZnTPP) which absorbs visible light, delivered a very low ηH2 of 0.05 mmol g−1 h−1. This work helps to develop efficient A-π-D-π-A-based porphyrins for PHE by suitable molecular design. For details, see Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2023, 11 (3), 1473-1481. b) A new porphyrin photosensitizer ZnDC(p-NI)PP, containing two naphthalimide (NI) donor chromophores and 4-carboxyphenyl substituents is developed for PHE. Using chloropyridinecobaloxime (CoPyCl) as a cocatalyst in phosphate buffer/THF solution at pH 7.4, the homogeneous PS of ZnDC(p-NI)PP exhibits a very high hydrogen evolution rate (ηH2) of 35.70 mmol g−1 h−1, turnover number (TON) of 5958 and apparent quantum efficiency (AQE) of 10.01%. The noticeable performance of ZnDC(p-NI)PP in PHE is attributed to the intramolecular energy transfer from the NI donor chromophore to the porphyrin acceptor that would promote the long-lived photoexcitation states. This work was published in Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2021, 9 (36), 20645-20652. 4. Collaborative efforts with Prof. Zhao at Dalian University of Technology have yielded valuable insights into the structure-property relationships of rhodium-based porphyrin complexes, enhancing the understanding of electron transfer efficiency and facilitating the design of advanced photocatalytic systems. 5. Close collaboration with the Knowledge Transfer Office is ongoing to scale up and commercializing the state-of-the-art photocatalyst developed in the project. Overall, the successful realization of all project objectives underscores the interdisciplinary efforts in advancing the field of photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH regeneration. The project outcomes not only contribute to sustainable and efficient methodologies for photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH regeneration but also provide a solid foundation for future research, innovation, and commercialization of the developed photocatalysts.

Typically, the periodic arrangements in COFs definitely facilitate an efficient electron transfer to accelerate the catalytic cycle. Moreover, COFs photocatalysts can be readily recycled and reused. Therefore, we proposed to prepare COF-based Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts from building blocks of porphyrin as photosensitizer and rhodium complex as catalytic center, and apply them for visible light driven NADH regeneration.

Then we systematically investigated photocatalytic NADH regeneration property and sort out the state-of-the-art photocatalyst for commercialization. To investigate the applicability of the synthesized photocatalysts, a photolysis experiment was performed. TEOA was used as a sacriﬁcial donor in a 0.1 M aqueous buﬀered sodium phosphate solution to enhance the stability of both the NAD+ and the NADH present in the sample, which was necessary due to the relatively long irradiation time. A distinct absorbance band with a maximum at 340 nm will be formed upon the light irradiation at λ ≥ 390 nm, which indicates the successful photocatalytic formation of NADH. Additionally, the reduction product NADH will be further conﬁrmed by measuring the ﬂuorescence spectrum upon excitation at 340 nm. The NADH yield, initial reaction rate, turnover number (TON) and turnover frequency (TOF) will be evaluated accordingly.

At the same time, we theoretically studied structure-property relationship for Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) photocatalysts. We will collaborate with Dr. Lau at CityU HK to perform theoretical calculations to study the photophysical and electrochemical properties of rhodium-based porphyrin complexes and to establish the structure-property relationships of the complexes. Electron transfer efficiency of the rhodium-based porphyrin complexes will be investigated by correlating the reduction potentials with the electronic and steric parameters of the complexes when various ligands and spacer are used. The computational results will provide fundamental insight and facilitate us to design and synthesize state-of-the-art Porphyrin-(N^N)Rh(III) system for photocatalytic applications.

Last, we try to apply TSSSU to scale up and commercialize the state-of-the-art photocatalyst. We will keep in close communication with the Knowledge Transfer Office at HKBU, and apply for financial support, e.g via the Technology Start-up Support Scheme for Universities (TSSSU) that permits us to scale up and commercialize the state-of-the-art photocatalyst that we will develop in this project. The research will involve the training and inspiration of the undergraduate and research postgraduate students.

12304320.label: Major findings and research outcome
12304320.value: Some significant advancements have been achieved in the field of photocatalytic hydrogen evolution (PHE) and NADH regeneration and the development of efficient photosensitizers and photocatalysts. 1. The study introduces a novel heteroleptic iridium(III) photosensitizer (Ir-1) for cocatalyst-free PHE, demonstrating a high hydrogen production rate attributed to its superior light-harvesting properties and efficient charge separation for hydrogen evolution. For details, see ACS Applied Energy Materials 2021, 4 (4), 3945-3951. 2. A new porphyrin photosensitizer (ZnDC(p-NI)PP) combined with CoPyCl cocatalyst achieves remarkable hydrogen evolution rates, turnover numbers, and apparent quantum efficiencies, showcasing superior performance compared to existing PSs and cobaloxime systems. The details can be found in Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2021, 9 (36), 20645-20652. 3. The development of p-type nickel-based MOF single crystals and nanobelts demonstrates efficient visible-light-driven water splitting without the need for a cocatalyst, showcasing enhanced water reduction activity and active surface areas compared to traditional MOFs. As for details, see Journal of the American Chemical Society 144 (6), 2747-2754. 4. The conjugation of a T-Ir complex to a porphyrin ring results in a highly efficient cocatalyst-free photocatalytic system for hydrogen evolution, leveraging aggregation-induced emission, Förster resonance energy transfer, and efficient light harvesting for enhanced performance. For details, see Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2022, 10 (8), 4440-4445. 5. The development of A-π-D-π-A porphyrins demonstrates visible-to-near-infrared light-harvesting abilities, efficient charge separation, and well-defined nanosphere morphologies, leading to significantly improved PHE rates compared to traditional porphyrins. For details, see Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2023, 11 (3), 1473-1481. 6. Self-assembled Pt(II)-tetrakis(pentafluorophenyl)porphyrin exhibits hindered aggregation-caused quenching, enabling efficient charge separation and enhanced PHE rates compared to traditional porphyrins under heterogeneous conditions. The results was published in Journal of Materials Chemistry A 2024, 12 (5), 2924-2931. Overall, the research outcomes encompass a wide range of novel materials and strategies for efficient PHE, highlighting the importance of light-harvesting properties, charge separation mechanisms, and morphological considerations in developing advanced photocatalytic systems. These findings contribute significantly to the advancement of sustainable energy production technologies and pave the way for future research in the field.

12304320.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12304320.value: The research outputs presented indicate significant potential for further development and advancement in the field of photocatalytic hydrogen evolution (PHE) and sustainable energy production. In the future, further research will focus on exploring new materials with enhanced light-harvesting properties and efficient charge separation mechanisms to improve PHE rates and quantum efficiencies. And we will continue the optimization of catalytic systems, such as porphyrin-based photosensitizers and cobaloxime cocatalysts, aiming to develop more efficient and stable photocatalytic systems for hydrogen evolution. At the same time, we are planning to transition successful lab-scale experiments to larger-scale applications through collaboration with industry partners, therefore facilitate the commercialization of advanced photocatalytic systems for real-world energy production.

12304320.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12304320.value: The research project developed a series of new type of photocatalysts using a combination of porphyrin and catalytic complex for photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH regeneration. This process mimics natural photosynthesis and can be used to efficiently produce chemicals and fuels using light energy. By structurally engineering these photocatalysts, the researchers successfully improved their efficiency in photocatalytic hydrogen production and NADH generation, which is essential for photocatalytic and many biological reactions. This innovative approach could lead to more sustainable and cost-effective methods for producing valuable compounds in chemical and pharmaceutical industries. The project combines expertise in chemistry, materials science, and biocatalysis to create advanced materials that can potentially revolutionize how we harness light energy for chemical synthesis.

12500020.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500020.value: As online harassment has become epidemic on social media with serious negative consequences to individuals and society, platform providers are facing public pressures to mitigate online harassment and maintain a healthy online environment for their users. Educators and government agencies also request platform providers to implement digital safety plans for preventing online harassment on their platforms. While we witness an increasing academic interest in online harassment prevention, prior literature has largely focused on training, community involvement and parental responsibilities. Online harassment on social media is a technology-mediated phenomenon, empirical evidence on the role of technology in preventing online harassment is largely lacking. Thus, it is timely and important for researchers and platform providers to investigate technology-based prevention strategies for online harassment on social media. Prior studies suggested that self-awareness is a powerful disinhibitor of aggressive behaviors. However, less is known about how social media features alter users’ self-awareness and promote aggressive behaviors on social media platforms. Further, there is no theory-driven research examining how technological features can be incorporated in platform design in order to prevent online harassment on social media. Thus, our project aims to design and assess technology-based prevention strategies for online harassment on social media. With the guidance of self-awareness theory and reflective system design principles, we will conduct three studies. In Study 1, we will identify social media features that affect users’ self-awareness on their online behaviors on social media platforms using a focus group study; in Study 2, we will examine how reflective system designs alter self-awareness using an online scenario-based study; and in Study 3, we will test the designs and effects of a mobile application incorporating the reflective system design for preventing online harassment on social media using a field experiment study. Our proposed project is a response to the call for more theory-based research on the emerging societal issues associated with technology use. This proposed project advances the literature by (1) incorporating self-awareness theory to online harassment research; (2) using reflective system design principles to guide our investigation of the role of technology in preventing online harassment; and (3) empirically testing the effectiveness of reflective system design principles in online harassment prevention. Finally, the lessons learnt from this project will offer courses of action and guidelines for implementing preventive measures to mitigate online harassment on social media. 隨著網絡騷擾於社交媒體上的流行及其對個人和社會造成的嚴重負面影響，平台供應商正面臨公眾壓力去減輕網絡騷擾並維護健康的線上環境。教育工作者和政府機構亦要求平台供應商實施網絡安全計劃去防止網絡騷擾。雖然有關網絡騷擾的預防的學術研究與日俱增，但是現有的文獻主要集中於探討個人訓練、社區參與和父母責任的影響。社交媒體上的網絡騷擾是一種由科技介導的現象，關於科技在防止網絡騷擾中的作用的研究仍然缺乏。因此，對於研究人員和平台供應商來說，研究以科技為本的預防網絡騷擾的策略是及時而且重要的。 先前的研究顯示，自我意識有效抑制攻擊性行為。但是，關於社交媒體功能如何改變用戶的自我意識並在社交媒體平台上誘發攻擊性行為的了解還很少。此外，還沒有以理論主導的研究來探討如何將相關的技術融入到平台設計中，以防止社交媒體上的網絡騷擾。因此，我們的項目旨在為社交媒體上的網絡騷擾去設計和評估以科技為本的預防策略。基於自我意識理論和反思性系統設計的原則，我們將進行三項研究。在研究一，我們將通過焦點小組去探討社交媒體的功能如何影響自我意識及其行為。在研究二，我們將使用情景模式的線上問卷來研究反思性系統設計如何改變自我意識。在研究三，我們將使用現場實驗來測試結合了反思性系統設計的移動應用程式在防止社交媒體上的網絡騷擾的效果。 我們提出的項目回應了有關科技使用所引致的新興社會問題的理論形研究的呼籲。本項目通過以下三方面推動了文獻的發展：將自我意識理論應用於網絡騷擾研究； 使用反思性系統設計原則來探討科技在防止網絡騷擾的影響； 及測試反思性系統設計原則在預防網絡騷擾的功用。最後，本項目將為減輕社交媒體上的網絡騷擾的預防措施提供可行的研究方針和指南。

12500020.label: Realisation of objectives
12500020.value: Objective 1: To explore how social media features affect users’ self-awareness of their online behaviors on social media platforms; Four papers have been prepared. The work-in-progress paper (in abstract form) was published at DIGIT2022 (Paper 1). An extended version (Paper 2) discussed the social media features (regarding accountability and attentional cues) and their impacts on public and private self-awareness and their aggressive responses to cyberbullying (online harassment on social media platforms). A full paper (currently under copyediting for the submission of JAIS – Paper 3) has been prepared. Using a multi-method research design consisting of a three-wave longitudinal survey and an experiment, we tested how public and private self-awareness, influenced by environmental cues (accountability cues and attentional cues) interact with social homogeneity to affect online harassment on social media. A recently accepted paper (ISR – Paper 4) with a focus on the organizational context has identified two specific technostressors, techno overload and techno invasion, and their impacts on employees’ engagement in cyberdeviance (including online harassment behavior) through the self-regulatory processes (including self-awareness). Objective 2: To empirically evaluate the reflective system design principles in altering users’ self-awareness; We selected Reddit as the research context because the structure of subreddits provides natural settings (reflective system design principles) for examining the effects of self-awareness on social homogeneity and cyberbullying. Reddit’s artefacts, such as the upvoting and downvoting mechanisms and the provision of anonymous or pseudonymous accounts, permit the study of the interplay between self-awareness, social homogeneity, and harassment on social media platforms (see Paper 3). Objective 3: To test the effectiveness of a mobile application incorporating reflective design principles for preventing online harassment on social media platforms; and Users mostly access and use Reddit and subreddit through a mobile application. The Reddit’s artefacts (mentioned in Objective 2) can also explain how the environment promotes self-awareness and prevent online harassment on social media platforms. Objective 4: To identify courses of action and guidelines for online harassment prevention on social media. For social media platform owners, they can implement AI-driven moderation tools to detect and flag potentially harmful content and provide immediate feedback to users. They can also consider implementing reputation management systems that reward positive contributions through mechanisms like likes, badges, and upvotes, further encouraging users to adhere to community standards. These approaches can deter uncivil behaviors by making users more aware of the potential consequences of their actions and the social norms they are expected to follow. (see Paper 3). For Governments, they can play a significant role in promoting inclusive social norms through public policy and educational programs. Public campaigns and digital literacy programs that emphasize respectful online behavior and the value of diverse perspectives can foster a more inclusive and respectful online environment. Public campaigns can raise awareness about the importance of respectful online communication. These campaigns can highlight the consequences of incivility and promote positive online interactions. By leveraging various media channels, governments can reach a wide audience and instill a culture of respect and inclusion. Digital literacy programs, on the other hand, can equip individuals with the skills needed to navigate the digital world responsibly. These programs can cover topics such as recognizing and combating misinformation, understanding privacy settings, and the impact of digital footprints. Additionally, policies that incentivize platforms to adopt best practices in user moderation and accountability can ensure that the efforts to curb incivility are systemic and sustainable (see Paper 3). For organizations, managers can create a relaxing work environment or design tools to reduce technostressors. Managers can also offer assistance programs to their employees to teach them how to control or manage their emotional and cognitive resources and to better cope with techno overload and techno invasion (see Paper 4).

12500020.label: Major findings and research outcome
12500020.value: As online harassment has become epidemic on social media with serious negative consequences to individuals and society, platform providers are facing public pressures to mitigate online harassment and maintain a healthy online environment for their users. Educators and government agencies also request platform providers to implement digital safety plans for preventing online harassment on their platforms. Therefore, this project aims to explore how social media features affect users’ self-awareness of their online behaviors on social media platforms. Four papers have been prepared. The work-in-progress paper (in abstract form) was published at DIGIT2022 (Paper 1). An extended version (Paper 2) discussed the social media features (regarding accountability and attentional cues) and their impacts on public and private self-awareness and their aggressive responses to cyberbullying (online harassment on social media platforms). These two papers described how the accountability (i.e., identifiability and diffused responsibility) and attentional (i.e., group cohesiveness and arousal) cues influence diminished public and private self-awareness, and thus discourage users’ aggressive responses towards cyberbullying. A full paper (currently under copyediting for the submission of JAIS – Paper 3) has been prepared. Using a multi-method research design consisting of a three-wave longitudinal survey and an experiment, we tested how public and private self-awareness, influenced by environmental cues (accountability cues and attentional cues) interact with social homogeneity to affect online harassment on social media. This paper highlights how technology subtly influences the psychological processes underlying online interactions, offering a comprehensive understanding of digital behavior dynamics. A recently accepted paper (ISR – Paper 4) with a focus on the organizational context has identified two specific technostressors, techno overload and techno invasion, and their impacts on employees’ engagement in cyberdeviance (including online harassment behavior) through the self-regulatory processes (including self-awareness). By integrating the self-regulation perspective into the technostress literature, we show that exhaustion is a critical psychological resource-related mediator linking daily technostressors to daily cyberdeviance. In addition, we extend these studies by further showing that emotional and cognitive exhaustion play a critical role in corporate IS settings. Our theorization and empirical findings of cyberdeviance (including online harassment) have important implications for IS research.

12500020.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12500020.value: The main paper (Paper 3) presents an exploration of collective behaviors on Reddit's Politics subreddit, employing a three-wave longitudinal design and supplementing it with an experimental study based on census-representative samples. Despite these methodological strengths, we recognize several limitations that highlight avenues for future research. The use of Prolific for data collection, while beneficial for its diversity, may not accurately reflect the broader Reddit user base and may attract participants more inclined towards monetary incentives, which could affect the generalizability of our results. The focus on a politically charged subreddit also raises questions about the applicability of our findings across different online communities and platforms that may have varying norms and levels of anonymity. Moreover, our reliance on self-reported measures for self-awareness and network structure introduces potential biases, such as social desirability and self-perception inaccuracies. Given the complexity of self-awareness as a construct, this could impact the validity and reliability of our findings. Future research could enhance methodological rigor by integrating more objective metrics and diverse data sources. Lastly, while our study centers on self-awareness and homophily in shaping collective behavior, it does not account for other relevant theories like herding behavior or the concept of a contagious mindless crowd, which could significantly contribute to understanding collective incivility. Future studies should consider these theoretical frameworks to comprehensively decipher the multifaceted nature of online social dynamics.

12500020.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12500020.value: This study offers pivotal contributions to understanding the interplay of technological features and online deviant behavior (including online harassment on social media and cyberdeviance in the workplace context). This research sheds light on the underpinnings of online interactions that can lead to cyberbullying and aggressive discourse. The longitudinal design and the use of a census-representative experimental study underscore the nuanced ways in which self-awareness is influenced by, and influences, social media dynamics. The findings of this study are especially valuable for social media platform developers and policymakers who are tasked with creating safer and more respectful online communities. The insights gained point toward the importance of thoughtful platform design and informed regulation that can mitigate negative behaviors and encourage positive interaction. By laying the groundwork for future research, this study not only contributes to academic knowledge but also serves as a catalyst for practical interventions. It emphasizes the importance of understanding the social psychological aspects of online behavior, which is crucial for developing strategies to counteract cyberbullying and promote a healthier, more civil discourse in the ever-evolving digital landscape.

12500420.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500420.value: 如今中小企业数目已占世界企业总数的90%以上。中小企业因其对创造就业和经济增加值的贡献日益成为发达和发展中经济体的重要力量。然而中小企业在迅速发展的过程中，会面临着很多困难，其中最大的障碍是信息不对称带来的融资困难。更糟糕的是，许多企业主缺乏抵押物或者过往的信用记录，这也成为贷款难的核心矛盾。同时作为贷款的抵押品往往形式单一，通常以不可动资产的形式出现，例如房地产。 本项目旨在研究政府对房地产市场的干预会如何影响中小企业的融资渠道。该研究利用住房限购令在中国46个大中城市的实施和取消作为主要研究方法，并基于国内某大型银行的中小企业商业贷款申请组合的样本。本文采用倍差法(DID方法) 在多个维度对处理和对照城市组的中小企业作了考察比较，包括中小型企业的信贷可用性，相关的债务合同设计和事后贷款表现。该项目的研究结果将使我们进一步了解抵押品在信贷供应中的作用，同时也为决策者如何更好地改善中小企业融资环境提供有用的参考。

12500420.label: Realisation of objectives
12500420.value: 1. To offer evidence regarding the role of collateral in the credit supply and debt contracting to SMEs and, ultimately, real economic activity. The project has successfully achieved this objective by investigating how changes in a lender's ability to liquidate collateral affect the provision of credit to consumers. We used a unique dataset of personal loan applications secured with housing from a leading bank in China and exploited a housing policy that enhances liquidity in the secondary residential property market to capture the micro-level variation in asset liquidation value. We found that the reform leads to credit expansion, with a greater probability of loans being granted. This increased lending is not accompanied by a deterioration in credit allocation efficiency. The results of this study provide strong evidence on the crucial role that collateral plays in alleviating financial friction and improving credit access for individual borrowers, including SMEs. 2.To enhance our understanding of mechanisms through which economic policy can influence SMEs’ access to financing, providing normative implications for policymakers to design programs and regulations to promote financial access for SMEs The project has contributed to enhancing our understanding of the mechanisms through which economic policy can influence SMEs' access to financing. By focusing on the housing policy that exogenously removes purchase restrictions in the residential property market, we have shown how this policy improves debtors’ ability to dispose of housing collateral in case of default. We also identified two potential economic mechanisms - the Collateral Liquidity Channel and the Collateral Price Channel - through which the housing reform may influence bank credit decision. The results indicate that the Collateral Liquidity Channel is the most important mechanism through which the housing policy induces a greater credit supply, while the Collateral Price Channel explains a minor part of the overall effect. These findings provide valuable insights for policymakers to design programs and regulations that promote financial access for SMEs by easing collateral-related constraints. 3. To offer useful insights to decision-makers with regards to policy formulation and assessment. The project has provided useful insights for decision-makers in terms of policy formulation and assessment. The results support the idea that policies aimed at improving collateral liquidity can lead to credit expansion without compromising credit allocation efficiency. This evidence can be used by policymakers to make informed decisions when designing and assessing policies related to collateral and credit access for SMEs.

12500420.label: Major findings and research outcome
12500420.value: In this research project, we investigate the general implications of housing in mitigating constraints and providing liquidity for households and its effect on broader outcomes, including credit, borrowing, and entrepreneurship. In the published paper “Liberalizing Home-Based Business” (Management Science) listed in No. 1 Part C, we empirically analyze the effects of home-based entrepreneurship and property equity access on entrepreneurial activities. A reform in Singapore, the Home Office Scheme, which allowed business creation at one's residential property, resulted in significantly higher levels of business creation and higher survival rates for newly created firms. This effect was more pronounced for low-income female individuals and industries with high startup capital, implying that financial constraints and nonpecuniary benefits likely drive the effect. Entrepreneurs were also found to become serial entrepreneurs, opening larger businesses with similar survival rates for their second firms, suggesting the program effectively attracted more entry into self-employment without significantly lowering the average quality of the pool. In the published paper “Housing Property Rights, Collateral, and Entrepreneurship: Evidence from China” (Journal of Banking and Finance) listed in No. 3 Part C, we show that the housing collateral lending channel has a significant impact on entrepreneurial activities by allowing homeowners to access property equity and invest in new businesses. In China, complete access to collateral values is only legally granted to homeowners with full property rights (FPR). We find that local house price growth significantly increases the probability of starting a new business for FPR homeowners, with effects being robust when relying on exogenous shocks induced by house purchase restrictions. This is primarily driven by homeowners without household debt. Macro analysis supports a positive correlation between the concentration of FPR homeowners and employment and economic growth, indicating better access to external financing via the collateral channel. In the working paper "Collateral Shock and Credit Access: Evidence from Personal Loan Application Data" listed in No. 2 Part C, we investigate the role of collateral liquidity, focusing on a central housing policy in China that removed purchase restrictions in the residential property market. The study aims to provide insights into how changes in a lender's ability to liquidate collateral affect the provision of credit to consumers. The housing policy leads to credit expansion, with a greater probability of loans being granted. Importantly, this increased lending is not accompanied by a deterioration in credit allocation efficiency.

12500420.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12500420.value: This study emphasizes the significance of collateral liquidity in enhancing credit access for individual borrowers. Subsequent research could investigate the effects of comparable policies in various countries, particularly in developing economies with inadequate collateral laws. Additionally, future studies may assess the enduring impacts of such policies on credit markets, economic growth, and financial inclusion. The suggested course of action involves advocating for policies that alleviate collateral-related limitations and facilitate credit access for small borrowers, ultimately fostering economic growth and financial inclusion in developing economies.

12500420.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12500420.value: This project looks at how changes in a lender's ability to use collateral, like a house, affect their ability to lend money to people. By studying a housing policy in China that allows easier selling of houses, the study finds that when lenders can use collateral more easily, they can lend more money without causing any problems with how they assign credit. This shows that collateral is important in making it easier for people to borrow money, especially in countries that are still developing. This research suggests that policies should focus on addressing issues related to collateral in order to improve access to credit for individuals.

12500620.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500620.value: 心理學文獻表明，語音和面部表情中表現出的情感揭示了相關且可靠的信息，可幫助觀察者區分撒謊者和講真話的人。我們的研究旨在調查盈餘電話會議和IPO路演中表達的管理者情緒是否可以可靠地預測公司財務報告的質量，尤其是欺詐性財務報告。我們還建議研究公開披露中的管理者情緒是否以及如何影響投資者對公司短期和長期估值過程。 基於語音分析和面部肌肉運動分析的最新機器學習技術，我們建議建立一個獨特且全面的管理情緒數據庫，該數據庫包含高層管理人員的電話會議中的語音和IPO路演演講中的面部表情所隱含的豐富情緒指標。我們的數據庫將包含各種高層管理人員的情感，包括興奮，活力，內容，沮喪，憤怒，強調，不確定，集中，理性，猶豫，尷尬，思維密集，想像力，極端情感，濃厚興趣，舒適，驚訝，害怕，厭惡和鄙視。該數據庫將使我們能夠為我們的研究問題提供新穎而係統的證據。具體而言，擬議的研究將提供新的見解，以了解高層管理人員的情感是否以及如何包含與公司價值相關的信息，而這些信息在很大程度上被各種市場參與者所忽視。這項研究的結果還可以通過將高層管理人員的情緒作為相關和可靠的預測因素納入公開披露中，從而幫助監管機構和從業人員增強發現公司欺詐的能力。擬議的研究如果可以為高層管理人員的情緒在公司欺詐檢測中的作用提供實證，將值得政策制定者借鑒。

12500820.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12500820.value: 托育補助全蒐羅 親子天下 Yù'ér bǔtiē zhèngcè de jūnhéng fēnxī: Xiàolǜ yǔ gōngpíng 17/5000 育兒補貼政策的均衡分析：效率與公平

12500820.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12500820.value: Prof Fu, Chao Prof van Kippersluis, Hans

12500820.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12500820.value: The cost and availability of childcare are two crucial determinants of parental choices of formal childcare use and labor supply. However, previous studies of childcare subsidy policies are divided into two largely independent strands of research investigating the childcare market and individual family behavior separately. Moreover, the latter strand of research on individual family behavior almost exclusively examine how price changes affect childcare use and labor supply independently without considering that these choices are simultaneously determined within households. This project aims to fill both gaps in the existing literature by developing an equilibrium model that considers households’ choices of labor supply and childcare use as a simultaneous decision and integrates households’ childcare choices with childcare centers’ decisions on supply to an equilibrium of the childcare market. The model will be estimated on the basis of a unique longitudinal dataset that covers formal childcare use, parental labor supply, and access to childcare services at the individual level for the entire population of the Netherlands. Identification of the model will rely on unprecedented policy variation that reduced the generosity of childcare subsidies in the Netherlands in 2012 and 2013, which enables us to make a unique contribution to the existing empirical literature that exclusively examine expansions of childcare subsidies. Moreover, by estimating a structural model with externalities through childcare supply at the neighborhood level, we are able to investigate heterogeneity in the effects of childcare subsidy reforms by not only households’ socio-demographic background but also neighborhood characteristics. Last but not least, through simulation analysis, we are also able to compare the efficacy and distributional consequences of various alternative childcare policies and evaluate specific household-based or neighborhood-based targeted childcare policies or interventions. 托育的成本和可獲得性是父母選擇使用托育服務和勞動力供應的兩個關鍵決定因素。以前關於托育補貼政策的文獻往往分別研究對托育市場和個體家庭行為的影響。後者關於個人家庭行為的文獻幾乎只分開看價格變化如何分別影響托育服務的使用和勞動力供應，而未考慮到個體家庭需同時做出這兩個選擇。本課題旨在通過建立一個一般均衡的模型將家庭對勞動力供應和托育選擇視為同時做出的決定，並將家庭的托育選擇與托育中心的供應決定整合為托育市場的市場均衡結果。該模型將通過涵蓋荷蘭全部人口的托育選擇、父母的勞動力供應以及托育服務的可達性的縱向數據進行估算。模型的識別將依靠一個前所未有的在二零一二年和二零一三年間降低了荷蘭托育補貼的政策變化，使得我們的研究能夠對現有的全部基於補貼增加的政策變化的文獻做出獨特的貢獻。此外，通過估算一個在鄰里間托育服務供應具有外部性的結構模型，我們可以研究托育補貼改革效果在個體間和鄰里間的異質性。最後，通過模擬分析，我們還能夠比較各種替代性托育政策的效果的分佈並評估基於特定目標家庭或鄰里的托育政策或乾預措施。

12501120.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12501120.value: Information acquisition is crucial for decision making procedures, in particular, for search. There is vast consumer search literature that study how sellers provide information to the consumers, while consumers' information acquisition is often modeled in an all-or-nothing manner, i.e., once you pay a search cost, you learn everything about the product. Imagine that a consumer searches online in order to purchase a product. The information acquisition procedure might be more complicated in this internet era. Relevant information regarding purchase decision is likely to be more than what one can digest. Consumers have to choose what type of information to process and to what extent to process. Consumers' information acquisition strategy has implications for sellers' pricing strategy. Price set by the seller affects not only a consumer's surplus but also each consumer's incentive to acquire information. A higher price might encourage or discourage consumers to acquire more information while acquiring more information does not imply higher demand. Therefore, the seller needs to be very careful when determining price when she anticipates that consumers engage in active information acquisition. We adopt the framework of rational inattention in this project to model information acquisition. Rational inattention captures the phenomenon that humans cannot digest all available information, but can choose which exact pieces of information to attend to. Rational inattention offers a tractable and intuitive way to model information acquisition and is applied to various fields such as finance, trade and political economics. Yet it has not been explored in search where information is abundant. Recent work in all these fields has shown that market outcomes are very sensitive to consumer information acquisition strategies. A key question in the literature has been to inspect the effect of search cost on price. We would like to investigate how optimal price, seller’s profit and consumer welfare vary with the information acquisition cost. One might also wonder what type of information and how much information consumers gather during the whole process, and how it is influenced by information acquisition cost. More generally, we are curious about how seller's incentive to provide information and consumers' incentive to acquire information interact with each other, and whether platform designer has incentive to intervene. This project aims to understand the interaction between consumer search, information acquisition and price competition. Moreover, this project points to opportunity for analyzing other relevant problems like marriage market and school match, which also involve similar information acquisition procedure. 信息獲取對於決策程序至關重要，特別是對於搜索。大量的搜索文獻研究了賣方如何決定給消費者提供信息，而消費者的信息獲取通常被假設為一種全有或全無的方式，即，一旦您支付了搜索費用，您就會了解有關產品的所有信息。試想一下，消費者在線搜索購買產品。在這個互聯網時代，信息獲取的過程可能會更加複雜，有關購買決定的相關信息可能會超出消費者能夠消化的範圍。消費者必須選擇要處理的信息類型和花費多少精力去處理。 消費者的信息獲取策略對賣方的定價策略有影響。賣方設定的價格不僅影響消費者剩餘，而且影響每個消費者去獲取信息的激勵。較高的價格可能會鼓勵或勸阻消費者在獲取更多信息，獲取更多的信息也並不意味著對產品更高的需求。因此，賣方在確定價格時需要非常考慮到消費者參與主動信息獲取的激勵和價格的關係。 我們在本項目中採用理性疏忽的框架來對信息獲取進行建模。理性疏忽捕捉了人類無法消化所有信息的現象。理性疏忽提供了一種易於處理且直觀的信息獲取的建模方法，並被應用於金融，貿易和政治經濟學等各個領域。然而，尚未在搜索的領域中被應用。最近的這些領域的文獻都表明，市場結果對消費者的信息獲取策略非常敏感。 文獻中的一個關鍵問題是檢查搜索成本對價格的影響。我們試圖探索最佳價格，賣方的利潤和消費者福利如何變化，當信息獲取成本變化的時候。 我们也想知道消費者在整個過程中，收集哪種類型的信息并且收集了多少信息，以及如何受信息獲取成本的影響。 我們试图探索賣方提供信息的動機和消費者獲取信息的動機如何彼此影响，以及平台設計者是否有動機進行干預。 該項目旨在了解消費者搜索，信息獲取之間的相互作用。 這個項目也指出了应用信息獲取模型與與其他相關問題的機會，例如婚姻市場和學校匹配。

12502620.label: Major findings and research outcome
12502620.value: This project studies whether a decentralized, unregulated market of private currencies will provide adequate incentives for innovations. By private currencies, we refer to all private monies that come with their associated platforms (not necessarily digital), which include but not limited to digital currencies such as cryptocurrencies. The key finding is that, unlike innovations in traditional economic sectors, innovations in private currencies have an immediate value-destruction impact on the society, even before such innovations bear any fruit. The reason is that an anticipated new, and better, currency immediately depresses the values of existing currencies even when this new currency has not yet arrived. The depressed values of existing currencies, in turns, make decentralized trades more inefficient. The project identifies the key conditions under which such a value-destruction effect dominates any benefits that come from innovation: (1) when the discount factor is low; (2) when the scale of improvement is small; (3) when the seigniorage that an entrepreneur can collect from an ICO takes up a large share of the social welfare generated by the private currency he invents (which will be the case if utility functions are closer to be linear); and (4) when user bases of different currencies tend to be fleeting in the sense that they flock to a new currency en masse as long as there is a tiny improvement. Yet, in a decentralized and unregulated market, entrepreneurs do not internalize their innovations' value-destruction effects, and hence tend to over-innovate. In this situation, policies that regulate and hence slow down innovations can be beneficial to the society.

12502620.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12502620.value: Banning private currencies is a crude policy. More nuanced policies may include policies that regulate how an entrepreneur is allowed to recoup his innovation costs (e.g., whether he is allowed to collect seigniorage in an ICO, or whether he is only allowed to collect fees). Future research can study how these more nuanced policies can do better than the very crude policy we studied in this project.

12502620.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12502620.value: Modern-day private monies do not come in the form of stand-alone currencies like casino chips, but more often are an integral part of an associated trading platform. The architecture of the trading platform makes possible some previously impossible decentralized trades. One example is Ether, the native currency on Ethereum, the blockchain that is home to the majority of DeFi applications. Another example is the ill-fated Libre/Diem, the stablecoin designed for Facebook, whose potential was so threatening to regulators that paradoxically contributed to its fateful demise. These private monies hence are not unlike innovations in traditional economic sectors, and involve costly innovations in their associated platforms. In a decentralized market of private monies, do innovators have adequate incentives to innovate for the benefit of the society? This project makes a first attempt in answering this question. Specifically, we study a quality-ladder model of private monies, where a succession of private monies are adopted by the society, with each new one replacing an old one, resulting in more and more decentralized trades being made possible. We identify conditions under which innovators over- or under-innovate, and suggest policies that are appropriate in this market.

12600120.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600120.value: Research on innovation processes in China has been mainly conducted at national and regional levels, whereas studies at individual and community levels, such as on makerspaces that have emerged since the 2010s, are limited. Digital fabrication technologies, such as additive manufacturing (3D printing), advanced automated equipment and artificial intelligence (AI), have become increasingly accessible for independent innovators and maker communities at various sites of makerspaces. Despite the implications of the intertwined development processes being acknowledged in policy circles, makerspaces as emergent spaces and scales of innovation in digital fabrication remain poorly understood and under-researched, in comparison with formalized innovation activities in traditional production. Existing literature on makerspaces has focused on local networks in specific territories, but research on extra-local connections of makerspace innovation is scant. Studies on technological innovation systems have largely neglected the distinct spatial effects of digital fabrication, especially in the emerging makerspaces in the global south, such as China. Drawing upon the multi-scalar relational perspective in economic geography, which is developed to study the non-territorially bounded dimension of innovation, this project examines the emerging makerspace innovation in digital fabrication in China and particularly in Shenzhen, known as China’s Silicon Valley. This project has a threefold goal: 1) to identify the salient economic, social, cultural and institutional contexts and motivations in which the makerspaces have emerged and generated innovation in widespread digital fabrication; 2) to understand the nature, locational patterns, operation and organization of open-source innovation involving individuals and communities of makers in various makerspaces in association with digital fabrication technologies, particularly addictive manufacturing; and 3) to recognize the role of makerspace innovation in digital fabrication in the evolving dynamics and processes of innovation in China, especially their interconnections with the formalized innovation systems at the regional, national and global levels. The project will be conducted through on-site field investigation, participatory observation, semi-structured interviews and multi-case studies of the emergent makerspaces engaged in digital fabrication innovation in China and Shenzhen in particular. By extending the Western-oriented empirical research to China and particularly Shenzhen, the project contributes to the innovation research by shifting the focus away from the established firms and institutions and towards a comprehensive understanding of digital technological innovation involving individuals and communities of makerspaces. The project has practical implications for various innovators, producers and consumers of digital fabrication, as well as policy makers and practitioners at multi-scalar spaces in the digital age of the global economy. 現有關於中國的創新動力和過程的研究主要在國家和地方進行，而對於個人和社區級的研究，特別是自2010年代以來出現的創客空間有限。數字製作、3D打印等技術，高級自動化設備和人工智能（AI）已變得越來越普及。獨立的創新者和創客社區位於創客空間的重要節點，創客空間作為數字製造中的新興空間和創新尺度仍然缺乏了解和研究不足。關於創客空間的現有文獻主要側重於特定地區的本地網絡，但研究本地外連結創客空間創新的研究則嫌不足。對技術創新系統的研究在很大程度上忽略了數字製造的獨特空間效應，尤其是在中國等發展中國家等新興創客空間。 基於經濟地理學中的多尺度關係視角，即本項目旨在研究創新的非領土範圍，該項目考察了中國特別是在被稱為中國矽谷的深圳的數字製造領域新興的創客空間的創新活動，這個項目有三個方面研究目的：1）剖析創客空間出現的經濟，社會，文化和體制背景，以及數字製作產生創新的動機； 2）探究涉及個人和企業的開源創新的運營和組織的創新性質；以及3）考察創客空間創新在不斷發展的動力學和過程中在數字製造中的作用，特別是它們與正規創新的相互聯繫區域，國家和全球各級的系統。該項目將通過實地調查、參與性觀察，半結構化訪談和對於從事數字製造的新興創客空間的多案例分析，研究中國尤其是深圳的創客空間的創新過程和動力機制。 本項目的貢獻將西方的實證研究擴展到中國，尤其是深圳，同時將創新研究範疇和重點從成熟的公司和機構轉移到涉及個人和社區的數字技術創新及作爲其載體的新興創客空間。該項目對各種創新機構和生產商俱有實際意義，並為數字製造的消費群體，並可為全球經濟數字時代中多尺度空間下的政策制定者和實踐者提供參考。

12600320.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600320.value: Ci, or song lyrics, were originally sung to music. After the Yuan dynasty, as the music of ci tunes gradually declined and disappeared, the question of how to establish the formal orthodoxy and legitimacy in the writing of ci lyrics became a matter of great concern. This was especially true in the Qing dynasty, when against the broad backdrop of the revival in ci poetics, the investigation into catalogues of ci tune patterns (cipu) was an important step in exalting the ci genre. The appearance of Wan Shu’s 萬樹compilation, Cilü 詞律 (Ci Metrics), was a significant indicator that the Qing scholars studied the catalogues of ci tune patterns with increased depth, meticulousness, and involved a broad range of fields. The fruits of their research in turn contributed to the writing in the ci genre. The effects are abundantly manifested in many areas, including the development of poetry groups and movements, the unfolding of collective writing activities, and the variety in writing styles. This project aims to conduct a thorough examination of ci tune catalogues in the Qing dynasty. Moreover, by incorporating specific developments in Qing ci poetry, this project will analyze the interplay between theory and practice, thereby gain new insight on this particular level in the study of the ci genre and poetics in the Qing dynasty. 詞本是可以唱的，但元代之後，由於詞樂漸漸消亡，繼續保持詞的音樂性是很多人都在考慮的問題。這在清代更為突出。在清代詞學復興的過程中，對詞譜、詞律的研究是重要的一環。清代對詞譜詞律的研究，更為深刻，更為細緻，並且涉及廣泛的領域。反過來，他們的研究成果也為詞體文學創作提供了助力。這在許多領域都得到了充分體現，包括詞人的群體特色，集體寫作的展開和寫作風格的多樣性等。本課題旨在對詞譜詞律進行徹底調查，結合清詞創作的發展，探討其相互作用，從而更好地研究清代詞學的理論和實踐。

12601720.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601720.value: 現時已經有顯著證據顯示自我決定為預測殘疾人士學後成果的因素之一。雖然自我決定的介入訓練早已成為多個國家特殊教育服務的重要元素(Algozzine et al., 2001)， 近期有研究發現智力障礙人士的自我決定程度低於同輩(e.g. Cheak-Zamora et al., 2019) 。這意味著現時自我決定的推動及實踐尚有優化空間，因而應投放更多努力去找出有什麽因素能令自我決定介入訓練有成效。 自我決定的介入訓練一般包括學習自我倡導、目標設定、自我監控、決策、解決問題及規劃等技巧(Algozzine et al., 2001; Karvonen, et al., 2001)。智力障礙人士在日常生活中都面對著高階認知作業的挑戰(Schalock, et al., 2010)。由於自我決定中涉及的認知過程對智力需求甚大，因此引起探討自我決定發展是否被智力障礙所侷限的問題。我們提出執行功能影響自我決定的發展。執行功能是一種高階認知作業，去協調各種認知過程，如工作記憶、自制、認知彈性等(Diamond, 2013) ，而該些認知過程在進行有目的或目標導向行為時是必需的，並與自我決定的行為吻合。本方案研究執行功能訓練對智力障礙的青少年發展自我決定的影響。我們將採用電腦程式訓練參加者的各種執行功能。同時，我們將採用有系統的課程，以提升自我決定的課堂教學作為介入模式。本研究將邀請九十名年滿十六至十八歲患有輕度及中度智力障礙的學生參與。參加者將被隨機地分為三組，第一組將會接受執行功能訓練及自我決定介入訓練，第二組只會接受自我決定介入訓練，最後一組則為活躍對照組。我們將會在研究的不同時段收集包括自我決定、執行功能、非語言智力、學後成果以及生活質量等數據進行分析。我們假設第一組參加者在訓練完結時及後六個月的執行功能及自我決定程度有顯著的進步。這組的參加者於訓練後的一年將會擁有比其他組別較佳的生活質量、收入、獲聘請、及持續進修的機會。至於研究貢獻方面，發展有科學根據的介入方案，有機會提升患有智力障礙的人士在成人階段時的獨立性及生活質量，對其照顧者或親人皆有裨益。

12601720.label: Realisation of objectives
12601720.value: Overview of Project Implementation The three objectives have been fully achieved by the effort of the research team. Despite the pandemic during our project period (2021-2023), we managed to build partnership with five special schools in Hong Kong and recruited 79 students with mild to moderate ID to join our intervention which lasted for 4 months and conducted the pretest and posttest data collection. The project consists of four main stages of the project: pretest, intervention, posttest, and follow-up interview. Seventy-five of participants completed the first three stages. Four students dropped out of the project at stage one due to different reasons, including health issues, classroom behaviors, and withdrawal from school. Fifty-seven participants completed the fourth stage of follow-up phone interview. The remaining participants either refused to be interviewed or did not respond to phone calls at the final follow-up. To achieve objective 1 “To evaluate the effectiveness of self-determination and executive function training for adolescents with intellectual disability immediately after intervention”, participants were assigned to three groups: the self determination and executive function training group (SD+EF Group), the SD intervention only group (SD Group), and the control group. At the beginning of the project, all participants were assessed with computerized cognitive tests to evaluate their cognitive ability. They filled in the AIR-Self Determination Survey (Chinese Version) (AIR-SDS-C) and the Quality of Life Questionnaire for Individuals with Intellectual Disabilities (Chinese Version) (CQoL) which evaluated their self-determination level and perceived quality of life. Participants from the SD+EF Group and the SD Group attended a 16-week SD training programme. In addition to the SD training programme, participants in the SD+EF Group also took part in a 16-week training programme specifically to train executive functions. All participants were given the same computerized cognitive tests and surveys after intervention to evaluate the effectiveness of intervention. To determine the effectiveness of the training, multiple repeated measures ANCOVAs were conducted. Group (SD+EF, SD and control group) was the between-subject factor. Timing of assessment (pre-test and post-test) was the within-subject factor. Age, IQ and sex were covariates. The dependent variables were the composite scores of EF performance and subscale scores of SD questionnaire scores. The results showed no significant effect that the overall self-determination and executive function training was effective for adolescents with intellectual disability. However, correlation analyses revealed that executive planning, one of the subconstructs of executive function, is positively correlated with the capacity subscale of self-determination. This finding suggests that training executive planning skills may facilitate the development of self-determination. To achieve objective 2 “to examine whether executive function training modulates the outcomes of self-determination intervention”, statistical analyses was conducted to observe whether executive function affects the effectiveness of self-determination intervention. Multiple regression analyses were conducted to predict quality of life scores with different executive functions and subconstructs of self-determination. The mediation analysis revealed that executive planning, one of the subconstructs of executive function, predicts self-determination capacity scores. Also, higher scores in self-determination capacity predict higher scores in quality of life. Objective 2 was achieved. To achieve objective 3 “to investigate the impact of self-determination and executive function training on the postschool outcomes (including employment and further education) and quality of life of adolescents with intellectual disability after graduation”, the research team arranged follow-up phone or zoom interviews with the participants after graduation. The follow-up interview consists of two surveys. The first survey is a semi-structured interview designed to follow-up on their job status and their desire to pursue future education. The second survey is the CQoL to assess their latest view on quality of life. Fifty-seven participants responded. Objective 3 was achieved.

12601720.label: Major findings and research outcome
12601720.value: This study examines the relationships among cognitive abilities, self-determination, and quality of life in adolescents with intellectual disability. Seventy-nine adolescents aged between 17 and 20 years with mild intellectual disability joined the study. Executive functions including executive planning, working memory, and inhibition were assessed by experimental tasks. Non-verbal IQ, survey data regarding quality of life, self-determination capacity, and self-determination opportunity were collected from the participants. Major findings: 1) A significant relationship between executive planning and self-determination was found: executive planning predicts capacity of self-determination (β = .262, t(64) = 2.20, p = .031, 95% C.I.: .012 to .244). However, other kinds of executive functions (including working memory and inhibition) do not predict capacity of self-determination. 2) A significant relationship between executive planning and quality of life was found: executive planning predicts quality of life (β = .401, t(63) = 3.44, p = .001, 95% C.I.: .137 to .518). However, other kinds of executive functions do not predict QoL. 3) There was also a significant direct effect of executive planning on quality of life (β = -.292, t = -2.70, p = .009, 95% C.I. = -.103 to -.015). For the mediator paths, executive planning significantly predicts self-determination capacity (β = .262, t(64) = 2.20, p = .031, 95% C.I.: .012 to .244), and self-determination capacity significantly predicts quality of life (β = .537, t(63) = 4.89, p < .001, 95% C.I. = .131 to .313). However, the indirect effect of executive planning on quality of life does not reach significance (β = .141, 95% C.I. = -.067 to .293). Research Output: The findings obtained in this project were published in this journal: Lui, M., Lau, G. K. B., & Wong, P. K. S.. (published online in 2023). The associations among executive planning, self-determination, and quality of life in adolescents with intellectual disability. Journal of Intellectual Disability Research. [Impact factor = 3.6; Journal Citation Reports: 1/43 (Education, Special (Social Science)); 2/73 (Rehabilitation (Social Science)]

12601720.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
12601720.value: Our finding highlights the potential benefits of training executive planning skills and self-determination among adolescents with intellectual disability, as the findings suggested that improving executive planning is linked to a higher capacity of self-determination. Future intervention program should be more targeting and specific in the type of executive functions that may benefits the lives of adolescents with intellectual disability. The current study drew conclusions mainly based on cross-sectional data. Further intervention and longitudinal studies are necessary if we want to obtain a better understanding on the causal relationships and the impact of training executive planning and self-determination on the quality of life among individuals with intellectual disability. Future longitudinal studies may also collect data about employment, independent living and leisure activities to measure the quality of life during adulthood in addition to self-reported survey data of quality of life.

12601720.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
12601720.value: Independent living and quality-of-life among individuals with intellectual disabilities during adulthood is a major concern among families of the individuals. This research project attempts to identify evidence-based intervention and training approach to improve the self-determination and cognitive abilities among adolescents with intellectual disabilities, which may contribute to improve their independent living abilities and quality of life. The current study’s findings highlight the importance of a specific type of executive function – executive planning - for individuals with intellectual disabilities. Having stronger executive planning skills is linked to higher capability in self-determination, which facilitates decision-making and goal-driven behaviors. Individuals with stronger self-determination capacity are better equipped with the skills to set goals and make plans for achieving life goals. Our research may inform the design of cognitive training and self-determination intervention to equip such individuals with the necessary skills to enjoy independent living throughout their adulthood.

12601820.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601820.value: The project is situated in communication studies’ subfield of health communication, and uses an experimental approach to examine how to motivate and enable young adults, through storytelling, to discuss with their parents their wish to donate their own organs, posthumously. The story features emotions anticipated to be experienced in the future event and cogent wish appeals, which are approaches to convince parents of young adults honor their organ donation wish. Both will be assessed for its persuasiveness. Hong Kong’s organ donation rate is among the lowest in the developed world [1]. For instance, half of the patients with kidney failure will die before an optimal cadaveric organ is available [1]. Therefore, Hong Kong’s situation of organ donation is a severe concern. Surveys [2-3] consistently show that family opposition is a major barrier to organ donation; families’ refusal is commonly because their deceased loved one did not share with them their wish to donate [4]. Furthermore, Hong Kong’s opting-in system for donation requires family consent prior to extracting the deceased’s organs, regardless of the individual’s donation card indication. Therefore, to promote organ donation in Hong Kong, it is necessary to persuade people to tell their family their wish to donate their own organs, posthumously. Narratives can be an appropriate form of communication to persuade young adults to express their donation wish to their parents; narratives can portray scenarios in which audiences can envision what their parents might experience by not telling them about their wish. Furthermore, narratives can foster vicarious learning through modeling (watching how others successfully convince their parents to support their donation wish). Although narratives have been recognized as an effective form of communication for health behavior change [5], the message features that could enhance narratives’ persuasiveness remain less understood. Guided by the theory of motivated information management (TMIM) and research on organ donation, we propose an experiment to address the research gap: examining how narratives that feature different anticipated emotions and different cogent wish appeals can motivate and enable young adults to have family discussions about organ donation. By identifying which anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeals influence the variables of issue importance and communication efficacy, the two key TMIM determinants that foster family discussion, this study's findings will advance the TMIM framework. Furthermore, it will inform health communicators about designing effective narrative content for promoting family discussion about the donation wish. 這項研究是屬於傳播學中健康溝通的分支，並運用實驗方法以探究如何激勵及使年輕成人能透過故事表達方式，去和他們的父母討論死後捐贈自己器官的意願。故事會以預計在未來可能經歷的情感和具理據的意願表達為特徵，作為說服年輕成人父母以他們捐贈器官為榮的方法。兩者皆會以說服力作評估。 香港的器官捐贈率是在已發展地區中最低的一員。例如一半有腎臟問題的病人會在出現合適屍體器官前死亡。因此，香港的器官捐贈情況是值得嚴重的關注。 調查持續地顯示家庭反對是器官捐贈的重大障礙，家庭拒絕如此常見，因為他們離世的親人並沒有對他們分享捐贈的意願。再者，香港的自願器官捐贈制度要求在摘取死者器官前必須先獲得家屬同意，不管個人器官捐贈卡的表示。因此在香港推廣器官捐贈，說服人們告知他們的家庭在死後捐贈自己器官的意願是必要的。 敍事能夠作為恰當的溝通方式，說服年輕成人向他們的父母表達捐贈的意願。敍事能讓觀眾預見如不事先告知父母意願，父母可能會有的經歷的情境。而且，敍事能培養透過模仿的替代學習（觀察他人如何成功說服父母表達支持捐贈的意願）。雖然敍事已被承認為帶來健康行為轉變的有效溝通方式，能提升敘事者說服力的信息特徵的理解仍然很少。 在動機資訊管理理論和器官捐贈研究的引導下，我們提出了一個實驗去填補這個研究缺口：探討以不同預期情感和不同說服理據的意願表達為特徵的敍事，如何鼓勵及使年輕成人能與家庭討論器官捐贈。 透過分辨哪個預期情感和說服理據的意願表達，影響變數如議題重要性和溝通效能，這兩項動機資訊管理理論中促進家庭討論的決定因素，這項研究會會充實動機資訊管理理論的框架。並且，這會告知健康溝通者如何設計有效的敍事內容，以提昇關於捐贈意願的家庭討論。

12601820.label: Realisation of objectives
12601820.value: 1. Project Status Guided by the Theory of Motivated Information Management, this project examines how message features of anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeals influence single young adults’ intention to express their organ donation wish to parents. In this project, we conducted a 4 (anticipated emotions: regret vs. guilt vs. pride vs. joy) by 3 (Cogent Wish Appeals: Empathic appeal vs. Organ donor prototype appeal vs. Subjective norm appeal) between subject factorial experiment. We recruited more than 800 young adults and successfully contacted 708 young adults to individually collect data. We completed basic and advanced data analyses, and the findings are enclosed in Part C. We are now at the stage of preparing a manuscript for conference and journal submission. We are still preparing a manuscript for conference and journal submission because our project timeline was severely disrupted by the campus closure and social restriction during the multiple COVID-19 community outbreaks. As stated in the mid-term progress report, our video production was severely delayed because our animator was unable to access to high-capacity computer due to the campus closure. As a result, the production time took longer as scheduled. Because of the social restrictions, the production house took a longer time to complete the video dubbing. We also faced challenges to recruit participants and to conduct the experiment at the computer laboratory on individual basis. Because the University had purchased licenses of Zoom videoconferencing, we were able to remediate the challenges by switching the recruitment and data collection online. Specifically, the use of Zoom allowed us to conduct the experiment with individual participant via video conferencing. As a result, we could speed up the data collection process. We requested a project extension for six months, which allowed us to complete all data collection. We successfully completed the experiment on a one-on-one basis with 708 participants by June 30, 2023. After the data collection, we engaged in the process of data cleaning and management. We conducted two sets of analyses: (1) Using the ANOVA approach, one focused on the joint effect between anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeal; (2) Using the structural equation modelling approach, the other focused on specifying pathway of how anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeal influence organ donation wish expression (see Part C for details). In short, except for producing a full research output for conference and journal submission, we successfully all essential parts in this project. Our project team has successfully completed data collection, with 708 young adults joined the experiment. We also completed basic and advanced data analyses. We are preparing a manuscript for conference and journal submission. Because we have completed the data analysis and obtained significant findings (see Part C), we are confident to produce a research output out of this project and we are in good progress in manuscript preparation. 2. Completion of Project Objectives According to the project proposal, we specified four project objectives. Based on the findings, we successfully completed all four objectives in 100% capacity. Below we explained how and what extent each project objective had been achieved. Objective #1: To identify the message features that enhance the persuasiveness of narratives Our research identified anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeal as an important message features to enhance the persuasiveness of narratives. The ANOVA results showed that the effect of anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeal exerted an interactive influences on individuals’ issue importance, F(6,696) = 6.07, p < .001, η2 = .05, uncertainty discrepancy, F(6,696) = 4.81, p < .001, η2 = .04, anxiety, F(6,696) = 5.64, p < .001, η2 = .05, outcome expectancy, F(6,696) = 4.16, p < .001, η2 = .04, communication efficacy, F(6,696) = 5.60, p < .001, η2 = .05, Organ Donation Wish expression Intention, F(6,696) = 2.87, p < .01, η2 = .02. Objective #2: To advance the TMIM framework by examining how anticipated emotions increase young adults’ perceived issue importance for family discussion, and how different cogent wish appeals increase their communication efficacy to convince their parents’ support for their donation decision Our findings advanced the TMIM framework by revealing the psychological mechanism of how narratives with the message features of anticipated emotions and cogent wish appeal influence young adults’ intention to express organ donation wish to their parents. As shown in Figure 1, the structural model showed that participants who were exposed to the narrative with message features of the anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal were more likely to experience higher uncertainty discrepancy than those who were exposed to the other six different narratives with different combination of anticipated emotion and cogent wish appeal message features. Furthermore, those participants who experienced higher uncertainty discrepancy had higher anxiety, β = .58, p < .001. Higher level of anxiety led to higher level of communication efficacy, β = .07, p < .05, and lower outcome expectancy, β = .07, p < .05. Both outcome expectancy, β = .61, p < .001, and communication efficacy, β = .44, p < .001 positively influenced donation wish expression intention. Objective #3: To inform communication practitioners on the design of narrative content Based on our study’s findings, the narrative with the anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal may be more persuasive than the other six narratives with different combinations of anticipated emotion and cogent wish appeal. Our study suggests that, the narrative with the anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal is more likely to persuade young adults to express the donation wish to their parents. Therefore, our findings can provide evidence to inform health communication practitioners to choose narratives with the anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal. Objective #4: To help the Hong Kong Society of Transplantation to develop an evidence-based persuasive message to promote family discussion about organ donation Based on our findings, narratives with anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal are likely to be more persuasive than other narratives with different combinations of anticipated emotion and cogent wish appeal. Therefore, based on the findings, we produced the promotional animation with the message features of with anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal. We provided this version of animation to the Hong Kong Society of Transplantation for its organ donation promotion effort. 3. Conference and Journal Submission Under Preparation Based on the findings, we are in the stage of preparing a manuscript for conference and journal submission. We aim to submit the manuscript to the 2025 annual conference of the International Communication Association, June 12 – 16, 2025. The deadline of manuscript submission is November 1, 2024. Therefore, we have sufficient time to prepare the manuscript for conference submission. We will submit the manuscript for journal review after the conference submission. We aim at submitting the manuscript to the academic journal of "Health Communication".

As shown in Figure 1, the structural model showed that participants who were exposed to the narrative with message features of the anticipated guilt by subjective norm appeal were more likely to experience higher uncertainty discrepancy than those who were exposed to the other six different narratives with different combination of anticipated emotion and cogent wish appeal message features. Higher level of anxiety led to higher level of communication efficacy, β = .07, p < .05, and lower outcome expectancy, β = .07, p < .05. Both outcome expectancy, β = .61, p < .001, and communication efficacy, β = .44, p < .001 positively influenced donation wish expression intention.
