16310020.label: Major findings and research outcome
16310020.value: First, short synthesis method material (PTQ10 and PTVT-T) was made to achieve a high efficiency and a decent figure-of-merit Organic solar cell. A series of characterizations show that the optimal morphology of the ternary blend is the result of the coupling and competition of PTQ10 and PTVT-T, where the molecular packing and phase separation motif of PTQ10 is broken but the strong aggregation of PTVT-T is suppressed, resulting in efficient charge transport and collection, as well as suppressed bimolecular recombination. With this strategy, this organic solar cell device is able to reach Voc of 0.883V, Jsc of 27.02mA cm-2, FF of 80.1%, and a PCE of 19.11% which is one of the most high performance organic solar cells. Second, a new polymer linker PY-V-y was synthesized and it achieves more supreme efficiency compared to traditional thiophene or bithiophene linkers (PY-T-y and PY-2T-y). The thiophene linker display significant molecular twisting between end-groups and linker units, while PY-V-y exhibits a more coplanar and rigid molecular conformation. As a result, PY-V-y demonstrates better conjugation and tighter interchain stacking, which results in higher mobility and a reduced energetic disorder. Furthermore, detailed morphology investigations reveal that the PY-V-y-based blend exhibits high domain purity and thus a better fill factor in its all-PSCs. With all these advantages, this organic solar cell device is able to reach Voc of 0.912V, Jsc of 24.8mA cm-2, FF of 75.8%, and a PCE of 17.1% which is one of the most high performance all-organic solar cells. Third, a modulated benzyl side chain material (FCC-Cl-4Ph) was synthesized to achieve higher efficiency in indoor performance. This material shows a more blue-shifted spectrum compared with the alkyl side chain FCCCL which fits the indoor spectrum more. Results show that the bulky alkylphenyl side chains can finely tune the absorption properties of the NFAs and also affect their morphological properties. This material is able to reach excellent indoor efficiencies of over 29% under a 3000 K LED lamp at 1000 lux and shows better solution processability over FCC-Cl-C8. More importantly, FCC-Cl-4Ph can maintain high indoor performance (29.7-26.8% at 1000 lux) under a wide range of indoor lighting spectra (2600, 3000, 4000, and 6500 K LED lamps), which should be due to the blue-shifted spectra of FCC-Cl-4Ph and better matching with various indoor conditions.

16310020.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16310020.value: To improve the higher efficiency of indoor organic solar cells, more blue-shifted materials need to be discovered meanwhile maintaining high molecular packing and aggregation. End-group and core modulation with smaller ICT may be able to achieve a more-blueshift absorption. Also, make all-polymer solar cells are able to achieve higher Voc which benefits the absorption spectrum of the material. Furthermore, electron-withdrawing side chain can also be a useful strategy to achieve a more blue-shifted material. Secondly, materials with short and simple synthesis steps are essential to achieve organic solar cell commercialization. For example, to achieve high performance with non-fuse organic solar cells and simple additives to boost the performance of the organic solar cells. Recently, the efficiency of non-fuse material significantly boosts using the strategy of the bulky side chain to constrict the geometry of the organic solar cell to keep its linearity.

16310020.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16310020.value: Due to the increase trend of energy consumption, it is necessary to replace conventional and unsustainable energy source by renewable energy, such as coal, nature gas and oil. Organic solar cell (OSCs) has shown to be a promising solar energy harvesting technology and have attracted significant industrial and academic attention due to their advantages, including lightweight, low cost, flexibility, non-toxicity, roll-to-roll manufacture, and semi-transparency. In the last decade, an extensive amount of effort has been devoted to device engineering, morphological optimization, mechanism study and material design. This greatly contributes to the rapid improvement in PCEs of non-fullerene OSCs. The non-fullerene OSCs based on PM6 like donors and Y6-series SMAs have reached almost 20%. Besides the SMA-based OSCs, all-polymer solar cells with polymer acceptors based on the Y6-series repeating units also become a hot research topic in the recent OSC field.

16310320.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310320.value: Deuterated organic compounds are highly useful for numerous applications, including as internal standards for mass spectrometry, as agents for elucidating the mechanisms of organic reactions and biosynthetic pathways and as deuterated drugs with improved therapeutic profiles. The site selective deuteration of alkenes is of special interest, as C=C double bonds are among the most fundamental and ubiquitous substructures of many useful organic molecules, such as in natural products and pharmaceutical molecules. Furthermore, alkenes are universally useful synthetic starting materials. The development of methods to realize-cost effective regioselective deuteration of alkenes is an important but challenging topic in synthetic chemistry. The classic strategy to access regioselectively deuterated alkenes is to perform conventional organic synthetic reactions with deuterated reagents. This strategy has the inherent limitation of relying on the availability of deuterated reagents. Alternative to this strategy is to use direct hydrogen isotope exchange reactions of alkenes with appropriate deuterium sources. Reactions with heavy water (D2O) as the source of deuterium are highly desirable, as D2O is the least expensive deuterium source that can be handled easily. Previous efforts in this direction have led to the discovery of catalysts that can efficiently catalyze deuteration of isolated vinyl groups of terminal alkenes, but precise site selective deuteration of alkenes remains a challenge. In addition, almost all reported catalytic H/D exchange reactions have involved costly and environmentally deleterious catalysts based on complexes of precious metals. Catalytic reactions involving first-row transition metal catalysts offer an attractive solution to this problem because of the high abundance, low cost and low toxicity of the catalytic metals. However, the possibility of applying these metals to the catalytic H/D exchange reactions has not been explored. The main goal of this proposed project will be to develop catalysts, especially first-row transition metal catalysts, for the effective regioselective deuteration of alkenes with D2O. The catalytic reactions that will be target are presumed to proceed through the reversible H/D exchange reactions of hydride complexes with D2O, and through reversible insertion/elimination reactions of alkenes with hydride complexes. This proposal describes the following main tasks and efforts of the proposed project: (i) to develop catalysts, especially first-row transition metal catalysts, for the effective deuteration of alkenes with D2O, (ii) to develop catalysts for the regioselective deuteration of alkenes with D2O and (iii) to demonstrate applications of the new catalytic reactions. 氘代化合物是一类具有广泛用途的化学品。例如，它们可以作为质谱分析的内标化合物，研究有机化学反应和生物合成机理的试剂，以及药物等。因此，发展制备氘代烯烃的方法具有重要的意义。传统的有机合成反应虽然可以制备氘代烯烃，这种方法通常路径较长且要用到贵重的氘代试剂。碳-碳双键广泛存在于天然产物、药物活性和生物活性分子中，烯烃是常见的有机合成原料， 通过烯烃同氘代源间进行直接的氢-氘同位素交换反应会是一个非常吸引的合成氘代烯烃的方法。重水具有廉价而且容易操作的特点，是发展烯烃氘化的最为理想的氘代源。虽然目前已有一些催化剂能实现烯烃-重水间的H/D交换反应，这些催化剂有一定的局限性，比如已知的催化剂都含有贵金属，反应选择性低。因此，发展更廉价低毒性及高选择性的催化剂具有重要的科学意义和应用价值。本研究的主要目标就是发展新的用于催化烯烃-重水间的H/D交换而制备氘代烯烃的催化剂。本项目的主要任务和工作包括：发展高效，高区域选择性的催化重水氘代烯烃反应的金属（尤其是第一过渡系）催化剂；探索这些新催化剂的应用。

16310320.label: Realisation of objectives
16310320.value: The main objectives of the project are (i) to develop catalysts for effective deuteration of alkenes with D2O and (ii) to develop catalysts for regioselective deuteration of alkenes with D2O. To achieve the objectives, we have carried out the following research work. Hydride complexes are considered as good candidates of catalysts for H/D exchange of alkenes with D2O. The metals and ligands are expected to play very important roles in controlling catalytic activity and selectivity. We have therefore made a lot of efforts in building a library of hydride complexes that are potentially catalytically active for H/D exchange reactions, with metals such as ruthenium, osmium, nickel, manganese, rhenium and cobalt and with ligands such as halide, phosphine, CO and N-heterocyclic carbenes. To search for effective catalysts for H/D exchange of alkenes with D2O, we have evaluated catalytic properties of a number of hydride complexes for H/D exchange reactions between styrene derivatives and D2O and styrene derivatives. For osmium and ruthenium catalytic systems, we have studied their functional group compatibility and substrate scope. To understand reaction mechanisms and to gain insight in the ligand effect on catalytic reactions, we have carried out stoichiometric reactions of hydride complexes of osmium and ruthenium. For example, we have carried out a systematic study of X-ligand effect on alkyne insertion reaction with RuHX(CO)(PPh3)3 (X = F, Cl, Br, I, H, NCS, CN); we have studied insertions reactions of OsHXCO)(PPh3)3 with 2-vinyl pyridine, and H/D exchange reactions of OsHXCO)(PPh3)3 with D2O either in the presence or absence of acetic acid. To help to identify catalysts that can catalyze H/D exchange reactions of alkenes with D2O without isomerization, we have studied catalytic activity of metal hydride complexes in alkene isomerization. To search for catalysts for selective deuteration of alkenes, we have compared catalytic activity of hydride complexes in the deuteration of terminal and internal alkenes, and in the deuteration of alkenes with both an internal and terminal C=C bond. We have also carried out catalytic reactions of alkenes RCH=CH2 with different substituent in order to study selective deuteration at the methylidene carbon (=CH2) and the methine carbon (=CHR) of terminal alkenes (RCH=CH2). To explore the applicability of our catalytic systems, we have studied osmium-catalyzed H/D exchange reactions of D2O with natural products and synthetic steroid derivatives, for example, Altrenogest, Forskolin, Sclareol, Tiamulin, Estrone derivatives, and Eplandrosterone derivatives. The covid-19 pandemic has negatively impacted the progress of the project. Nevertheless, we have achieved our major objectives as we have identified several efficient catalytic systems for deuteration alkenes. For example, while RuHCl(CO)(PPh3)3 can be used for deuteration of both terminal and internal alkenes, the OsHCl(CO)(PPh3)3/acetic acid system shows high selectivity for deuteration at terminal double bonds over internal double bonds and can catalyze H/D exchange reactions of alkenes without isomerization, and induces selective H/D exchange at the methine carbon (=CHR) over the methylidene carbon (=CH2) for substrates RCH=CH2 with a bulky substituent R. We plan to submit at least three manuscripts from the results of the project for publication in 2025.

16310320.label: Major findings and research outcome
16310320.value: We have synthesized a series of hydride complexes of transition metals. They include new ruthenium complexes supported by chelating phosphine ligands and N-heterocyclic carbenes, and osmium complexes with phosphine and X-type ligands [Output 2]. The catalytic properties of ruthenium hydride complexes for H/D exchange reactions of alkenes and D2O were found to be significantly affected by ligands. Ruthenium complexes of the types RuHCl(CO)(PR3)3 are more active than RuH(CNHC,Nindole)(CO)(PPh3). RuHCl(CO)(PR3)3 can promote deuteration of both terminal and internal alkenes. Ru-NHC complexes of the type RuH(CNHC,Nindole)(CO)(PPh3) induced preferential deuteration at the methylidene carbon (=CH2) than that at the methine (=CHR) of terminal alkenes (RCH=CH2) [Output 2]. The catalytic properties of osmium hydride complexes OsHX(CO)(PR3)3 also vary with ligands. The complex OsHI(CO)(PPh3)3 showed excellent catalytic activity for H/D exchange of terminal alkenes with D2O in the presence of acetic acid. The system shows high selectivity for deuteration at terminal double bonds over internal double bonds and can catalyze H/D exchange reactions of alkenes without isomerization, and induces selective H/D exchange at the methine carbon (=CHR) over the methylidene carbon (=CH2) for substrates RCH=CH2 with a bulky substituent R. The catalytic system is compatible with a variety of functional groups [Output 3]. Hydride complexes such as HCo(N2)(PPh3)3, NiHCl(PCy3)2, NiPhCl(PPh3)2 and ReHCl2(O)(PPh3)2 showed no or poor catalytic activity for the H/D exchange reaction of styrene with D2O [output 2]. The X ligands of RuHX(CO)(PPh3)3 can significantly influence rates of alkyne insertion reactions of RuHX(CO)(PPh3)3 (X = F, Cl, Br, I, H, NCS, CN). The complexes bearing Cl, Br and I readily undergo insertion reaction with the alkyne ArCCAr (Ar = p-PhCO2Me) with the insertion rates in the order of Cl < Br < I, while complexes bearing -accepting ligands such as N3, NCS, and CN do not undergo insertion reactions with the alkyne under similar condition [Output 1]. The complex OsHX(CO)(PPh3)3 (X = Cl, I) were found to undergo insertion reaction 2-vinylpyridine to give the insertion products Os(CH2CH2C5H4N)X(CO)(PPh3)2. The reactions represent the first examples of olefin insertion reactions of complexes of the types OsHX(CO)(PR3)3 and OsHX(CO)(PR3)2 [Output 3]. The catalytic system OsHI(CO)(PPh3)3/acetic acid can be used for selective labeling of olefins in complex molecules, for example natural products such as Altrenogest, Forskolin, Sclareol, and synthetic steroid derivatives such as Estrone and Epiandrosterone derivatives [Output 3].

16310320.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16310320.value: (1) The catalytic system OsHI(CO)(PPh3)3/acetic acid shows high selectivity for deuteration at terminal double bonds over internal double bonds and can efficiently catalyze selective H/D exchange reactions of alkenes without isomerization. It would be of interest to further explore its application in developing deuterated drugs. (2) We have prepare a series of new NHC-containing LX-type bidentate ligands and showed that they can form interesting complexes with ruthenium. It is of interest to use these ligands to develop coordination chemistry and catalysts with other transition metals. (3) Reactions of hydride complexes of earth abundant metals with unsaturated substrates (especially in aqueous medium) are of value for catalysis development, but are less known. It is of interest to conduct a systematic study on reactivity of hydride complexes of earth abundant metals with unsaturated substrates such as alkynes and alkenes.

16310320.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16310320.value: Deuterated organic compounds are highly useful for numerous applications, including as internal standards for mass spectrometry, as agents for elucidating mechanisms of organic reactions and biosynthetic pathways and as deuterated drugs with improved therapeutic profiles. Selective deuteration of alkenes is of special interest, as C=C double bonds are among the most fundamental and ubiquitous substructures of many useful organic molecules, and as alkenes are universally useful synthetic starting materials. Direct deuteration of alkenes by hydrogen isotope exchange reactions of alkenes with D2O is highly desirable, as D2O is the least expensive deuterium source that can be handled easily. In this work, we have developed several efficient catalysts for deuteration alkenes. For example, we found an osmium system that shows high selectivity for deuteration at terminal alkenes and can catalyze H/D exchange reactions of alkenes without isomerization, and induces selective H/D exchange at the methine carbon (=CHR) over the methylidene carbon (=CH2) for substrates RCH=CH2 with a bulky substituent R. The catalysts are potentially useful for making deuterium-labeled drugs.

16310420.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310420.value: Gauge fields have great importance in modern physics. First verified by the famous Aharonov-Bohm effect [1], exploration of the physical consequences of gauge ﬁelds has attracted extensive attention, both in theory and in experiments. Thus far, researchers have realized artificial gauge fields in a wide range of physical systems, including condensed matter, ultracold gases, photonic crystals, acoustic crystals, and mechanical setups [2]. Very recently, the interplay between artificial gauge fields and topological physics has appeared to greatly promote the discovery of many novel topological phenomena, such as the zeroth chiral Landau level, in which a pseudo-magnetic field is applied onto Weyl/Dirac semimetals by introducing external strains into the materials lattice [3-7]. Weyl/Dirac semimetals, characterized by the crossing of two/four linear dispersion bands known as Weyl/Dirac points in three dimensions, support relativistic quasiparticles that inherit intriguing properties from high-energy physics [8-19]. To date, the characterization of these semimetal phases has led to great success in homogenous/periodic systems through either near-field scanning or angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy (ARPES). The introduction of artificial gauge fields into topological phases will bring stirring differences that still require in-depth exploration in both quantum and classical systems. The proposed project will explore the peculiar topological consequences and observables induced by artificial gauge fields in electromagnetic systems. Capitalizing on the design flexibility and tunability of metamaterials [20], which are arrays of artificially designed man-made structures, we will aim to bring various artificial gauge fields and pseudo magnetic field into topological photonics. The proposed system will work on the parameter space, including both momentum and real spaces. In addition to the chiral zeroth Landau levels, other elusive phenomena, including quantum oscillation [21], the wormhole effect [22], one-way fibers [23] and other effects that arise from non-abelian gauge fields [24], will be realized in photonic metamaterial systems. By introducing pseudo-electric field (i.e., spatial-dependent frequency responses), three dimensional chiral anomalies could also be designed [19]. As the microwave metamaterials can be precisely fabricated with printing circuit board (PCB) technology [18], each of our proposals will be experimentally demonstrated in reality. The distributions of the density of states could be mapped out experimentally with the near-field scanning setups. Compared with those condensed matter systems, our setups will provide a more flexible platform for inhomogeneous topological phase research. Furthermore, because the artificial gauge fields and pseudo-magnetic fields can control the charge-neutral particles or wave-packets, potential applications in photonic/acoustic wave manipulation and communications will be simulated. 规范场的概念在现代物理学中非常重要。最初由著名的Aharonov-Bohm效应验证，对规范场引起的物理结果的探索在理论和实验上都引起了广泛的关注。到目前为止，研究人员已经在多种多样的物理系统中实现了人工规范场，包括凝聚态，超冷气体，光子晶体，声子晶体以及机械体系等。最近，人工规范场与拓扑物理学之间的相互作用极大地促进了许多新型拓扑现象的发现，例如零级手性朗道能级，这是通过在外尓/狄拉克半金属中加入应力，产生等效的磁场实现的。外尓/狄拉克半金属在三维空间有两个/四个线性色散能带相交成的简并点，即外尓/狄拉克点，它们继承了高能物理学中相对论准粒子引人入胜的特性。迄今为止，这些半金属相的表征已通过近场扫描或角度分辨光发射光谱法，在均匀/周期性系统中取得了巨大成功。将人工规范场引入拓扑象将带来令人兴奋的物理新现象，这些仍然需要在量子和经典系统中进行深入探索。本项目将一超材料为研究平台，探索以及实验观测电磁系统中人工规范场引起的特殊拓扑现象。 超材料是人工设计的结构阵列，我们的目标是利用超材料的设计灵活性和可调谐性，将多种形式的人工规范场和赝磁场引入拓扑光子学中。项目将研究包括动量空间和实际空间在内的多个参数空间。除了手性零朗道能级之外，我们将在拓扑超材料中研究大量其他有趣的现象，包括量子振荡，虫洞效应，单向传输的光纤，以及非阿贝尔规范场所产生的其他效应。通过引入赝电场（即与空间相关的频率响应），还可以设计三维手性异常。 由于微波超材料可以使用印刷电路板技术精确地制造，因此我们的每项研究都将进行实验演示。拓扑超材料态密度的分布可以在实验上通过近场扫描绘制出来。与凝聚态系统相比，超材料将为非均质的拓扑象研究提供更灵活的平台。此外，由于人工规范场和赝磁场可以控制中性粒子或波包，因此我们将模拟光子/声波操纵在通信中的潜在应用。

16310420.label: Realisation of objectives
16310420.value: Objective 1: Chiral zeroth Landau levels are topologically protected bulk states. In particle physics and condensed matter physics, the chiral zeroth Landau level plays a significant role in breaking chiral symmetry and gives rise to the chiral anomaly. Experimental works on such chiral Landau levels are usually based on three-dimensional Weyl degeneracies coupled with axial magnetic fields. Their realizations using synthetic gauge fields are more promising for applications. Here we propose a scheme for realizing chiral Landau levels in a photonic system. By introducing an inhomogeneous effective mass through breaking local parity-inversion symmetries, a synthetic in-plane magnetic field is generated. Consequently, the zeroth-order chiral Landau levels can be induced, and the one-way propagation characteristics are experimentally observed. In addition, the robust transport of the chiral zeroth mode against defects in the system is also experimentally tested. Our system provides a new pathway for the realization of chiral Landau levels using pseudo-magnetic fields. [Results published in Light: Science & Applications 12, 165 (2023)]. Twisted metamaterial with chiral character can produce Berry curvature, which is a kind of pseudo-magnetic field as it is the counterpart of the magnetic field in the k- space. In 3D systems, much attention has been paid to Weyl points, which serve as sources and drains of Berry curvature. Berry curvature usually originates from Weyl points, which acts as source/sinks (magnetic monopole) in k-space. Here, we demonstrate a toroidal moment of Berry curvature, which exhibits a vortex-like configuration without any source and drain in the momentum space. Experimentally, the presence of Berry curvature toroid is confirmed by the observation of conical-frustum shaped domain-wall states at the interfaces formed by two metamaterials with opposite toroidal moments. [Results published in Nature Communications 12,1784 (2021).] We also considered metacrystals that are protected by an unusual roto-inversion time (roto-PT) symmetry. They carry nodal lines that appear as quadrupole sources of Berry curvature flux (pseudo B field in k-space) in contrast to the monopolar Weyl points, which are monopoles. Interestingly, topological surface states exist at all cutting surfaces, as guaranteed by π-quantized Zak phases along all three directions. As frequency changes, the surface state equifrequency contours evolve from closed to open and become straight lines at a critical transition frequency, at which diffractionless surface wave propagations are experimentally demonstrated, paving the way toward development of superimaging topological devices. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 129, 043602 (2022)] Objective 2: The gist of this objective is to show the relationship between artificial gauge field and relativity. We showed that torsion induced gauge field can be considered as an spatially dependent effective mass, and can induced quantum-like effect in photonic systems [Light: Science & Applications 12, 165 (2023)]. A Weyl particle is a hypothetical elementary particle arises within the framework of relativistic quantum field theory. With photonic crystals that structurally provide synthetic gauge fields, we can realize various types Weyl points (including spin-1 Weyl nodes) in momentum space [Nature Materials 22, 1203 (2023)]. We demonstrated that certain meta-systems can be described using relativity language. In relativity, the curvature of spacetime is described by the metric tensor. We showed that Riemannian geometry of evolution of eigenstates can be observed in some non-Hermitian systems (realized experimentally using circuits), in which the effective Hamiltonian carries certain operator that plays a role similar to the Minkowski metric in general relativity and can induce Lorentz boost transformations, leading to frame rotation and frame deformation (due to non-Hermiticity). Frame deformations of eigenstates along paths in k-space are observed. We also found the unexpected existence of topological edge states in 1D lattice models protected by the intersection singularities. In addition, these systems feature surfaces of exceptional points that host stable embedded intersection singularities in momentum space. [Communications Physics 6, 293 (2023)]. We used PT symmetric photonic systems to demonstrate the photonic Γ point serves as the source of a frame charge flow in momentum space. This source naturally generates non-Abelian topological signatures in PT-symmetric photonic systems. We use biaxial photonic crystals as examples to show how complex nodal line configurations can be explained as the topological consequences of the frame charge flow. [Physical Review X 13, 021024 (2023).] We also clarified the rule that governs the “frame flow” of the non-Abelian charges that originates from the photonic Γ point. We designed and fabricated a metamaterial, with which the multiple nodal links and the topological connection between nonadjacent nodal lines are experimentally demonstrated [Physical Review Letters 129, 263604 (2022)]. In addition, we designed chiral photonic crystals which carries an intrinsic degeneracy carries ±2 chiral topological charge while having linear band dispersions, different from the general perception of charge-2 nodes being associated with quadratic dispersions. We showed that these topological characters originate from the spin-1Weyl point at zero frequency node of triple degeneracy [Physical Review Letters 130, 203802 (2023)]. Objective 3: 1D systems with non-Abelian topological characteristics are realized using the high dimensions manifested as compactified dimensions. These fibre bundle systems have 1D transport but they have eigenmodes that performs quantized frame rotations in 3D/4D space. The network has internal (coiled dimensions) degree of freedom that allows for twisted/braided coupling between nodes, which is essential for the non-Abelian character. These systems go beyond the usual topological systems in which the underlying global invariant is usually well characterized by integers, such as Chern numbers or winding numbers which are Abelian charges. We experimentally observe the non-Abelian topological charges in a time-reversal and inversion-symmetric network. In 3 band systems, the quaternion-valued non-Abelian topological charges (3D rotations) are clearly mapped onto an eigenstate-frame sphere. Moreover, we find a non-Abelian quotient relation that provides a global perspective on the distribution of edge/domain-wall states. We found a system with an even or odd number of bands will exhibit a significant difference in non-Abelian topological classification. We illustrate their difference in the 4D rotation sense on the stereographically projected Clifford tori. [Nature 594, 195 (2021); Nature Communications 12, 6471 (2021)]. We also discovered that some special boundary conditions imposed on Dirac cone systems are mathematically equivalent to the imposition of a pseudo-gauge field, leading to robust one way transport in 1D systems. The concept is experimentally demonstrated in an acoustic system and can also be generalized to electromagnetic waves [Nature Communications 13, 5916 (2022)]. The non-Abelian topology concepts can also be applied to describe admissible nodal line configurations in three dimensions. We proposed and demonstrated a photonic crystal where all chained nodal lines coexist in a single mirror plane and the chain point is stabilized by the intrinsic symmetry that is specific to electromagnetic waves at the Г point of zero frequency. By adding another mirror plane, we find a nodal ring that is constructed by two higher bands and links with the in-plane nodal chain. The nodal link in momentum space exhibits non-Abelian characteristics on a C2T - invariant plane, where admissible transitions of the nodal link structure are determined by generalized quaternion charges [ Light: Science & Applications 10, 83 (2021)].

16310420.label: Major findings and research outcome
16310420.value: The objective of this project is to demonstrate artificial gauge fields in photonic topological metamaterials. We have discovered several methods to achieve this goal. For instance, we can apply strain that varies with position to a photonic crystal, which can be interpreted as a synthetic gauge field. We have successfully demonstrated this by using a photonic crystal that carries Dirac cone dispersions, resulting in the observation of chiral zeroth Landau levels. In 3D systems, synthetic gauge fields can be realized using twisted or braiding structures or structures with chiral characteristics within the unit cell. In such systems, a wave with a well-defined k-vector passing through the crystal can sense the chirality. The absence of inversion symmetry in some of these systems can lead to Berry curvature in momentum space, analogous to a magnetic field in momentum space. In k-space, objects called Weyl points act as sources of k-space magnetic fields. We have published a couple of papers illustrating these concepts. Some aspects of this physics can be related to the theory of relativistic physics. Weyl particles actually arise within the framework of relativistic quantum field theory. By utilizing photonic crystals that provide synthetic gauge fields structurally, we can realize various types of Weyl points, including spin-1 Weyl nodes. the curvature of spacetime is described by the metric tensor. We have shown that the Riemannian geometry of the evolution of eigenstates can be observed in certain non-Hermitian systems. In these systems, the effective Hamiltonian contains an operator that plays a role similar to the Minkowski metric and can induce Lorentz boost transformations. The "twisting" effect can also be realized using hidden dimensions. In quasi 1D systems with hidden internal degrees of freedom, we can achieve non-Abelian topological characteristics by using "twisting connectivity" in the curled dimension. The correspondence between the bulk and boundary of such systems differs from that of usual Abelian systems. Additionally, we have discovered that in certain photonic crystal waveguides, specific boundary conditions can result in chiral transport. This is particularly interesting because structural chirality is not a requirement in such cases. The ability of certain boundary conditions to achieve the same dispersion as a valley-Hall state introduces a valuable new concept. It is important to emphasize that our ideas are not solely theoretical or mathematical. In many instances, we have fabricated real samples and experimentally measured the dispersion and demonstrated various phenomena.

16310420.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16310420.value: This project primarily focuses on achieving the realization of synthetic gauge fields. We have successfully accomplished this objective by employing various approaches. To validate the feasibility of our ideas, we conducted experiments using microwave frequencies, as our laboratory is equipped specifically for such measurements. Unfortunately, we currently lack the necessary equipment to operate at higher frequencies. The logical next step in our research is to investigate the scalability of our concepts to higher frequency regimes, such as THz, IR, and optical frequencies. Some of our strategies, such as utilizing the concept of spatially varying effective mass, should be readily applicable to higher frequencies. The fabrication techniques for nano-scale layer-by-layer structures have reached maturity, making them feasible for implementation. However, certain approaches we have explored involve twisting or braiding structures in a three-dimensional sense. These structures may not be compatible with standard nano-fabrication technologies, necessitating modifications to ensure compatibility. Additionally, the lack of high-frequency equipment in our laboratory poses a challenge. To overcome this limitation, we need to collaborate with other research groups possessing the necessary equipment and expertise to conduct experiments at higher frequencies.

16310420.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16310420.value: This project focuses on the realization of synthetic gauge fields. We have accomplished this objective through various approaches. Our work extends beyond theoretical frameworks, as we have conducted experiments to demonstrate the feasibility of our ideas. Synthetic gauge fields have emerged as a powerful tool due to their ability to mimic the effects of real magnetic fields. While real magnetic fields traditionally require the presence of charged particles or currents, synthetic gauge fields do not require actual magnetic fields. Instead, they are created through tailored photonic structures and interactions. One of the key benefits of synthetic gauge field is the enhanced controllability and tunability they provide. This flexibility allows for the creation of novel functionalities and tailored properties that are not readily achievable with real magnetic fields. We have demonstrated that topological metamaterials, which are materials with designed subwavelength architectures that exhibit topological properties, offer an ideal platform for manifesting synthetic gauge fields in photonics. By introducing tailored geometric structures, topological metamaterials can effectively emulate the behavior of gauge fields and enable the manipulation of light in fascinating ways.

16310520.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310520.value: A monolayer graphene is formed by an atomic layer of carbon atoms arranged in a honeycomb-like lattice. Other than being chemically stable, mechanically strong and highly conducting, the electrons in graphene have the exotic property that they behave as massless particles and exhibit a wide range of interesting electrical and optical properties. After fifteen years of intense experimental and theoretical studies, many believe that the fundamental properties of graphene are well understood. Surprisingly, it was realized recently that by twisting a graphene bilayer with a small twisting angle, the electronic properties of the material can be dramatically changed. The misalignment of the atoms caused by twisting can dramatically enlarge the unit cell and a Moire superlattice is formed. Moreover, the Moire potential reduces the Fermi velocity of the bands. As a result, two nearly flat bands are created near some special angles of twisting. Due to the flatness of the bands, electron-electron correlations become important and correlation-driven phases such as the Mott insulating phase and the superconducting phase were observed last year. Earlier this year, the topological properties of twisted bilayer graphene (TBG) were investigated. It was shown experimentally that TBG can be ferromagnetic and exhibit quantized Hall conductance. Importantly, it was shown that an exceedingly small current in the order of tens of nA was sufficient to switch the direction of magnetization of TBG. This opens a way for ultra-low power magnetic memory devices. However, the mechanism behind the current-induced magnetization is not yet well understood. Recently, we proposed that the large orbital magnetization generated by the Berry curvature of the bands and the charge current are responsible for the magnetization switching. Our study also pointed out that strain is essential in controlling the properties of the Moire superlattices. Importantly, we realised that the current-induced magnetization can appear in several recently discovered two-dimensional materials with Moire superlattices such as trilayer graphene/hexogonal boron nitride heterostructure (TLG/hBN), and twisted transition metal dichalcogenides. Therefore, this proposal is focused on studying the magnetoelectric effect (the current-induced magnetization effect or the Edelstein effect) of these materials. Moreover, we would like to generalize the study to the supercurrent-induced magnetization in superconducting Moire superlattices. This research direction has not been explored previously. Our study will significantly advance the understanding of the symmetry and band topology dictated magnetoelectric effect in Moire superlattices and their applications in electronic devices. 單層石墨烯是由碳原子組成的蜂窩狀晶格構成的。除了化學性質穩定，機械操縱性強和高導電性之外，石墨烯中的電子還具有奇異的性質，即它們表現爲無質量的粒子，並呈現出各式各樣有趣的電學和光學性質。經過十五年深入的實驗和理論研究，許多人認爲石墨烯的基礎特性已經得到充分的理解。 令人驚訝的是，直到最近人們才意識到，通過很小的轉角扭轉雙層石墨烯會使該材料的電子性質發生戲劇性的變化。由扭轉引起的原子錯位可以使晶格元胞顯著增大，形成摩爾超晶格。此外，摩爾勢場降低了電子能帶的費米速度。因此，在一些特殊的轉角附近產生了兩個近乎平整的帶。由於能帶的平整性，電子-電子關聯變得至關重要，去年在實驗上就觀察到了諸如莫特絕緣相和超導相這類由電子關聯驅動的相. 今年早些時候，有實驗研究了轉角雙層石墨烯(TBG)的拓撲性質。實驗結果表明，TBG具有鐵磁性，並顯示出量子化的霍爾電導。重要的是，數十納安培量級的極小電流就可以反轉TBG的磁化方向。這爲超低功率磁存儲設備開闢了一條新的途徑。然而，電流誘發磁性這一現象背後的物理機制還沒有得到充分的理解。最近，我們提出了由能帶貝里曲率和注入電流所產生的巨大軌道磁化率是引起磁性反轉的原因。我們的研究還指出，應變在控制摩爾超晶格的性質中起着至關重要的作用。 更重要的是，我們意識到電流誘導磁性可以出現在最近發現的幾種具有摩爾紋超晶格的二維材料中，如三層石墨烯/六方氮化硼異質結構(TLG/hBN)和轉角過渡金屬二硫屬化物。因此，本提案將重點研究這些材料的磁電效應(電流誘導磁性效應或Edelstein效應)。此外，我們希望將研究推廣到超導摩爾超晶格中由超電流誘發的磁性。該研究方向先前尚未被探索過。 我們的研究將極大地促進對摩爾超晶格中取決於對稱性和能帶拓撲的磁電效應及其在電子器件應用方面的理解。

16310520.label: Realisation of objectives
16310520.value: The main purpose of this proposal is to study the current induced orbital magnetisation, namely, the magnetoelectric effect in graphene- and transition metal dichalcogenide-based materials. The orbital magnetisation is induced by the Berry curvature of the bands. Moreover, the magneto-electric effect is closely related to the superconducting diode effect as the magneto-electric effect serves as one of the possible origin of the superconducting diode effect. Therefore, with the support of this GRF grant, we studied several superconducting and non-superconducting phenomena related to the magneto-electric effect in graphene and transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs). 1. Valley Polarized Quantum Anomalous Hall State in Moiré MoTe2/WSe2 Heterobilayers Ying-Ming Xie, Cheng-Ping Zhang, Jin-Xin Hu, Kin Fai Mak, K. T. Law*, Phys. Rev. Lett. 128, 026402 (2022). In this work, we studied the Berry curvature and the origin of topological bands in MoTe2/WSe2 heterobilayers. With strain, the material will exhibit magneto electric effect and possible current induced magnetisation switching. The MoTe2/WSe2 are important TMD materials for the study of topological and superconducting phenomena. Both MoTe2 and WSe2 have 2H structure. This work is directly related to Objective 2. 2. Valley Polarization Induced Josephson Diode Effect in Twisted Bilayer Graphene Jin-Xin Hu, Zi-Ting Sun, Ying-Ming Xie, K. T. Law*, Phys. Rev. Lett. 130, 266003 (2023). In this work, we study the origin of Josephson diode effect. The origin of the superconducting diode effect is closely related to the magnetoelectric effect as the magnetoelectric effect may serve as an origin of the Josephson diode effect. This work is directly related to Objective 1 and Objective 3. 3. Symmetry-broken Josephson junctions and superconducting diodes in magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene J Díez-Mérida, A Díez-Carlón, SY Yang, Y-M Xie, X-J Gao, J Senior, K Watanabe, T Taniguchi, X Lu, AP Higginbotham, KT Law, Dmitri K Efetov*, Nature Communications 14: 2396 (2023). In this collaboration with experimentalists, we studied the Josephson diode effect in twisted bilayer graphene. As mentioned above, the superconducting diode effect is closely related to the superconducting magneto-electric effect. This work is directly related to Objective 1 and Objective 3. 4. Orbital Fulde-Ferrell pairing state in moiré Ising superconductors Yingming Xie and K. T. Law*, Phys. Rev. Lett. 131, 016001 (2023). In this work, we predicted the superconducting diode effect and twisted bilayer WSe2. This work is directly related to Objective 3. In summary, all of the three objectives of the proposal had been realised.

16310520.value: Orbital magnetoelectric effect is a very interesting phenomena that a current, without going through circular motions, can induce magnetisation. The magnetisation is induced by the self-rotation of the Bloch wavefunction of a material. In this project, we studied various phenomena related to the magentoelectric effect in graphene-based and transition metal dichalcogenide based materials. In particular, we studied the superconducting diode effect which is closely related to magneto-electric effects.

16310620.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16310620.value: A tensor is a container which can house data in multi-dimensions. The study of tensors has gained significant attention in the era of big data, and tensor data analysis plays an important role in many in real-world applications such as data analysis, machine learning, dimension reduction, and signal processing. Many tensor data analysis tasks are eventually solved by optimization algorithms, among which non-convex approaches have many advantages over convex ones. For example, they often use less memory, especially for large-scale tensor problems. In the proposed project, we study non-convex optimization approaches for tensor data analysis. Under different low-rank tensor models, we investigate non-convex optimization approaches for tensor recovery (including tensor completion) and tensor robust principal component analysis. The low-rank models under our consideration include low Tucker-rank, low tubal rank, and low tensor-train rank. For all these tensor data analysis tasks, we will propose efficient non-convex algorithms, as well as prove their theoretical guarantee of convergence to the global minimum. 張量是描述多維數據的一種數據結構。張量的研究在大數據時代引起了廣泛的關注。張量數據分析在許多實際應用中扮演著重要的角色，例如數據分析，機器學習，降維和信號處理。許多張量數據分析任務都是通過優化算法最終解決的。其中非凸方法比凸方法具有很多優勢。例如，非凸方法通常使用較少的內存，尤其是對於大規模張量問題。在擬議的項目中，我們研究用於張量數據分析的非凸優化方法。在不同的張量低秩模型下，我們研究用於張量恢復（包括張量補全）和張量魯棒主成分分析的非凸優化方法。我們考慮的低秩模型包括張量多線性低秩，張量管低秩和張量列低秩。對於所有這些張量數據分析任務，我們將提出有效的非凸算法，並證明其收斂到全局最小值的理論。

16310620.label: Realisation of objectives
16310620.value: The project set out to advance non-convex optimization methods for tensor data analysis through two main objectives: (1) developing tensor recovery algorithms and (2) studying tensor robust principal component analysis (RPCA). Both objectives were substantially achieved, with several significant theoretical and practical advances documented across the published works. Objective 1: Non-convex Algorithms for Tensor Recovery This objective was largely achieved across all four sub-objectives: i) Construction of optimal sampling complexity algorithms: -Fully achieved through Paper [1]'s generalized framework combining Riemannian optimization with gradient pruning -Demonstrated linear convergence and sharp statistical error bounds -Validated on real-world applications showing practical effectiveness ii) Non-convex tensor completion: -Successfully addressed through Paper [2]'s breakthrough theoretical analysis of Riemannian gradient descent -Achieved near-optimal sample complexity -Introduced novel initialization method improving computational efficiency iii) Tensor-train rank models: -Fully realized in Paper [2] providing first theoretical guarantees for tensor-train format completion -Demonstrated linear convergence with constant contraction rate -Improved upon existing sample complexity bounds iv) Low-tubal-rank models: -Addressed through Paper [5]'s work on Hankel matrix completion for multi-dimensional signals. -Demonstrated linear convergence and superior empirical performance Objective 2: Non-convex Algorithms for Tensor RPCA Both sub-objectives were substantially achieved: i) Construction of efficient algorithms: -Successfully addressed through Paper [1]'s generalized framework -Extended to handle both sub-Gaussian and heavy-tailed noise -Demonstrated superior computational efficiency compared to existing methods ii) Theoretical guarantees: -Comprehensively achieved through Papers [1] and [3] -Established statistical optimality under various noise models -Provided novel two-phase convergence analysis Achievements Beyond Original Objectives The project yielded several additional contributions beyond the initial objectives: 1. Computational efficiency advances: -Developed fast projected Newton-like methods for structured estimation -Improved sample complexity bounds in reinforcement learning -Advanced interlacing polynomial techniques for matrix subset selection 2. Theoretical innovations: -Novel analysis frameworks combining Riemannian optimization with gradient pruning -Two-phase convergence analysis for non-smooth optimization -Improved spectral norm bounds for matrix column subset selection problems Further investigation While objectives were fully realized, some aspects warrant further investigation: 1. Unified framework: -While multiple tensor formats were studied, a unified treatment across all formats remains open -This reflects the inherent challenge of bridging different tensor decomposition approaches Overcoming Challenges Several strategies were employed to address challenges: 1. Theoretical complexity: -Developed novel analysis techniques combining Riemannian optimization with gradient pruning -Introduced sequential second-order moment methods for initialization 2. Computational efficiency: -Leveraged structured optimization to reduce computational complexity -Developed efficient implementations validated on real-world datasets 3. Heavy-tailed noise: -Successfully extended methods to handle non-Gaussian noise -Developed two-phase convergence analysis for robust estimation In conclusion, the project substantially achieved its primary objectives while making additional contributions to the field. The project's success is evidenced by the publication of 5 journal papers and 2 conference papers, each making significant theoretical and practical contributions to tensor optimization.

16310620.label: Major findings and research outcome
16310620.value: Below are the key findings and research outcomes of the project, structured according to the published papers and their contributions to the project's objectives. 1. Non-Convex Algorithms for Tensor Recovery Objective (i-iv): Develop and analyze non-convex tensor recovery algorithms with optimal sampling complexity under various low-rank models. Paper [1] introduces a generalized low-rank plus sparse tensor estimation framework, integrating Riemannian optimization and gradient pruning. It achieves linear convergence and sharp statistical error bounds under sub-Gaussian and heavy-tailed noise, addressing Objective (i-iii). The method is validated on real-world datasets, demonstrating robustness in tensor decomposition. Paper [2] provides the first theoretical guarantees for Riemannian gradient descent in tensor-train (TT) format completion, fulfilling Objective (iii). The algorithm attains linear convergence with near-optimal sample complexity, significantly improving prior work. A novel warm-start initialization via sequential second-order moments further enhances efficiency. Paper [5] focuses on robust Hankel matrix completion, proposing a Hankel-structured gradient descent (HSGD) method. This work aligns with Objective (iv) by exploiting structural properties for efficient recovery, achieving linear convergence and superior empirical performance. 2. Non-Convex Algorithms for Tensor Robust PCA (RPCA) Objective (i-ii): Develop efficient non-convex tensor RPCA methods with theoretical guarantees. Paper [1] also contributes to tensor RPCA by estimating low-rank + sparse tensors in generalized models, addressing Objective (i). Its statistical guarantees extend to robust PCA and heavy-tailed noise, fulfilling Objective (ii). Paper [3] tackles high-dimensional robust regression, proposing a projected subgradient descent method that achieves statistically optimal rates under heavy-tailed noise. While focused on matrices, its framework informs tensor RPCA (Objective (ii) by demonstrating two-phase convergence: sublinear (nonsmooth) followed by linear (smooth-like) convergence. 3. Computational Efficiency and Structured Optimization Paper [4] introduces an interlacing polynomial method for column subset selection, improving spectral norm bounds. Though not directly tied to tensors, its techniques may inspire future tensor sampling strategies. Conference paper [1] proposes a fast projected Newton-like method for precision matrix estimation under total positivity, advancing structured non-convex optimization. This aligns with the project’s broader theme of efficient non-convex algorithms. Conference paper [2] develops reinforcement learning in Markov games with independent function approximation, improving sample complexity. While outside tensor recovery, its optimization insights may extend to stochastic tensor methods. The project successfully advanced non-convex tensor recovery and RPCA, delivering theoretically sound, computationally efficient algorithms with optimal sampling complexity under various low-rank models (Papers [1–5]). Key innovations include Riemannian optimization, structured gradient descent, and two-phase convergence analysis, bridging theory and practice. Future work may extend these methods to broader tensor formats and stochastic settings.

16310620.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16310620.value: 1. Extensions to Other Tensor Decompositions: The current work focuses on tensor-train (TT) and tubal-rank models. Future research could explore hierarchical Tucker (HT) and block-term decompositions, which may offer better scalability for ultra-high-dimensional tensors. 2. Adaptive Sampling and Online Learning: The project assumes fixed sampling schemes. Developing adaptive sampling strategies (e.g., active learning for tensor completion) and online non-convex optimization methods could enhance real-world applicability in streaming data settings. 3. Integration with Deep Learning: Combining Riemannian optimization with deep neural networks (e.g., for tensor-based deep learning architectures) could improve representation learning in high-dimensional data. 4. Robustness to Adversarial Perturbations: While Papers [1] and [3] address heavy-tailed noise, future work could study adversarially robust tensor recovery, ensuring stability against structured corruptions. 5. Federated and Distributed Tensor Learning: Extending the algorithms to distributed and federated settings would enable large-scale collaborative tensor analysis while preserving privacy.

16310620.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16310620.value: This research develops smart math tools to uncover hidden patterns in complex, messy data—like medical scans, financial records, or social networks. Traditional methods struggle with large, imperfect datasets, but our non-convex algorithms (a type of advanced problem-solving technique) efficiently recover structured information even with missing or corrupted entries. Key breakthroughs include: - Faster, more accurate tensor recovery (think "3D data repair") with provable guarantees. - Robust outlier detection for reliable analysis despite noise. - Computationally efficient solutions that save time and resources. The tools are widely applicable—from improving MRI diagnostics to optimizing recommendation systems—and offer stronger theoretical foundations than prior approaches. By balancing speed, accuracy, and practicality, this work helps scientists and industries extract clearer insights from big, messy data.

16500320.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500320.value: 公司能否在困难时期通过积极管理现金流量的可抵押性从而扩大债务能力？这个问题涉及到企业如何获得更大的财务灵活性并减轻融资摩擦带来的负面影响的核心。 本项研究将探讨企业该如何提高标准化程度并改进未来现金流的可抵押性，以减缓信贷市场的冲击。尽管银行健康对企业投资和就业的影响已广为人知，但鲜有证据显示公司为提高其更换贷款方的能力而采取的行动。公司是否增加自愿披露，加强董事会的财务专业性，更改薪酬计划,以及获得贷款评级？ 2008-9年全球金融危机是检验异质性冲击对银行财务健康影响的理想试验。在此期间，尽管向非金融企业提供的银行贷款显著收缩，各个银行在危机中的风险敞口却相差甚远。与雷曼兄弟（Lehman Brothers）合作放贷的银行受到的打击更为严重，因为雷曼兄弟的倒闭耗尽了这些银行的流动性，迫使其客户的信贷收缩。各银行在住房抵押贷款证券，房地产贷款和存款资金方面的风险暴露也千差万别。因此，银行间财务健康状况的差异与其企业贷款组合的情况无关。该实验基于这样一个事实，即健康状况较差的银行的危机前借款人与健康状况较好的银行的危机前借款人相比，可获得的、来自其主要贷款银行的贷款显着下降。这是双重差分的实证策略，将比较贷款银行不太健康的公司与贷款银行较健康的公司之间的不同表现。 关于企业如何根据资本市场的摩擦内生地改变其现金流量的质押性的证据是全新的。信贷影响的持续时间取决于在信贷供应中断后企业能多快建立新的或者恢复旧的信贷渠道。此项研究成果将对破坏金融中介资本的冲击所造成的持续性和深度带来启示。

16500320.label: Realisation of objectives
16500320.value: As outlined in the proposal, I use the 2008-09 global financial crisis to examine whether and how firms improve the pledgeability of their cash flows to idiosyncratic shocks to the health of their lenders. I exploit the fact that banks varied greatly in their exposure to the crisis, and their health deteriorated for reasons unrelated to their corporate loan portfolio. For example, banks that had co-syndicated with Lehman Brothers were more severely affected as the collapse of Lehman drained liquidity from these banks, forcing contraction in credit to their customers. Banks also varied greatly in their exposure to mortgage-backed securities, real estate loans, and deposit funding. The experiment relies on the fact that pre-crisis borrowers of less healthy banks ("affected" firms) experienced a more significant reduction in the availability of loans from their primary lenders compared to pre-crisis borrowers of healthier banks ("unaffected" firms). I constructed several measures of bank health and used these bank health measures to identify borrowers before the crisis who had borrowed from banks that did less lending during the crisis. These borrowers had greater difficulty obtaining bank financing than firms that had borrowed from healthier lenders. Since primary bank lenders generate borrower-specific, durable, and reusable information through repeated interactions with the borrower, idiosyncratic fluctuations in bank health have significant consequences for companies. The objective of the project is to examine what changes affected borrowers make to improve the pledgeability of their cash flows to be able to switch lenders. By pledgeability, I refer to actions that firms can take to improve the transparency of their operations and to make cash flows less volatile and harder to divert by focusing on the long term. The empirical strategy is a difference-in-differences test in which I compare the responses of affected firms to those of unaffected firms. The study focuses on four specific sets of firm responses. First, I show that affected firms add substantially more directors with accounting and finance expertise to their boards and the audit committees of the board. Finance directors bring financial expertise to their management. Accounting expertise reduces the risk of adverse reporting outcomes such as restatements, SEC comment letters, and internal control deficiencies, making cash flows more pledgeable to potential new lenders. Bank directors can also overcome problems of asymmetric information, allowing firms to access new lending relationships. Second, I show that affected firms significantly increase the duration of executive compensation contracts. I estimate the pay duration as the weighted average of the vesting periods of the different components of executive pay (i.e., salary, bonus, restricted stock, and stock options), with the weight for each component determined by the fraction of that component in the executive's total compensation package. The evidence that affected firms increase the duration of executive compensation contracts is consistent with longer-duration contracts reducing incentives to take risks and to engage in accrual management to boost short-term earnings. Third, I examine managerial forecasts of earnings. Managers of affected borrowers significantly increase the horizon of their earnings forecasts relative to those provided by managers of unaffected firms. Longer horizon forecasts reduce information asymmetry and help potential new lenders form their earnings expectations early when there is little publicly available information about those earnings. In addition, I also examine the precision of earnings forecasts. The precision of forecasts depends on whether managers provide a point estimate, a range, or an open-ended forecast. Point estimates are more precise than range estimates, which are more precise than open-ended forecasts. My results show that affected firms significantly increase the precision of their managerial forecasts, consistent with an attempt to improve the pledgeability of cash flows in response to a decline in the health of their lead lender. Finally, I examine how the readability of financial statements changes for affected and unaffected firms around the crisis. If greater financial statement complexity increases adverse selection and makes it harder to obtain financing from new lenders, then affected firms should improve the readability of their financial statements. The complexity of financial statements imposes information processing costs on potential credit providers who do not have the benefit of a relationship with the borrower. My results show a significantly larger improvement in readability in the post-crisis period. I construct six different measures of readability of firms' disclosures by applying text analysis to 10-K filings of firms. All six measures of readability yield consistent evidence and suggest that affected firms significantly reduce the complexity of their financial statements after the crisis relative to before and relative to the change for unaffected firms. The second objective was to examine treatment heterogeneity by exploiting sub-samples of firms to examine if the effects are larger for a subset of firms than others. I explore two dimensions on which affected firms differed: firm size and whether firms have a loan rating. Smaller firms are expected to be more constrained, so the theory predicts that small firms should respond more strongly to a decline in their lender health compared to large firms. Similarly, firms that have loan ratings are likely to be less constrained compared to unrated firms. The results provide some support for these predictions. When examining firm size, I find that often, both small and large firms responded to a decline in their lender health. In many cases, and consistent with theoretical predictions, the response to declining lender health was stronger for small firms than for small firms. The tests using cross-sectional differences in loan ratings yield similar conclusions. The third objective was to examine the speed of response to credit shocks. I exploit the dynamic nature of the data to create event-time dummy variables for the [-3, +3] window where year 0 represents the year of the crisis. Then, to assess the speed of affected firms' responses, I re-estimate the baseline model with "Affected" firm dummy interacted with dynamic indicators over time relative to the crisis. The estimated regression coefficients confirm that the affected and unaffected firms evolved similarly prior to the crisis, as the pre-crisis coefficients are nearly zero, supporting the assumption of parallel trends assumption. Importantly, I find that affected firms quickly respond to a decline in their lender health when it comes to changing board composition to include directors with financial expertise on their boards and audit committees. Affected firms took longer to change executive compensation contracts and the horizon and precision of their voluntary disclosures. Furthermore, affected firms were also quick to reduce the complexity of their financial statements. Policymakers and regulators are increasingly concerned that idiosyncratic shocks to bank health could transmit to the real sector as banks cut back on lending and borrowers are not able to switch to alternative lenders. Several prominent academics consider the destruction of financial intermediary capital as a critical contributor to the depth and severity of recessions that follow financial crises. The study contributes to our understanding of how firms actively manage their ability to borrow against future cash flows by making these flows more pledgeable to creditors. It provides novel evidence of the flexibility that firms have in altering their ability to access external finance. Note on research staff expenditures: These expenditures were larger than budgeted because we analyzed a large number of databases.

16500320.label: Major findings and research outcome
16500320.value: The study examines how firms overcome credit market frictions when their lenders suffer a decline in their health. Focusing on the 2009-09 global financial crisis, I compare the responses of firms that had borrowed before the crisis from banks that did less lending during the crisis (affected firms) with those of firms that had borrowed from healthier lenders (unaffected firms). I show that following the crisis, affected firms significantly increased the presence of accounting and finance experts on boards and their audit committees relative to those on the boards of unaffected firms. Affected firms also modified executive compensation contracts, extending the duration of executive pay both for the CEO and for other senior executives. In addition, affected firms changed the nature of their voluntary disclosures by lengthening the horizon of their earnings forecasts. Managerial forecasts of earnings also became more precise for affected firms than for unaffected firms after the crisis. Finally, the results show that firms reduced the complexity of their financial statements. Their 10-K statements became significantly more readable than those of unaffected firms after the crisis. Additional tests show that affected firms responded quickly, making changes to their boards, compensation contracts, and disclosures within one to two years after the onset of the crisis. The firm responses documented in the study are consistent with affected firms improving the pledgeability of their cash flows to be able to obtain additional outside debt financing. The results show that even though bank-borrower relationships are sticky in the short term, firms could alter these relationships by improving the pledgeability of their cash flows.

16500320.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16500320.value: First, the cross-sectional heterogeneity in the responses of affected firms is understudied. Some results, particularly concerning the readability of financial statements, suggest that larger and rated firms responded more strongly to a decline in their lender health during the crisis than smaller or unrated firms. These results are intriguing and require an understanding of the determinants of the costs of improving the pledgeability of cash flows, which likely would have been greater for smaller, unrated firms. I will conduct additional tests to understand why some firms have less flexibility to respond to crises and others more. Second, additional evidence is needed to determine whether the changes that firms made were temporary or permanent. This requires a longer-term analysis that examines whether the policy changes by affected firms immediately following the crisis lasted many years after when financing conditions were more normal. Third, the study would benefit from a more granular analysis of which banks provided financing to affected firms during the crisis. More tests on how loan syndicates changed for affected firms following the crisis would be informative.

16500320.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16500320.value: The study examines whether and how firms recover from idiosyncratic shocks to the health of their lenders. The results show that affected firms make specific changes to their boards, the duration of compensation to top executives, and firm disclosures. Affected firms add new finance and accounting experts to their board of directors and the audit committee of the board. Their presence on board audit committees has the potential to reduce the risk of restatements and internal control deficiencies. Second, affected firms lengthen the pay duration of executive compensation contracts, influencing managerial behavior to shift away from managing short-term earnings and instead focus on long-term projects. Third, I show that firms provide long-horizon forecasts and increase the precision of their forecasts to improve their information environment. Finally, I show that firms reduce the complexity of their financial statements and make financial reports more readable. Overall, my results suggest that the dislocations that firms experience during a crisis will be short-lived since firms can quickly respond to the destruction of financial intermediary capital by increasing accounting and financial expertise on their boards, changing executive compensation contracts, and improving their financial disclosures.

16500520.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500520.value: 大多數拍賣平台會同時列出許多相似甚至相同的物品。由於時間衝突和預付款要求，買家往往只能參加少數的拍賣。現有的拍賣設計研究大多專注於尋找銷售單個商品的最佳機制，但忽略了同時拍賣許多可替代物品的情況，以及其對買家參與度的影響。眾所周知，與設置最優保留價或選擇最優拍賣形式相比，通常會吸引更多的買家更利於賣家的收益最大化（Bulow and Klemperer，1996）。因此，拍賣平台認真考慮和利用拍賣之間競爭關係以實現收益最大化。 使用eBay汽車銷售數據，Newberry（2015）發現每增加一個相似物品的拍賣，所有商品的平均價格將降低6％。但是淘寶司法拍賣平台上汽車銷售數據卻顯示出相反的結果。我們發現同時拍賣更多的物品會導致銷售價格上漲。這是因為更大的拍賣群組會吸引更多的買家。因此，為了使總收入最大化，拍賣平台不應獨立對待單個拍賣，而應該仔細考慮拍賣與吸引買家進入之間的關係。 我們提出了一個結構性分析框架來分析競爭性拍賣與買家的進入。在模型中，多個可替代物品同時拍賣，而每個買家則選擇進入其中一個拍賣。給定一組固定的買家，項目之間的競爭會壓低價格。但是，具有不同偏好的潛在買家更喜歡大型拍賣群組，因此產生的進入效應會導致更多出價和更高價格。淘寶平台上觀察到的情況正是因為這種進入效應。 拍賣平台的最佳項目列表策略取決於這兩個效應的相互作用。我們的結構性分析對競爭性拍賣進行識別和程序，可用於對競爭效應和進入效應的量化分析。基於結構性估計結果，我們計劃展示拍賣平台如何通過更好的拍賣物品編排來增加總收入。

16500520.label: Major findings and research outcome
16500520.value: 1. We develop a theoretical model of competing auctions with three stages that can capture the competition effect and the entry effect. 2. We empirically study competing auctions using data from the Taobao judicial auction platform and find reduced-form evidence for the competition effect and the entry effect. 3. We propose a structural estimation framework that allows the auction platform to estimate model primitives and evaluate the competition effect and entry effect. 4. We demonstrate that increasing the auction group size based on the structural estimation result can significantly increase the average price of auctions over the case of optimal individual auctions.

16500520.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
16500520.value: In addition to the auction group size, auction platforms can also use other tools to further optimize the performance of competing auctions. First, the platform can adjust the reservation price $r$. It can also use the deposit requirement and auction duration to affect the entry decisions of potential bidders. Second, the platform can adjust the composition of items. In principle, the platform should list differentiated items in the same auction group and avoid listing identical items together. This will enlarge the entry effect and reduce the competition across similar items. Moreover, auction platforms also need to consider seller-side participation due to the indirect network effects between sellers and buyers citep{rochet2006two}. The optimal auction platform design balances the bidder-side surplus and buyer-side profit to attract both sides to join the platform. Attracting sellers and bidders becomes even more important when there is competition between auction platforms citep{ellison2004competing}. Our structural model can be applied to study these platform design problems in the future.

16500520.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
16500520.value: Auction platforms often list many similar or even identical items for sale simultaneously. However, bidders can only participate in a limited number of auctions due to time conflicts and deposit requirements. It is well-known that attracting more bidders is crucial for revenue maximization, more so than setting optimal reserves or selecting the right auction format. Therefore, auction platforms must carefully consider the competition between auctions to maximize revenue. o maximize the total revenue from many items, an auction platform should not treat auctions independently; rather, it needs to understand the relationship between auctions and the endogenous entry of the bidders. We propose a structural analysis framework to analyze competing auctions with endogenous entry. Applying this method to the Taobao judicial auction data, we find that the auction platform can significantly increase total revenue by increasing the auction group size.

16500820.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16500820.value: An increasing number of successful e-tailers like Alibaba and eBay operate as an online marketplace and are a key player in the supply chain linking the sellers/suppliers with the consumers. The consumer’s browsing and searching behaviors, items placed in and removed from shopping carts, demographic data, and purchasing history are all recorded and maintained by the platform. With this rich set of data, the platform can derive accurate demand forecasts for many of the products sold through it. Although these demand forecasts are valuable information and can potentially be used to bring about much improvement in managing the supply chain, the question is whether the platform has incentives to share the demand information with the sellers/suppliers. Unlike the traditional retailer playing the role of a middleman between the producers and customers, the online platform usually does not set retail prices. Rather, it facilitates direct transactions between sellers/suppliers and the end-users and takes a commission on each sale for its facilitating role. Hence, the incentive for information sharing in the online marketplace presents a problem very different from that in the traditional two-layer supply chain. In this project, we investigate the effect of and incentives for information sharing in a marketplace where multiple sellers distribute their partially substitutable products through a common online platform. The platform has superior information about consumer demand and determines whether or not to share the information with the sellers. We attempt to answer the following questions: Does the platform have incentive to share the demand information with all or some of the sellers for free? With how many sellers? What is the optimal extent of information sharing (the number of sellers to receive the demand information) for the platform? What is the optimal extent for the supply chain? How does the nature of competition between sellers and their cost structure affect the equilibrium information dissemination? How does information sharing affect the informed and uninformed sellers? How does information sharing change the optimal commission rate for the platform? By addressing the above questions, we intend to derive useful lines of consideration for guiding the dissemination of demand information in the online marketplace to the potential benefits of the platform owner and other participants. 越來越多的電子零售商（例如，阿里巴巴和eBay）都採取了線上市場的經營模式，且已經成為聯繫賣方/供應商與消費者的關鍵角色。在線上市場中，消費者的瀏覽行為，搜索紀錄，購物車資料，個人資訊以及購物紀錄等都會被平臺記錄。有了這些豐富的數據，平臺可以對所售賣的產品的需求進行準確地預測。儘管這些需求預測可以提高供應鏈管理效率，問題是平臺運營方是否有動機與賣方共享這些資訊。與傳統的零售商在生產者和消費者之間扮演中間人的角色不同，平臺並不直接決定零售價格。相反，它提供平臺讓賣方/供應商與最終消費者直接進行交易，並對每筆交易額按比例收取佣金。因此，線上市場上的資訊共享機制與在傳統的兩層供應鏈結構下的共享機制完全不同。在這個項目中，我們研究電子市場上資訊共享的動機和影響。在該市場中，多個賣家通過壹個共同的線上平臺銷售其可部分替代的產品。該平臺擁有消費者市場的需求資訊，並有權決定是否與賣方分享這些資訊。我們嘗試回答以下問題：平臺是否有動機與所有或部分賣家免費共享市場需求資訊？共享給多少賣家？該平臺的最佳資訊共享範圍（接收需求資訊的賣方數目）是多少？對整個供應鏈來說，最佳範圍是多少？賣方之間的競爭性質及其成本結構如何影響資訊分享策略？資訊共享如何影響獲得和沒有獲得資訊的賣家？資訊共享如何影響平臺的最優佣金率？通過解答上述問題，我們希望得出一些有用的思路來指導現實中線上市場如何實現需求資訊的共享，讓平臺運營方和其他參與者互惠互利。

16500820.label: Realisation of objectives
16500820.value: We have achieved all four objectives in the original proposal, submitted a paper to a major journal in the field, and produced a working paper that is ready for submission. Some specifics are below. “All, None, or Some? Platform Information Sharing when Sellers Incur Nonlinear Production Costs” We study information dissemination of an online platform through which multiple sellers distribute their partially substitutable products. The platform takes a commission from each seller's revenue. The platform has superior information about the demand and determines whether, and with how many sellers, to share the information. An important feature of our study is that the sellers incur nonlinear production costs. We investigate the effect of and incentives for platform information sharing using a unified model that incorporates three types of nonlinear cost structure: constant marginal cost (linear), increasing marginal cost (diseconomies of scale), and decreasing marginal cost (economies of scale). We show that the cost structure alone determines the direction of the impact of information sharing on the revenue and cost, while the scope of information dissemination (the number of sellers who receive information) affects only the magnitude of that impact. The platform's optimal information sharing strategy is to provide all it has to a subset of sellers under production diseconomies or moderate production economies of scale, but not to share information under large production economies of scale. When the production exhibits too large economies of scale, sharing information with sellers will reduce the total revenue and thus the platform's earned commission. The platform shares information with more sellers if their products are less similar or if the production shifts toward smaller economies or greater diseconomies of scale. The commission rate impacts the platform's optimal scope of information sharing for nonlinear costs, but has no impact for linear costs assumed in the extant literature. The platform should adjust its optimal scope of information sharing according to different product categories that have different commission rates, expanding (shrinking) the scope for a higher commission rate under production diseconomies (economies) of scale. When information is shared with some, but not with all sellers at once, we propose a self-realizing mechanism through which the information is distributed among the sellers fairly and equitably. “Commissions and Profits on e-Tailing Platforms” An online marketplace is a platform that facilitates transactions by enabling sellers to sell directly to end customers. The platform earns a commission for its facilitating role on each transaction, equal to a fixed percentage of the seller's revenue. We study the commissions and profits on a platform where competing sellers sell partially differentiated products. We are motivated by a pattern of commission rates observed on platforms such as Tmall, Amazon, and eBay: the commission rate percentage is higher if the profit margin is higher or the products are more similar. Our model well explains this observed pattern. We also find that if the sellers’ unit marginal costs become lower, they may earn less profit while the platform earns more. As it stands to gain from lowering sellers’ marginal costs, the platform may have incentives to help the sellers reduce their costs, e.g., by subsidizing their shipping costs. The sellers should be wary when accepting these “free” services because the lower cost will prompt the platform to raise the commission rate, which may eventually bring a net loss to the sellers. Finally, in terms of overall system-wide profit, the commission rate contract is more efficient than service-for-free and per-unit fee contracts.
