17307720.label: Major findings and research outcome
17307720.value: As a result of the constructions and testing conducted, two homomorphic encryption algorithms were designed as a result of this research. A paper detailing the primary research results is currently under preparation, as described in part C. The first algorithm is a modification of the algorithm originally detailed in the grant proposal. Due to testing of inverses of the functions constructed, zeroes were identified by numerically computing the poles of the inverses. This numerical detection of zeros leads to a vulnerability for the resulting cryptographic system, as an adversary stealing enough encrypted data may be able to find the secret point at which the evaluations are occurring, by searching for common zeros. The modification involves taking the value modulo a lattice instead of taking the value itself. Since the lattice is being mapped via the modular form to the image of the lattice, there does not appear to be a way to detect the lattice. Since the value varies modulo the lattice, detection of common zeros also does not indicate the secret point. So the cryptographic system appears to be secure. A more complicated second construction was also developed using harmonic Maass forms and principal parts. The second construction seems to be very secure, but may not be as efficient, due to large principal parts for weakly holomorphic modular forms of cryptographically large level.

17307720.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17307720.value: There are additional tests that need to be done in order to determine which of the two constructions is both efficient and secure enough to use for practical purposes. The cryptographic system potentially allows for computations involving addition and multiplication to be done without revealing secret information. In order to test the algorithms more completely a next step would be to extend the code prototype to a more robust and efficient system; this should help to determine whether a practical construction is viable or not.

17307720.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17307720.value: In this project, we used a mathematical object called modular forms to construct two cryptography systems (systems that scramble data) which allow arithmetic to be constructed on the encrypted/scrambled data. When decrypted/unscrambled, the answer is correct, but the person doing the calculations cannot see the original data. The potential purpose of such systems is to share the work of cloud computing while preserving privacy of data. The resulting system is not yet fully tested, so long-term practicality as a viable commercial product is not yet clear.

17308120.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308120.value: 水蒸氣和水滴是普遍存在的水相，其存在範圍廣泛，並且在地質，海洋和大氣環境中起著核心作用。地球上所有水驅動過程的基本原理是分子級溶劑化，即水分子之間，水分子與離子之間的相互作用以及無機和生物界面的水合過程。分子溶劑化在淺地殼過程中起著關鍵作用，例如在礦物溶解，金屬運輸和成礦過程中。這些分子相互作用實際上也影響著所有生物和生化過程，例如，在生命起源和進化過程中的膜離子轉運，蛋白質折疊和益生元生物分子組裝 地球的上地殼（約2公里深）含有約2.26.1016噸水或2.26.107平方千米水，流量約為1g / cc。這種水合包裹層通過地殼浮起，冷卻，沸騰並產生水流體和共存的蒸氣。這兩個相的分子結構和物理化學性質都根本不同。更重要的是，氣相對離子，絡合物和簇的溶劑化行為的影響是顯著的，並且在沸騰流體中金屬的遷移率中起著至關重要的作用。最近的理論和實驗研究表明，該氣相實際上是一個複雜的多相化學系統，由單個水分子，具有5-20個水的簇和具有多達1000個水分子的納米液滴組成。這些納米級液滴在其表面，近表面和主體區域相互作用並溶劑化金屬離子，每種離子類型的位置傾向不同。例如，H3O +離子佔據表面位置，而OH-位於液滴近表面位置，從而導致酸性液滴表面，鹼性近表面和pH中性內部區域。然而，關於納米液滴中對地球化學重要的礦石金屬（如金和銅）的位置偏好知之甚少。了解這些金屬在水納米滴中及其周圍的溶劑化行為是了解金屬在礦石蒸汽中的溶解度和遷移率的核心。我們對氣相金屬形態的了解正是這種差距，這是我們小組旨在探查納米溶劑化金屬物種的實驗和理論努力背後的驅動力。因此，我們對納米液滴金屬形態的興趣使我們通過結構敏感的IRMPD光譜學和第一原理分子動力學研究了溶劑化的Cu，Ag和Au簇簇物種的穩定性和分子結構

17308420.label: Project Objectives
17308420.value: We develop adaptive enrichment strategies with sample size re-estimation by controlling the overall type I error rate and achieving desired statistical power with minimum expected sample size. We develop a new measure of survival by assessing the average survival time among the population whose survival rates are greater than a certain quantile, which is the area under the survival curve with respect to the vertical axis in contrast to the restricted mean survival time which is the area under the survival curve along the horizontal axis. For interval-censored and truncated data, we propose a new algorithm to compute the NPMLE by casting the likelihood in the incomplete multinomial framework, and further compute the restricted mean survival time and area above a quatile for such data.

17308420.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308420.value: Clinical trial participants are often heterogeneous, which is a fundamental problem in the rapidly developing field of precision medicine. Participants’ heterogeneity causes considerable difficulty in the current phase III trial designs. Adaptive enrichment designs provide a flexible and intuitive solution. At the interim analysis, we enrich the subgroup of trial participants who have a higher likelihood to benefit from the new treatment. However, it is critical to control the level of the test size and maintain adequate power after enrichment of certain subgroup of participants. We develop adaptive enrichment strategies with sample size re-estimation and verify the feasibility and practicability through real trial examples, extensive simulations and sensitivity analyses. We expect the proposed methods can control the overall type I error rate and exhibit competitive improvement in terms of statistical power and expected sample size. Motivated by the restricted mean survival time, we develop a new measure of survival by assessing the average survival time among the population whose survival rates are greater than a certain quantile, which emphasizes the survival rate profile of mean survival from the prospective of a rescaled-time axis by quantile transformation. For interval-censored and truncated data, we propose a new algorithm to compute the NPMLE by casting the likelihood in the incomplete multinomial framework. 臨床試驗參與者的異質性是快速發展的精准醫學領域中的一個基本問題，它給現階段的三期試驗設計造成了很大的困難。自適應富集設計給這個問題提供了一個靈活而且直觀的解決方案。在期間分析階段，自適應富集設計更傾向與把病人分配到參與者更可能受益於治療的子組。但是，這難以控制假設檢驗的第一類錯誤率和維持被富集的子組上足夠的統計功效。我們提出了一個通過樣本量重估測的自適應富集設計，並且通過實際的例子，大量的模擬實驗和敏感性分析，我們驗證它的靈活性和實用性。我們期望該方法可以控制總體的第一類錯誤率並且可以顯示出它在統計功效的提升和期望樣本量的優勢。受限期望生存時間在生存分析得到廣泛的應用，由此啟發，我們發展了一個新的生存分析的測量標準，這個標準測算生存率大於某個特定分位數的人群的平均生存時間，並且它通過分位數變換著重強調了平均生存時間的生存率概況。對於區間刪失數據和被截斷數據，我們通過把似然函數結合進不完全的多項式框架，發展出一種新的計算非參數極大似然估計的演算法。

17308420.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17308420.value: Patient survival time is the gold standard for evaluating treatment effects. Our research has delivered several novel methods for analysing survival data, e.g., interval censored data. We relax the modelling assumption by using the restricted mean survival time, which leads to more robust comparisons between treatments. We also develop adaptive clinical trial designs to allow for sample size re-estimation so that the trial can be properly powered for detecting a treatment difference. Our work has the potential to improve clinical trial implementation and promote new drug development.

17308520.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308520.value: Understanding the dynamic evolution of planetary space environment is important for basic space physics research and future planetary mission planning, which requires an understanding of the interaction between the ionosphere, and magnetosphere and the solar wind. This proposal focuses on the possible physical influence of non-thermal plasma populations on the global configuration the Jovian magnetosphere. Similar to the geospace environment, the Jovian system is influenced by the solar wind, but is also driven by the fast rotation of the planet. Moreover, the plasma population within the Jovian magnetosphere consists of large contributions from Io. Previous missions to the Jupiter have also shown that, unlike the Earth’s magnetosphere, non-thermal plasma populations have been observed in the middle-outer region of the Jovian magnetosphere, suggesting that the pressure balance in the outer Jovian magnetosphere may be dominated by these hot plasma populations rather than the magnetic pressure. In the past decades, significant progress has been made on the development of Jovian magnetosphere models and their use in interpreting observations. However, none of these global models considered the effects of hot plasma populations in the middle-outer Jovian magnetosphere, and therefore the simulated Jovian magnetospheres deviate significantly from the observations. Based on these recent development on multi-fluid magnetohydrodynamics based global Jovian magnetosphere models, the project seeks to improve the existing global models by developing numerical methods for including hot plasma populations and to gain a better understanding of the dynamic evolution of the Jovian magnetosphere especially on the magnetospheric pressure balance, plasma instability and auroral precipitation. In the interest of narrowing the scope of the project, the work will focus on the development of global magnetosphere models of the Jupiter. The specific science questions to be addressed are: 1. What determines the stand-off distance and bow shock location of the Jovian magnetosphere? 2. What controls plasma instabilities in the middle/outer Jovian magnetosphere? 3. Do the non-thermal plasma populations affect auroral precipitation in the Jovian magnetosphere? With the implementation of non-thermal plasma populations in a global Jovian magnetosphere model, these science questions will be addressed using controlled numerical experiments. The model development work will implement a phenomenological description of non-thermal ion population heated by empirical heating rates. The model development work required is based on the numerical multi-fluid MHD code named GAMERA, and preliminary results of the simulated Jovian magnetosphere are presented later in this proposal. Thus, most of the effort of this project will be directly devoted to addressing the science questions. 木星磁層的動力學演化過程對於了解行星系統的空間環境，基礎等離子體物理學以及未來深空探測項目的設計，具有重要的意義。對行星空間環境的系統研究需要理解其各個圈層之間的耦合關係，例如大氣層-電離層-磁層的相互作用。本項目聚焦於一個特殊的空間環境系統，即木星的磁層，探究在木星空間環境中觀測到的非熱平衡等離子體對於行星空間環境的演化的影響。木星的空間環境系統類似於地球，除去高速自轉以外，一個較大的不同之處在於空間等離子體的來源為伊奧（Io）衛星而非太陽風的帶電粒子。這些來自於Io地質活動的物質體佔了木星空間環境的大部分等離子體組成成分，並且呈現出非熱平衡的狀態。目前已有的木星空間環境全球模擬研究並未考慮非熱平衡等離子體的影響，因此得到的模型和物理過程存在缺失。本項目將使用多流體磁流體力學計算模式，通過嘗試人為加入非理想等離子體加熱的物理過程來近似來源於Io的非熱平衡等離子體，並且通並過使用超大規模並行計算來定量研究非熱平衡等離子體在木星磁層中的動力學過程，及其對於等離子體的輸運，大尺度不穩定性和木星的極光過程的影響。本項目的基礎研究可以應用於未來行星探測項目的設計和科學問題的提出，為空間探測提供理論基礎和數值模擬平台。

17308520.label: Major findings and research outcome
17308520.value: a) Model Development Accomplished 1. A three-dimensional global magnetohydrodynamics (MHD) simulation code was successfully developed (Objective 1) to investigate the external and internal dynamics of the Jovian magnetosphere, focusing on the nonthermal Iogenic plasma source (Zhang et al., 2021). 2. To address the non-thermal nature of internal plasma dynamics, a novel and robust numerical algorithm for handling pressure anisotropy was developed (Objective 1). Test results demonstrate the algorithm's effectiveness for both linear and nonlinear MHD flow problems (Luo et al., 2023). b) Major Science Questions Addressed 1. Leveraging the high-resolution global MHD simulation developed in this project, a novel magnetospheric topology of Jupiter and its response to solar wind pressure were proposed for the first time, which is now used in the community as the “standard” jovian magnetospheric topology and has been successful in explaining various auroral and plasma observations (Zhang et al., 2021; Feng et al., 2022) (Objective 2). 2. Through numerical experiments and in-situ observations from Juno, the significant variation of the Jovian magnetopause under constant conditions was unveiled for the first time, emphasizing the importance of the non-thermal plasma population sourced internally (Feng et al., 2023) (Objective 2). 3. The dynamic response of magnetospheric reconnection in the Jovian magnetodisc was successfully simulated and validated against observations (Chen et al., 2024) (Objectives 2 and 3). 4. The application of a multi-fluid model with various plasma species to other planetary magnetospheres such as Venus and Mars, provided insights into the effects of different plasma populations on planetary magnetosphere configurations (Dang et al., 2022) (Objective 4). The multi-fluid model development is currently now used as a framework for study planetary space weather systems by collaborators of the PI (Yang et al., 2022; 2024). 5. The impact of Iogenic nonthermal plasma population on magnetospheric instability was studied. Zheng et al. (2025) (under review) discovered that the internal plasma source influences the growth and propagation of the Kelvin-Helmholtz instability at the magnetopause, thereby regulating the dawn-dusk asymmetry of fast-rotating magnetospheres (Objectives 3 and 4). The influence on Interchange instability was also investigated and published in Zheng et al. (2024) (PhD thesis), with a manuscript in preparation for submission to GRL.

17308520.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17308520.value: The global magnetohydrodynamic (MHD) code developed under this RGC grant provides a flexible,multi-physics framework for studying space environments across solar system planets and exoplanets. Its modular architecture allows customization of planetary parameters (e.g., magnetic field geometry, rotation rates), enabling cross-system comparisons. A major milestone was achieved through its application to Jupiter’s magnetosphere, where the model resolved meso-scale plasma dynamics—particularly interactions between Io’s volcanism, Jupiter’s rapid rotation, and auroral processes. These results, validated against Juno mission data, were peer-reviewed and presented at the MOP2024 conference, offering new insights into magnetospheric energy transport in gas giants. The PI’s group is now adapting the code to simulate ice giants, starting with Uranus and Neptune. This work will address open questions about magnetotail stability and solar wind coupling at extreme obliquities, with preliminary simulations already identifying unique current sheet structures. Beyond the solar system, the code’s scalable design supports future studies of exoplanetary space weather, particularly for Earth-like worlds in habitable zones. The model will be shared as an open-source tool in 2025-2026, enhancing collaborative research capabilities in comparative planetary science.

17308520.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17308520.value: With support from the RGC grant, our team built a powerful computer model to study how planets—both in our solar system and beyond—interact with the harsh conditions of space. By plugging in details like a planet’s magnetic field or how fast it spins, we can predict how solar storms or charged particles behave around different worlds. We used this tool to solve mysteries about Jupiter. The model showed how material blasted from Io’s volcanoes gets swept up by Jupiter’s super-fast rotation, creating dazzling auroras near its poles. These findings matched real data from NASA’s Juno spacecraft and were shared at a major space science conference in 2024. The model is also suitable for ice giants like Uranus and Neptune. These distant planets have magnetic fields that are wildly tilted— compass pointing sideways. Early simulations reveal strange, twisted structures in their magnetic "tails," helping us understand how they cope with the solar wind flow. The same tool could soon study planets orbiting other stars, especially Earth-like worlds where safe space conditions might support life. By 2026, we’ll share this model freely with scientists worldwide.

17308920.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308920.value: An important task in data analysis is to check whether two sets of measurements from subjects are related each other. Traditionally, this is implemented via a so-called independence test. Developing meaningful methodology for this test has been in the center of statistical research. Many procedures have been proposed and validated in the statistical literature. However, in the current era of “big data”, most of these existing methodologies are challenged by the fact that the number of measurements (or variables) from examined subjects is increasingly large. This leads to the modern and difficult problem of “curse of dimension”. This project aims at generalizing and extending some well-known methodology of the independence test to a situation where the number of measurements is large, say beyond several thousands. The project is built upon an existing method called “distance covariance”. The novelty of the project is to borrow analytic tools from the mathematical theory of random matrices in order to modify and extend the existing test methods based on distance covariance to the situation with a large number of measurements. Upon completion of the project, new methods for testing the independence between two large sets of measurements will be available to practitioners of data analysts. Application areas include genomic data analysis, financial data analysis and network data analysis. 數據分析中的一項重要任務是檢查兩組測量數據是否彼此相關。傳統上，這是通過所謂的獨立性假設檢驗來實施的。為該假設檢驗開發有意義的方法一直位於統計研究的中心。統計文獻中已經提出並驗證了許多方法 。但是，在當前的“大數據”時代，這些現有方法大部分都受到以下事實的挑戰：檢查的測量（或變量）的數量越來越大。這導致了現代的難題，即“維數的詛咒”。 該項目旨在推廣和擴展一些知名的獨立性假設檢驗方法到變量數量很大（例如超過數千個）的情況下。 該項目建立在稱為“距離協方差”的現有方法的基礎上。該項目的新穎性是從隨機矩陣的數學理論中藉用分析工具, 來修改和擴展基於距離協方差的現有獨立性假設檢驗方法到變量數量很大的情況。項目完成後， 數據分析人員可以使用獨立性假設檢驗的新方法來分析大量的變量。項目的應用領域包括基因組數據分析，財務數據分析和網絡數據分析。

17309020.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309020.value: 為瞭解大分子在物理,化學和生物過程中的反應活性及功能,精確確定大分子的結構至關重要。 計算化學方法可以提供實驗測量無法呈現的原子及分子細節。 然而複雜分子體系通常包含大量的弱相互作用結構域,這些弱相互作用力這對現在廣泛使用的經典力場或密度泛函能量模型提出了巨大的挑戰。 儘管這兩類方法處理較大分子結構時有著很好的計算效率,但是它們引入了大量經驗或半經驗的方法參數,所以原則上無法保證結果的可靠性和適用性。 基於電子波函數的從頭算量子化學方法可以提供高度的準確性,但是對計算資源的要求過高,因此難以處理龐大複雜的分子體系。 經過過去幾十年的發展,二階擾動理論(MP2)在計算精度和資源成本之間取得了很好的平衡。 該理論提供了最經濟的從頭算電子相關方法,精度也大大提高,可用於描述生物結構中普遍存在的弱作用力。 MP2已成功被應用於包含921個殘基和14086個原子的流感HA抗原抗體系統,並已證明可在4096個向量CPU上在一小時內完成能量計算。 毋庸置疑,我們正處於一個新時代的開端,準確而高效的從頭算量子化學理論正在日益完善,同時超級計算機的算力亦迅猛增長。 例如,計算成本相對較低的MP2從頭算理論已經開始向傳統的DFT應用領域遷移,在解決實際複雜化學問題方面展現出巨大的潛質。 最近,我們發展了一種高精度低標度的OSV-MP2計算理論,並能應用於普通分子體系的能量和能量分析梯度計算。 研究表明,在單個CPU上進行的OSV-MP2分析梯度計算能夠顯著加快由OSV-MP2驅動的分子動力學類比速度。 我們的成果令人鼓舞,但方法的開發及應用仍然處於初級階段。 比如,對複雜分子體系的OSV-MP2 分子動力學類比性能仍然未知。 而只有將單個時間步驟上的OSV-MP2計算能力進行數量級的提升,同時藉助超級計算機的多節點算力,對大分子進行OSV-MP2 分子動力學的高效類比才能夠實現。 在這個專案中,我們將發展適用於快速計算複雜分子的新一代OSV-MP2能量和能量梯度理論,同時利用多計算機節點CPU和圖形處理器(GPU)相結合的大規模並行化算力。 本方法將大大提升計算預測化學及生物大分子結構的可靠性和精確度,同時為發展更高級別的低標度電子結構理論提供新的思路。

17309020.label: Realisation of objectives
17309020.value: Objective 1. This objective has been fully achieved. The near-linear-scaling OSV-MP2 algorithms for the energy and structure determination were developed and demonstrated to a range of molecules in our publication [Liang, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2021, 17, 6841-6860]. The computational performance for macromolecules including C60-catcher complexes with 148 atoms and 3888 atomic orbitals, the interlocking Cu-catenane supramolecule with 177 atoms as well as (H2O)190 with 570 atoms and 11020 atomic orbitals were demonstrated on the multi-node multi-processor supercomputer. The algorithm implements a dynamic memory control and massive parallel strategy to divide orbital-pair-based tasks over large-scale CPU cores. Due to limited CPU computing hours that we could afford to purchase through the small RGC funding (capped at HK$100,000) of "high-performance computing hours", only up to 120 CPU cores were accessible. We can envision that the structure determination of very large macromolecules becomes routinely possible at MP2 level for which the computing time can be further drastically reduced with strong CPU recourses. Objective 2. This objective has been fully achieved. Our development leads to a superior run-time performance to other low-scaling MP2 methods reported in literature. For example, on 24 CPU cores, the elapsed timing for an OSV-MP2 single-point energy and gradient computation of C60@catcher complex is 11394 seconds which is three times faster than 37255 seconds of the state-of-the-art dlpno-MP2 [J. Chem. Phys. 150, 164102 (2019)]; on 120 CPU cores, our elapsed timing is further reduced to about 2848 seconds by 4-5 fold acceleration relative to 24 CPU cores. This shows that the parallel scalability of the OSV-MP2 computation on multiple cores is excellent and potentially needs only about 1/3 CPU cores of the popular dlpno-MP2. The preliminary data show that it is possible to scale up OSV-MP2 model on less CPU cores with higher parallel efficiency than dlpno-MP2. Objective 3. This objective has been mostly achieved. We have developed MBE(3)-OSV-MP2 and its QM/MM methods for driving Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics (BOMD) simulations [Liang, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2021, 17, 6841-6860; Liang, et al. J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2023,145,10159-10166]. These low-scaling models were applied to reveal the dynamic evolution of different chemical systems by 10 picosecond MP2-driven BOMD for the first time. In the first application, we studied the hydrogen transfer pathways that lead to tautomerization reaction of Porphycene (C20H14N4) at room temperature. We revealed that accurate electron correlations are the origin of the broadening of the N-H vibrational peaks, while the literature study attributed it to the quantum proton effect by path-integral MD simulation within density functional theory. Further studies are needed to investigate the impact of the proton-coupled correlated electrons. In the second application, we performed a multiscale OSV-MP2/MM BOMD modeling of a large water microdroplet (H2O)190 for studying the air/water surface charge transfer mechanism and the on-water reactivity that catalyzes the Criegee-water reaction. We pointed out that the microdroplet surface undergoes spontaneous water-water charge exchange that is highly inhomogeneous: a surprising large amount of charges up to 0.20 e per water are present and creates H2O+/H2O radical pairs in the surface layer. The resulting H2O+/H2O pairs build up a local electric field that may reorient reactants and accelerate the reaction. As a result, the anti-CH3CHOO-water reaction, which was previously deemed inert and stable based on density functional calculations, can proceed rapidly in three different pathways. Further developments are needed for faster and longer MD simulations by removing the computational bottleneck of the Hartree-Fock computation on the GPU/CPU hybrid platform in the short future. Objective 4. This objective has been partially achieved. The reason is that the computational resource is insufficient for supporting the computation of biological macromolecules as the allocation of CPU core hours is short by the earmarked RGC funding for high-performance computing hours limited to HK$100,000. As a result, we only demonstrated that the OSV-MP2 computational speedup for a short peptide chain (Gly)20 is unprecedented with respect to the number of CPU cores [Liang, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2021, 17, 6841-6860]. In future, we will attempt to seek different funding sources that enable a large-scale simulation platform for biological macromolecules, along with GPU acceleration. On the other hand, our recent low-data machine learning model [Ng, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2023, 19, 5439−5449] also opens a promising avenue in which we will attempt to compute OSV-MP2 energies and structures of small proteins by training transferable neural network model from few data of structural fragments. We plan to integrate both hardware and software techniques to enable targeting protein structures in near future.

17309020.label: Major findings and research outcome
17309020.value: We have implemented one of the fastest MP2 energy and geometry solvers for computing macromolecules that were previously difficult. To this end, this project made the following technical innovations and applications for enabling computation of macromolecules at MP2 level of theory: (1) Development of a highly efficient low-rank electronic structure representation for the MP2 wavefunction and analytic energy gradients [Liang, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2021, 17, 6841-6860]. We presented a third-order many-body expansion formulation and implementation for efficient computation of OSV-MP2 analytical energy gradients. Three major algorithm advancements were developed. (i) a new algorithms exploiting the two-electron integral sparsity for pruning out insignificant fitting integrals and OSV relaxations; (ii) an interpolative decomposition scheme for fast OSV generations that accelerates the computation by about 1-2 orders of magnitude; (iii) a highly parallelized algorithm by managing the global and local data arrays in the hybrid remote-memory access and shared memory mechanism through passive one-sided communication across multiple nodes. (2) Development of a multiscale MP2-driven QM/MM molecular dynamics model beyond conventional DFT/MM [Liang, et al. J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2023,145,10159-10166]. We developed a multiscale number-adaptive OSV-MP2-driven QM/MM scheme to adaptively relocate QM molecules for molecular dynamics simulations after the long distance translocation of QM molecules. (3) Development of a chemically accurate and transferable quantum-informed neural network model for predicting MP2 and CCSD electron correlation energies of large molecules by training small molecules [Ng, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2023, 19, 5439−5449]. We designed low-rank electronic feature sets that capture the essential pattern to recognize electron correlations, making a data-efficient and highly transferable neural network model across molecular sizes, bond types and morphologies. By training 800 small water clusters (H2O)8, our neural network model directly outputs accurate energies of up to (H2O)128 at an error of about 1 kcal/mol. (4) Demonstrative applications of our models to molecular systems that appear controversial to the conventional density functional theory [Liang, et al. J. Chem. Theory Comput. 2021, 17, 6841-6860; Liang, et al. J. Am. Chem. Soc. 2023,145,10159-10166]. The conventional DFT results are challenged with our OSV-MP2 predictions on: (i) the origin of the broadening of the Porphycene N-H vibrational signature between electron correlation and quantum protons; (ii) and the Criegee-water reactivity on the microdroplet air/water interface. This project generates 4 major publications and 5 conference talks, and has educated 2 PhD students.

17309020.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17309020.value: The project can be further developed by adding OSV-MP2 to CPU/GPU hybrid platform for harnessing the acceleration power on sophisticated hardware, for further improving transferable machine learning-assisted model with judicious model architecture design, and for accurately determining the polymorphic structure and energy ordering of crystal solids under periodic boundary condition. The joint efforts in all these aspects will add new computational toolsets and fundamentally escalate the simulation reliability by informing the quantum electronic structure to macromolecular simulations.

17309020.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17309020.value: In the digital era of modern sciences, molecular simulation techniques are becoming an increasingly important tool for probing molecular details of chemical and material problems. The atomistic processes in a chemical transformation are driven by electron and nucleus interactions which are quantum mechanical in nature and necessitate quantum chemistry computation that encodes electronic structure information. The most important molecular interaction is through the electron correlation which is chemical glue that holds all atoms together to form specific molecular structures, properties. and reactivities. It is of utmost importance to predict molecular electron correlations at various quantum levels of theory. In this project, the team has developed new mathematical theories and computer algorithms for enabling large-scale computation of macromolecular electronic structures on high-performance computers. Our technical innovations in this project bridge the high-level electronic structure theory, Born-Oppenheimer molecular dynamics simulation and machine learning model for computing energies and geometries of molecules in a unified ab-initio framework. Our research findings have been published in 4 peer-reviewed papers on the world leading chemistry and theoretical chemistry journals. The research efforts of this project would catalyze new computational idea to be developed for CPU-GPU heterogeneous computing towards real materials and solids.

17309220.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309220.value: With the ability to deliver light with high spatial and temporal precision in a remote and clean fashion, there has been a growing interest in the use of photo-activated processes in various fields of research, spanning all the way from materials, electronics and energy research to more recently, organic synthesis, catalysis and even drug delivery, biomedical diagnostics and chemical biology. Unlike the widespread use of photoclick ligation and phototrigger approaches in biology and photoresist chemistry in microelectronics, the corresponding exploitation of photoactivatable processes other than trans-cis photo-isomerization and photoinduced ring-opening/closing in supramolecular assembly, sensing and smart materials research is scarce, and is mainly confined to organics and polymers. In this project, we will mainly focus on the exploration of various photoactivation processes, such as phototrigger, photo-click, photoionization, photocycloaddition and photoresist chemistry, in the design of new classes of photoactivatable metal-ligand chromophoric complexes and the study of their supramolecular assembly. By capitalizing on the rich photophysics as well as the diverse coordination geometry of metal complex systems, a systematic exploration of photoactivation processes in the rational design and synthesis of metal-ligand chromophores that are capable of displaying photoactivatable assembly and functions will be made. Efforts will be made to introduce other orthogonal activatable moieties to achieve orthogonally-controlled multi-activatable metal-ligand chromophores. It is believed that systematic and sequence-specific activation of the multiple activatable metal complex systems can lead to changes in their electronic absorption, emission and supramolecular assembly properties. Extension of the work to proof-of-principle sensing protocols will be made. An understanding and correlation of the excited-state energies of the metal-ligand chromophores and photoactivatable ligands, optical, luminescence and electrochemical properties, photoactivation processes, as well as underlying factors that govern photoactivation and their mechanisms, self-assembly and sensing properties should give insights into their structure-property-function relationships and information on the rational photocontrol of supramolecular assembly effected by photoactivatable processes in metal complex systems, which would contribute towards the future design and development of new classes of photoactivatable metal-containing materials and sensors, and possibly serve as a model for photoactivatable on-demand cargo or therapeutic delivery. It is envisaged that the proposed study would provide new strategies to uncover the guiding principles for the rational design and synthesis of new classes of metal-ligand chromophores with photoactivatable assembly and functions, offering new opportunities and providing new research dimensions for the exploration and development of unique photoactivatable and orthogonally-controlled multi-activatable metal-ligand chromophores for supramolecular assembly and sensing applications. 由於光能夠以高時空精度進行遠程及潔淨的傳遞，因此光活化過程在不同的研究範疇均備受關注。這些研究領域不僅涵蓋了材料，電子器件和能源方面，還包括有機合成，催化，藥物傳遞，生物醫學診斷和化學生物學。雖然光點擊連接以及光觸發方法已廣泛應用於生物學，而光刻膠化學也廣泛應用於微電子學，但在超分子組裝、傳感與智能材料的研究領域，除了利用順反光異構和光誘導開環/關環，且局限於有機物和聚合物方面的研究外，其他光活化過程的研發則相對匱乏。本項目將集中於光觸發、光點擊、光離子化、光環加成和光刻膠化學等光活化過程的探索，致力設計新型的，具有光活化特性的金屬-配體發色團配合物，並對它們的超分子組裝進行研究。籍著金屬配合物體系自身豐富的光物理性質和多樣的配位幾何結構，以及通過對光活化過程進行系統性的探索來合理的設計和合成具有光活性組裝和功能的金屬-配體發色團。此外，本項目將引入其他正交活化基團，從而實現正交可控的多活性金屬-配體發色團。通過系統性和特異序列來活化金屬配合物體系相信能改變其電子吸收、發射和超分子組裝特性。未來更會把研究工作擴展至對傳感基理的驗證。理解及研究金屬-配體發色團和光活化配體的激發態能量，光學、发光和電化學特性，以及它們與光活化過程的相關關係；同時探索控制光活化過程和機理、自組裝和傳感特性的潛在因素將有利於了解結構-特性-功能間的關係，並能就金屬配合物體系進行的光活化過程如何影響光控超分子組裝提供重要信息。這些研究成果將有助設計和開發新型光活化金屬材料和傳感器，有望應用於光活化按需載物或治療傳輸的模型上。本研究項目將提供新策略來展示設計和合成具有光活化組裝和功能的新型金屬-配體發色團的指導原則，為探索和開發具獨特光活化和正交可控的多活性金屬-配體發色團帶來新機遇和新研究維度，實現這類新型光活化金屬-配體發色團於超分子組裝和傳感方面的應用。

17309320.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309320.value: Among the reaction tools available to the synthetic chemist, cycloadditions are important strategies for the convergent synthesis of rings. Cycloaddition reactions that efficiently assemble polycyclic systems are particularly useful for the synthesis of natural products. The cycloadditions that yield products substituted at varied positions, and with different oxidation states, could enable the construction of a number of members in natural product families. Intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions are a strategy to generate polycyclic products having seven-membered rings. Our studies found that, although the intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions of epoxides vicinally-substituted by the enolsilane and the furan failed to provide cycloadducts having perhydroazulene skeletons in good yields and selectivities, yet substrates with epoxides that are geminally-substituted undergo (4+3) cycloadditions efficiently and diastereoselectively to generate cycloadducts having the [5,7]-fused bicyclic frameworks. These perhydroazulene, [5,7]-fused bicyclic skeletons are important as they are found in many natural products, and the cycloadditions of these geminally-substituted epoxides fills a gap and complements the current methodology. This proposal aims to study the intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions of this new class of tethered epoxy and aziridinyl enolsilanes both computationally and experimentally. The rationale behind why these substrates are able to undergo the hindered cycloaddition effectively will be studied. The most suitable reaction conditions for these cycloadditions, their scope and the derivatizations will each be examined. Based on our previous research, a broad range of diene systems, including furans, pyrroles, thiophenes, will be investigated, leading to cycloadducts of diverse structures and reactivities. To demonstrate the robustness and the utility of this method, the cycloaddition will be applied to the total synthesis of some natural products, such as the tetraneurins isolated from Parthenium alpinum. 在合成化學家的工具庫中，環加成反應是合成環狀化合物的重要手段。特別是複雜天然產物的合成中，環加成反應可以高效地構建多環體系，從而大大縮短合成路徑。環加成產物可以在不同的位置引入取代基，可以選擇不同的氧化態，從而得到不同的天然產物類似物。 分子內（4+3）環加成反應是構建含七元環多環化合物的重要方法。我們的研究表明，儘管烯醇硅醚和呋喃鄰二取代的環氧化合物的分子內（4+3）環加成反應的產率和選擇性都不理想，偕二取代的環氧烯醇硅醚卻可以順利進行分子內（4+3）環加成反應，高產率，高非對映選擇性地得到[5,7]-稠合的雙環加成產物。氫化甘菊環的[5,7]-稠合雙環結構廣泛存在於天然產物當中，偕二取代環氧化合物的環加成反應是現有的合成方法的有力補充。 本課題旨在從理論計算和實驗的角度研究這類新型的環氧和氮丙啶烯醇硅醚化合物的分子內（4+3）環加成反應。我們將探究該類化合物具有較大位阻卻可以順利進行環加成反應的機理，我們也將研究該類反應的最佳反應條件，反應底物的適用範圍和加成產物的衍生化。基於我們以前的研究，本課題將引入廣泛的共軛二烯結構到底物當中，比如呋喃，吡咯，噻吩，從而得到多樣化的加成產物。為了證明該反應的實用性，我們也將應用該反應去完成一些天然產物的全合成，比如從小白菊中分離出的Tetraneurins。

17309320.label: Realisation of objectives
17309320.value: The objectives set out in this project, namely to investigate intramolecular (4+3) cycloaddition reactions in which the electrophilic component, the epoxy enolsilane, is tethered geminally as a new connective motif, have been largely achieved. In addition, the derivatization and utility of the cycloadducts from these reactions have also been explored, culminating in a formal total synthesis of pseudolaric acid B, the most potent anti-tumour and anti-angiogenic natural product derived from tujingpi, a TCM herb. A series of S2-type geminally tethered substrates were designed and synthesized. It was found that intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions of these geminally substituted epoxy enolsilanes with furan as dienes were very successful, producing cycloadducts having quaternary stereocenters. The yields were generally moderate to good. Due to the geminal substitution which stabilizes electron-deficient intermediates, these substrates were particularly reactive for reaction, where some substrates underwent cycloaddition even on silica gel (Objective #1). Substituents on the enolsilane and the furan were tolerated, and the scope of the reaction was thoroughly investigated (Objective #2). Optically pure epoxides reacted to generated optically enriched cycloadducts. This is a powerful methodology that can be applied to the synthesis of complex chiral molecules such as natural products (vide infra). There were also found significant differences in the reactions of these geminally-tethered substrates compared with the previous vicinally-substituted epoxy enolsilane substrates. Whereas the latter were adept to construct cycloadducts with intervening six-membered rings, geminally-tethered epoxy enolsilanes with that same tether length resulted in very poor cycloaddition yields. On the other hand, obtaining the perhydroazulene type of skeleton was not efficient for the vicinally-substituted substrates, but these were precisely the cycloadducts that were efficiently obtained with this series. Therefore we have uncovered a kind of complementarity by examining this series of epoxy enolsilanes (Objective #2). In addition, we have also thoroughly investigated this reaction with tethered dienes other than furan. These less reactive dienes, such as thiophene and benzene, did not undergo cycloaddition but rather, Friedel-Crafts cyclizations. With tethered alkenes, no (3+2) cycloaddition occurred, also a point of departure from the reactions of the vicinally-substituted compounds (Objective #3). Derivatizations of the cycloadducts were examined and versatile transformations could be achieved (Objective #5). As for any synthesis reaction development, evidence of the utility of the reaction is by being able to apply the reaction to the synthesis of a worthy target molecule. In this connection, considerable time and work was devoted to the application of this cycloaddition as the key step in the formal total synthesis of pseudolaric acid B (Objective #5). In the original proposal we suggested different natural product targets, but pseudolaric acid B became a superior target in terms of structure and its bioactivity. We have designed an 18-step synthesis of an advanced intermediate in the Trost synthesis of pseudolaric acid B and accomplished this in fewer steps than via Trost’s route (Objective #6). Significant challenges in this synthetic plan that were eventually solved included the setting up of two stereochemically defined moieties in the required substrate, implementation of the key cycloaddition, reductive ring opening of the oxa-bridge, and the late-stage oxidation of the allylic methyl ether into an ester functionality. We consider that Objective #6 was over-achieved--as our work not only engaged in the synthetic studies, but actually completed the asymmetric formal total synthesis of a complex natural product bearing four contiguous stereocenters. This work—the methodology development and the formal total synthesis of pseudolaric acid B is being written up for a publication, and is almost to be submitted. The major reasons for the delay of the work was the after-effects of the COVID, but even more seriously, due to the lack of appropriate research lab space in 2021 for over 8 months, so that our overall experimental progress was halted and had to be restarted later. As the formal synthesis was an "all-or-nothing" endeavour--ie. we had to complete the full synthesis for pseudolaric acid B, or else it would not be a formal total synthesis, much of our time and effort was devoted to the application and tackling the synthetic challenges. The remaining objective, #4, on the exploration of the aziridines is under-achieved, because this reaction is less relevant to the synthesis of the natural product, so its studies were not addressed until much later. However, we expect the results to be soon forthcoming.

17309320.label: Major findings and research outcome
17309320.value: 1. Geminally tethered furans and epoxy enolsilanes undergo intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions successfully to produce perhydroazulene compounds in moderate to good yields and with good diastereoselectivities. The reactions are facile, and the products also bear characteristic quaternary stereocenters at the ring fusion. The reaction produces optically enriched cycloadducts when enantiomerically pure epoxides are used as substrates, making this methodology powerful for the asymmetric construction of chiral compounds. 2. Cycloaddition to produce perhydroazulenes are much more efficient than the previous intramolecular reaction involving vicinally tethered epoxy enolsilanes, making these two versions of the cycloaddition complementary to each other. 3. The scope of the intramolecular (4+3) cycloaddition has been studied and substituents at various positions of the epoxy enolsilane and furan can be tolerated. 4. Where the cycloaddition is unsuccessful has also been scoped: cycloaddition with dienes other than furan resulted in alternative outcomes, including Friedel Crafts cyclization. 5. The asymmetric intramolecular cycloaddition has been applied as a key step in a formal total synthesis of pseudolaric acid B, the most potent antitumour natural product isolated with tujingpi. Using this cycloaddition, an advanced intermediate in the Trost synthesis of pseudolaric acid B was synthesized in 18 steps. Besides the key step, additional synthetic challenges were overcome to achieve the formal synthesis.

17309320.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17309320.value: This cycloaddition could be used and applied to the synthesis of other bioactive natural products. More detailed computations could be done to better understand the divergence between the two classes of substrates--the geminally and vicinally tethered epoxy enolsilanes.

17309320.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17309320.value: Among the reaction tools available to the synthetic chemist, cycloadditions are significant synthetic strategies for the convergent synthesis of rings. Cycloaddition reactions that efficiently assemble polycyclic systems are particularly useful for the synthesis of natural products. Intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions are a strategy to generate polycyclic products having seven-membered rings. However, cycloaddition methods have different limitations. Our studies found that, although the intramolecular (4+3) cycloadditions of epoxides vicinally-tethered to the enolsilane and the furan failed to provide cycloadducts having perhydroazulene skeletons in good yields and selectivities, substrates with epoxides that are geminally-tethered undergo (4+3) cycloadditions efficiently and diastereoselectively to generate cycloadducts having the [5,7]-fused bicyclic frameworks. These perhydroazulene-type skeletons are found in many natural products, and the cycloadditions of these geminally-substituted epoxides fills a gap and complements the previous methodology. To demonstrate the utility of this cycloaddition, it was used as the key step in the formal total synthesis of a natural product having a perhydroazulene core, pseudolaric acid B. This is the most potent anti-tumour constituent of the traditional Chinese medicinal herb, tujingpi. A route of 18 steps was designed and employed to provide a key advanced intermediate in the Trost synthesis of pseudolaric acid B.

17309420.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309420.value: Antibiotic resistance poses one of the greatest threats to human health today. Since the discovery of penicillin over 90 years ago, antibiotics have contributed to the control of infectious diseases, decline in childhood mortality and general lifespan extension[1]. Antibiotics have also formed the cornerstone of modern medicine by enabling clinical procedures including surgery, transplantation and cancer chemotherapy[1]. However, they have also placed an immense evolutionary pressure on the microbes to resist the action of these “wonder drugs”. Over-prescription and abuse of antibiotics further accelerated the emergence and dissemination of resistance in pathogens, eventually causing our arsenal of antibiotics to dwindle. The dire situation is aggravated by the decline in antibiotics development in the pharmaceutical industry[1,2]. Without effective strategies to contain the threat, the annual toll due to antibiotic resistance is projected to rise from 700,000 today to an extremely disturbing 10 million by 2050, surpassing cancer mortality and putting a cumulative 100 trillion USD of global GDP at risk[3]. Particularly pertinent to Hong Kong as a densely populated metropolitan, the modern lifestyle, including urbanization, increased trade and travel, further boosts the worldwide spread of “superbugs”[4]. This prompted the launch of Hong Kong Strategy and Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance in 2017. Central to the plan are inter-professional efforts in optimization of the use of existing antibiotics and prevention of transmission of drug-resistant organisms through infection control[5]; the success in both areas rest on the ability to rapidly determine the profile of drug resistance in pathogens. β-Lactam represents, by far, the most prescribed family of antibiotics worldwide[6], among which the carbapenem class is often prized as “antibiotics-of-last-resort”. Being broad-spectrum and presenting fewer adverse side-effects, carbapenems are often considered safer to use than other last-line drugs such as polymyxins[7]. However in recent years, the emergence and spread of carbapenem-resistant organisms, especially outside of healthcare facilities into the community, is alarming. The production of carbapenemases, enzymes that decompose carbapenems, represents the most important mechanism of resistance clinically, since carbapenemase-encoding genes are highly transferable even across bacterial species, causing serious outbreaks, dramatically limiting treatment options and resulting in increased mortality[8‒13]. Herein, we propose to address this issue by developing sensitive, small-molecule-based fluorogenic and chemiluminogenic sensors that provide rapid and selective response towards carbapenemase activity, with the long-term goal of contributing to the toolbox that helps clinicians prescribe the optimal antibiotic in a timely fashion and healthcare workers to monitor the spread of antimicrobial resistance. 如今,抗生素耐藥性已經成為對人類健康的最大威脅之一。自從九十年前發現青黴素以來,抗生素在控制傳染性疾病,降低兒童死亡率以及提高人類平均壽命等方面做出了卓越貢獻。 同時,抗生素為手術,器官移植和癌症化療等現代醫學中臨床過程奠定了堅實的基礎。然而,隨著抗生素的廣泛使用,微生物為抵抗這些"特效藥"開始不斷進化。過度處方和濫用抗生素極大地加速了病原體體內的耐藥性的出現和傳播,甚至導致了進入無葯可用的狀態。同時,近些年醫藥工業中,許多藥廠開始退出開發新抗生素,從而使得情況更加糟糕。如果缺乏有效的策略來應對這場危機,2050年前,每年因耐藥性而死亡的人預計將從現在的七十萬人增加到一千萬人左右;在死亡人數超過癌症的同時還會造成一百萬億美元左右的經濟生產總值的損失。 香港作為一個高人口密度、現代都市化生活方式、經貿旅遊繁密的城市,會極大加快「超級細菌」傳播的速度;也極其容易使得「超級細菌」向世界擴散。因此香港特別行政區政府已於2017年推行《香港抗菌素耐藥性戰略和行動計劃》。該計劃的目標是通過跨學科的努力,以優化現有抗生素的使用並通過感染控制手段防止耐葯生物的傳播;該計劃成功的核心之一在於能否快速檢測病原體的耐藥性。 β-內醯胺類抗生素是目前世界上處方量最大的抗生素。碳青黴烯類抗生素在β-內醯胺家族中被譽為"最後的抗生素",其具有廣譜的抗菌能力和極小的副作用等優點。因此碳青黴烯被認為是比多如粘菌素類等最後一線抗生素更安全可靠。然而, 近年來，耐碳青黴烯類的細菌的出現和擴散,尤其是在醫院外的社區內的擴散傳播,為人類社會敲響了警鐘。 臨床上最重要的碳青黴烯耐藥性產生機制是通過產生能夠分解碳青黴烯並使之失活的碳青黴烯酶。因為碳青黴烯酶相關的基因在不同種類的細菌之間有極高的傳遞性,所以導致了耐藥性細菌的廣泛傳播,從而極大的限制了治療方案的選擇,導致死亡率增加。 因此,我們提出了一種通過螢光和化學發光有機小分子快速檢測碳青黴烯酶活性的方法。該有機小分子探針具有對於碳青黴烯酶選擇性高、響應速度快以及靈敏度高的優點。我們的長遠目標為發展出一些工具以協助醫生能在短時間內判斷使用合適的抗生素,以及輔助醫護監測並控制耐藥性細菌的廣泛傳播。

17309420.label: Major findings and research outcome
17309420.value: Carbapenems stand as one of the last-resort antibiotics, however their efficacy is threatened by the rising number and rapid spread of carbapenemases. Effective antimicrobial stewardship thus calls for rapid tests for these enzymes to aid appropriate prescription and infection control. We have successfully developed the first effective pan-carbapenemase reporter CARBA-H with a broad scope covering all three Ambler classes. Using a chemical biology approach, we demonstrated that the absence of the 1β-substituent in the carbapenem core is key to pan-carbapenemase recognition, which led to our rational design and probe development. CARBA-H provides a dual colorimetric-fluorogenic response upon carbapenemase-mediated hydrolysis. A clear visual readout can be obtained within 15 minutes when tested against a panel of carbapenemase-producing Enterobacteriaceae (CPE) clinical isolates that notably includes OXA-48 and OXA-181-producing strains. Furthermore, CARBA-H can be applied to the detection of carbapemenase activity in CPE-spiked urine samples.

17309420.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17309420.value: We plan to further improve the stability of CARBA-H by optimizing the protecting group for its carboxylic acid unit through a pro-drug strategy and achieve fast response in detection of clinical samples. Meanwhile, we are working with a company in Ningbo to develop a point-of-care device to be used with our probes for rapid diagnosis and antibiotics susceptibility in clinical setting.

17309420.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17309420.value: Carbapenems are a type of antibiotic reserved by medical practitioners for treating infections that resist other antibiotics. But their long-term effectiveness depends on not creating more resistant microbes. Treating an infection with an antibiotic to which the microbe is already resistant not only fails to help the patient: it can spread resistant strains in the microbe population. Doctors want to know ahead of time how the strain of an infection they are treating will respond to their dwindling arsenal of antibiotics. Yet the approved activity-based diagnostic today for carbapenem-resistance has sensitivity rates as low as 11% for an emerging resistant enzyme. Now Dan Yang and coworkers report their development of a new, pan-carpabenemase reporter, CARBA-H (DOI: 10.1021/jacs.1c00462). The team found a common feature across several carbapenems that allowed them to design their reporter to detect a wider range of resistant bacteria than before. They tested their method via rapid test assays and got clear results in 15 minutes, about an eighth the time of the only approved phenotypic test. Application in bacteria-spiked urine that mimics UTI patient samples was also successful. This could enable clinics to offer point-of-care diagnostics with less culturing time or the need for a hospital setting.

17309620.label: Project Objectives
17309620.value: Building upon our earlier success on small molecules and ions made of H and He, we will extend 3D-CNN to include methane. CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVQZ will be used to calculate the electron density function of methane. Methane will be distorted to form a series of structures, each of which will be calculated to obtain the high precision electron density. The resulting electron densities will be used to calculate their corresponding effective exchange-correlation potential via Wu-Yang method. The 3D-CNN will then be trained and validated for methane. Finally, KS-DFT/NN calculation will be carried out on methane to confirm our KS-DFT/NN applicable to methane. We will also extend 3D-CNN to treat water molecule. CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVQZ will be used to calculate the electron density function. Water molecule will be distorted to form a series of structures, each of which will be calculated to obtain the high precision electron density. The 3D-CNN will then be trained and validated for water molecule. Finally, KS-DFT/NN calculation will be carried out on methane to confirm our KS-DFT/NN applicable to water molecule. Zero-force condition will be enforced. To extend the 3D-CNN and KS-DFT/NN to organic molecules. Building upon the success of H2, He2, HeH+, CH4 and H2O, we are ready to extend our method to more complex organic molecules containing H, C and O. The dataset will be generalized to include these complex molecules or ions. As only quasi-local electron density is required, we expect that the sizes of the molecules and ions required for the dataset are limited, for instance, containing less than 10 atoms. The 3D-CNN that maps quasi-local electron density and its local exchange-correlation potential will be duly trained, validated and developed for most molecules and ions that are encountered in research and industries. We will extend further our 3D-CNN and KS-DFT/NN to treat the general organic molecules containing H, C, O, N, S, F and Cl. CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVQZ will be used to calculate the electron density, and supercomputers will be employed. Large amount of GPUs will also be used to speed up the training and validation of 3D-CNN as dataset is expected to be huge. Sufficient computing resources will be deployed.

17309620.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309620.value: 几十年来人们一直在寻找精确的密度泛函，但没有成功。为解决这个难题，我们提出一个基于深度学习的方法，这个方法原则上可以找到精确的密度泛函的等价的交换相关势。我们可以用空间一个点附近的电子密度发布决定其交换相关势值，不需要整体电子密度分布。这是基于全息电子密度定理。我们用三维CNN来求解交换相关势。简单分子的交换相关势已经被准确计算，比如H2, HeH+ and He2. 在此基础上，包含H和He较大分子的交换相关势也能计算。 在这个项目里我们计划计算复杂分子的交换相关势，包括C，H，O，N，S，F 和 Cl。训练分子应该只需最多10个原子，这使得整个项目的成功成为可能。CCSD(T)将被用来计算精确的电子密度分布，Wu-Yang方法用来计算有效势，它们的结果组成训练数据库。我们将聚焦于有机分子。

17309620.label: Realisation of objectives
17309620.value: Our research has successfully achieved the project objectives, demonstrating significant progress in extending our machine learning methodology from simple H/He systems to methane and water molecules, and further to complex organic molecules containing C, H, O, N, F, S, Li, and Cl. By replacing three-dimensional convolutional neural network (3D-CNN) with fully connected neural network (FCNN) and developing a parameter-dependent optimised effective potential (OEP) method, we achieved accurate electron density-to-potential mapping, and it demonstrated transferability across various molecular systems and non-equilibrium structures. ***Objective 1 – Extension to Methane*** Building upon our previous work with small molecules and ions composed of hydrogen (H) and helium (He), we successfully extended our approach to methane. We employed coupled cluster with single, double, and perturbative triple excitations, i.e., CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVQZ calculations to obtain high-precision electron density distributions for both equilibrium and systematically distorted methane structures. As the variations in electron density due to structural changes were captured, a robust basis for training our neural network was established. Although it is straightforward to get near-exact electron density, numerical instability was encountered with the originally proposed Wu-Yang method for calculating the exchange-correlation potential. Another commonly used method, Zhao-Morrison-Parr (ZMP) method, albeit free from numerical instability, suffers from the smoothness. After careful evaluation, we developed a parameter-dependent Hartree-corrected OEP method to generate the exact electron density and obtain near-exact, smooth exchange-correlation potentials. In total, 589,920 data points were generated in the aforementioned way. FCNN was later used to map the (quasi-) local electron density distribution to the potential at the centre of the (quasi-) local region. Notably, we revised our initial approach of using 3D-CNN after discovering their tendency to lose crucial information through pooling operations, as only the maximal output was retained during them. Instead, the FCNN implemented proved more effective at preserving data integrity and achieving accurate density-potential mapping. Our FCNN architecture consisted of 8 layers: an input layer accepting the quasi-local electron density data, 6 hidden layers each with 256 nodes, and an output layer predicting the exchange-correlation potential. Subsequent Kohn-Sham DFT/Neural Network (KS-DFT/NN) calculations confirmed the applicability of our approach to methane systems, with a negligible error of 0.012 Debye for the dipole moment. ***Objective 2 – Extension to Water*** Following the successful implementation with methane, we applied our methodology to water molecules. As with methane, we utilised CCSD(T)/aug-cc-pVQZ calculations to construct a dataset comprising 403, 680 data points. Additionally, zero-force condition was implemented, which was necessary to ensure our calculated structures represented realistic molecular states where forces on atoms are properly balanced. This additional constraint enhanced the accuracy and physical meaning of our results. A FCNN was successfully trained and validated, and KS-DFT/NN calculations demonstrated our method’s applicability to water molecule systems with an overall error of 0.011 Debye. ***Objective 3 – Extension to Basic Organic Molecules*** Building upon our success with H2, He2, HeH+, CH4, and H2O, we expanded our methodology to include more complex organic molecules containing H, C, and O. Our approach focused on molecules containing fewer than 10 atoms, allowing us to maintain computational efficiency whilst demonstrating the method’s applicability to larger systems. The FCNN effectively learned the mapping between quasi-local electron density distributions and exchange-correlation potentials for five typical molecules: CH4, H2O, HF, NH3, and C2HF. Additionally, our model demonstrated its transferability when applied to CH3OH, a molecule not in the dataset. An error of 0.029 Debye was achieved, indicating its robustness. The success amongst typical molecules validated the scalability of our approach to more complex chemical systems whilst maintaining high accuracy in electronic structure calculations. ***Objective 4 – Extension to General Organic Molecules*** In the final phase, we successfully extended our methodology to a broader range of elements, including nitrogen (N), fluorine (F), sulphur (S), lithium (Li), and chlorine (Cl). The selected molecules served as excellent test cases, representing different chemical environments and bonding patterns. For each molecule in the training set, we performed detailed calculations to obtain near-exact electron density and exchange-correlation potentials after achieving self-consistent field (SCF) convergence. Our model achieved excellent performance metrics, with a root mean square error below 0.004 a.u. for exchange-correlation potential predictions. The results confirmed the applicability of our KS-DFT/NN method to these diverse systems. Furthermore, we extended our investigation beyond equilibrium structures to include non-equilibrium configurations and dissociation limits. This comprehensive approach proved the versatility of our method in handling various molecular states and chemical scenarios, making it a robust tool for quantum chemical calculations. Overall, these achievements highlight the robustness and potential of our KS-DFT/NN model. The ability to accurately map electron density to potential using neural networks opens new avenues for future research and applications in quantum chemistry and molecular simulations. Our approach provides a powerful tool for studying complex molecular systems, enabling researchers to gain deeper insights into their electronic properties and behaviour. In conclusion, we have successfully achieved all four objectives, implementing several strategic improvements to enhance the robustness and reliability of our methodology. The shift from 3D-CNN to FCNN and the development of a new Hartree-corrected OEP method represent significant advances over our initial proposal. These modifications have resulted in a more stable and reliable computational approach, capable of handling a diverse range of molecular systems whilst maintaining high accuracy in potential and energy calculations. Moving forward, we will continue to refine and expand our methodology, exploring new applications and integrating with other computational techniques. By making our model more accessible to the research community and addressing current challenges, we aim to drive further advancements in the field and unlock new possibilities for scientific discovery and technological innovation. The methodology we have developed shows promise for applications in various fields, from basic research in quantum chemistry to practical applications in materials science and drug discovery. The demonstrated transferability and ability to handle non-equilibrium structures make our approach particularly valuable for real-world applications in chemical research and industry.

17309620.label: Major findings and research outcome
17309620.value: In this research, we established a map from exact electron density to near-exact exchange-correlation (XC) potential for molecules containing C, H, O, N, F, S, Li, and Cl, by combining the Hartree-corrected OEP method with machine learning techniques. Our key findings comprise: 1. Hartree-Corrected OEP Method: We developed a parameter-dependent OEP method based on the Hartree potential to generate near-exact electron densities whilst ensuring smooth XC potentials. This method demonstrates superior performance compared to conventional OEP methods, such as Wu-Yang and ZMP approaches, particularly in numerical stability and potential smoothness—characteristics crucial for neural network training. 2. FCNN-Based Training and Validation: To overcome the information loss inherent in conventional CNNs, we implemented a fully connected neural network (FCNN). Whilst standard CNNs employ sequential convolution and pooling operations that sacrifice local density information, FCNNs maintain their structure-agnostic nature, ensuring broader applicability. We validated our model using five archetypal molecules: CH4, H2O, HF, NH3, and C2HF. The results confirmed the efficacy of our KS-DFT/NN method, yielding near-exact electron density and approximate Hartree-corrected OEP XC potential after SCF convergence. The model demonstrated notable transferability through successful application to CH3OH—a molecule absent from the training dataset. Further validation encompassed non-equilibrium structures and dissociation limits, substantiating the method’s versatility. 3. Extended KS-DFT/NN Calculations: We expanded our validation to encompass ten molecules containing multiple elements (C, H, O, N, F, S, Li, and Cl). The computational demands of this extensive dataset necessitated the use of a high-performance computing cluster equipped with eight A100 GPU cards, enabling efficient parallel processing for training and validation. The successful implementation of KS-DFT/NN calculations across this diverse molecular set, including species such as LiH, further corroborated our neural network model’s capability to accurately predict XC potentials from electron densities across varied molecular systems and configurations. This work represents a significant advancement in the development of robust neural network models for XC potential prediction from electron densities. The integration of the Hartree-corrected OEP method ensures numerical stability and potential smoothness, whilst the FCNN architecture preserves essential local density information. These developments hold considerable promise for computational modelling in quantum chemistry, particularly for complex molecular systems, non-equilibrium structures, and dissociation limits.

17309620.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17309620.value: Our previous studies have shown that fully connected neural networks (FCNN) can effectively map (quasi-)local electron density distributions to exchange-correlation (XC) potentials. However, this approach cannot compute absolute energies directly and relies on force integration for relative molecular energies, making results dependent on numerical integration accuracy. We propose a new method to calculate absolute XC energies by mapping electron density to XC energy density using an extended FCNN framework. Neural networks are ideal for this due to their automatic differentiation capabilities, allowing direct derivation of XC potentials from XC energy. This approach promises to overcome the limitations of current methods while maintaining computational efficiency. The model will map (quasi-)local electron density to XC energy density at region centres. Integrating the predicted energy density provides absolute XC energies, whilst automatic differentiation yields XC potentials for Kohn-Sham DFT calculations. We will develop comprehensive training datasets across diverse molecular systems and validate the model against high-accuracy quantum chemical calculations. Applications to complex molecular systems will demonstrate the methodology’s effectiveness and advance neural network integration in quantum chemistry. The successful implementation of this approach will significantly enhance our ability to perform accurate quantum chemical calculations at reduced computational cost.

17309620.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17309620.value: Our research advances computational methods in quantum chemistry by improving the accuracy and efficiency of molecular modelling, specifically focusing on exchange-correlation (XC) potentials—a critical component in quantum mechanical calculations. We developed a novel approach that combines the Hartree-corrected optimized effective potential method with machine learning techniques, specifically, fully connected neural networks. Traditional methods for calculating XC potentials often struggle with numerical instability and computational efficiency. Our approach overcomes these limitations by implementing a more robust mathematical framework coupled with modern machine learning architectures. We validated the method using a diverse set of molecular systems, including common molecules like methane, water, and ammonia, demonstrating both accuracy and transferability. Using high-performance computing resources with GPU acceleration, we successfully extended our calculations to include molecules containing various elements (C, H, O, N, F, S, Li, and Cl). The method proved particularly effective in handling complex molecular systems and non-equilibrium states. This advancement significantly improves the practical application of quantum chemical calculations, offering potential benefits for materials science, pharmaceutical research, and energy technology development. The increased accuracy and computational efficiency make it a valuable tool for both theoretical studies and practical applications in chemistry and materials science.

17500220.value: Provide a theoretical framework to understand the incentives behind tutoring and other costly activities aimed at influencing selective admissions systems. 17500220.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17500220.value: 在世界範圍內,付費補習已成為學生們提高考試成績以博取心儀學校錄取機會的普遍途徑之一。 批評者們擔憂課餘補習會佔用學生們在學校教育以外的時間與精力,最終只能提高學生們的考試成績而非真正的才能。 考慮到每個家庭的經濟水準不同,若此類補習課程成為普遍現象,作為教育系統選拔真正才能的錄取系統也許會喪失其公允性。 在本研究專案中,我們試圖通過建立一個理論框架來分析補習以及相類似的旨在影響錄取系統結果的活動背後的激勵機制。 不同於傳統的信號理論和信號干擾理論,由於學校的錄取名額有限,參與補習的回報取決於有多少其他學生同樣在參與補習。 本文的研究重心在於判斷學生參與課外補習的決定呈現戰略互補還是戰略替代關係。 初步研究結果顯示,參與課外補習的決定並不是純粹的合作博弈,因此在該博弈中兩種關係並存。 普遍看法認為課外補習是由於學校錄取名額的競爭越發激烈所導致,而本文與之相反,認為如果增加學校錄取率可能會適得其反,導致更多的教育資源浪費。 我們計劃進一步研究家庭收入分佈會如何影響課外輔導的均衡水準,學生的福利和錄取系統的分辨能力。 同時,我們也會研究建立以學生能力排序的錄取系統如何影響不同學校學生參與補習的程度,並探討競爭機制是否會導致家長在孩子教育的初期就開始安排課外輔導活動。 通過加強對課外補習背後激勵機制的理解,本專案希望能夠提供更有力的政策支援以打擊和控制過度輔導,設計更有效的錄取機制以抵禦潛在的操縱可能。

17500220.label: Realisation of objectives
17500220.value: We have built a model of selection in which a fixed quota of university places are to be allocated to students. The selection system prefers to admit students with high ability, but student ability is not directly observable. Only test outcomes are observable, and test outcomes can be manipulated through investments in "signal jamming." In other words, our work views tutoring as a signal jamming activity which is not directly productive (in terms of enhancing student ability) but which may successfully enhance the prospects of success in getting a student into university. An important aspect of our research is that a student's incentive to get tutoring depends on the extent to which tutoring is chosen by other students. The number of university places is fixed. If tutoring is not prevalent to begin with, then those who choose not to obtain tutoring still has a realistic chance of getting admitted. When more students begin to get tutoring, the probability of admission for such students is diminished, therefore prompting such students to also get tutoring in order to improve their chances. In other words, tutoring can be like a "rat race" where one chooses it lest those left behind have no realistic chances. On the other hand, suppose tutoring is already very common among students. Then even one who has invested in tutoring cannot be guaranteed a place in the university. When more students get tutoring in this case, this reduces everyone's prospect of being selected even if she gets good test results. Hence the payoff from signal jamming falls and it discourages people from getting tutoring. Our research finds that tutoring exhibits strategic complementarity when it is not very prevalent, but it exhibits strategic substitution when it is already very common. Based on this model, we derive comparative statics results concerning factors that may affect the extent of tutoring, and study the effects of tutoring on selection outcomes. A novel finding is that as the number of places available for admission increases, the extent of tutoring can increase (rather than decrease). The reason is that when competition for university places is very intense, lessening competition actually raises the payoff from tutoring because it increases the chances that a student with good test results will get a place in university. This would therefore attract more students to choose tutoring in equilibrium. We further use this model to shed light on the practice of "ability sorting." One may think of ability-sorting as a two-stage selection system in which some students are first selected into selective high schools, after which all students compete for entry into college. Under such a system, the university can rely on an additional signal, namely whether a student has got into a selective or non-selective high school, to guide its admissions decisions. The two-stage model brings out several interesting results. First, though a selective high school is able to select a better pool of students, it also selects students with lower tutoring costs. As a result, at the university entrance stage, gaming incentives are higher (because manipulation is more credible when there are indeed more high-ability students) while the costs are lower, and students from the selective school will game the university entrance examination more intensely than those from the non-selective high school. Second, the greater extent of manipulation in the selective school neutralizes its initial advantage in the quality of its student pool, so that in equilibrium students who get admitted into university are equally likely to be high-ability students regardless of which high school they come from. In other words, high school affiliation is after all not informative to the university conditional on the second-stage test score, and the final selection outcome for the university only depends on the extent of gaming in the first stage. Third, despite the equilibrium uninformativeness of high school affiliation and the university’s sole objective of maximizing student quality, the university treats students from the selective school (who tend to be rich kids with low tutoring costs) more favorably. An outcome in which student quality is the same in both high schools and the university treats their students symmetrically is not stable, because small differences in the initial quality of the two schools would trigger competition to get into the school with the initial advantage, which in turn would amplify the initial difference in quality. The favorable treatment by the university creates a rent from entering the selective school and causes gaming to unravel to the first stage of the selection process. Our model has a number of policy implications: (1) Increasing the enrollment size can increase the payoff from gaming, and hence cause more students to engage in gaming. (2) Abolishing university entrance examinations would intensify gaming activity targeting the earlier tests (such as high school entrance examinations or high school course grades), and as a result the average quality of the university’s admitted students would be lower. (3) Abolishing ability-sorting in the high school system worsens the university’s selection outcome when the cost structures of gaming the high school test and gaming the university test are the same. However, substantially more resources can be wasted on tutoring under high-school ability-sorting. (4) The university may select better students by committing to a lower-powered admissions policy that is suboptimal ex post but that will mitigate the extent of gaming.

17500220.label: Major findings and research outcome
17500220.value: We model unproductive gaming activities as improving students’ observable test outcomes without affecting their true ability. Because these gaming activities work by distorting the information available to an admissions system, a main theme of our analysis is how informational externalities affect the equilibrium level of gaming and equilibrium admissions outcome. Students can have either high ability or low ability and they also have different costs of gaming the test. A university has limited capacity and prefers to select high-ability students. It does not directly observe students’ abilities but only their test scores, which can be improved by costly gaming. We show that tutoring activities can be strategic complements or strategic substitutes among students, but strategic substitution prevails when competition for university places is intense. This follows because the capacity limit causes diminishing returns to set in as many students get artificially high test scores through gaming. One implication is that a policy that aims to lessen the competition by increasing the university capacity can increase the payoff from gaming, and hence causes more students to engage in this activity. We use this framework to study a number of policy issues: abolishing the university test, eliminating high school distinctions, or more broadly committing to admission policies that are not necessarily ex post optimal. Abolishing the university test increases gaming in the early stage and reduces the quality in-take for the university. Eliminating sorting in high school can create better selection outcome only if the cost of early-stage gaming is sufficiently lower than the cost of late-stage gaming. Moreover, the university can improve the selection outcome by committing to a lower-powered scheme that differentiates students with different expected ability less because it would induce less gaming. The analysis of our research and its policy implications are described in our paper, "Gaming a selective admissions system." This paper has been accepted for publication at International Economic Review.

17500220.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17500220.value: One of the more interesting findings that comes out of this research is that the incentive to invest in tutoring can unravel to earlier and earlier stages of the educational progression. This aspect of tutoring is potentially damaging to young children: parents' incentive to give their children a "head start" by exposing them to tutoring at very young age can create a lot of stress and stifle creativity. It may also reduce intergenerational mobility if such strategy indeed works. Although our model can explain the unraveling of tutoring incentives, it also suggests that the advantage conferred by a "head start" diminishes at earlier stages. Our model therefore does not explain why parents are willing to spend so much resources on tutoring at very young ages. Some kind of amplification mechanism is needed to account for this pattern. Identifying the amplification mechanism and understanding its implications will be a fruitful avenue for research.

17500220.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17500220.value: Information manipulation is common in many aspects of life when the information collected has implications for resource allocation. Creative accounting, fake product reviews, and credit score management are among the more important examples. In this project, we focus on information manipulation in college admissions, partly because of its significance to students and their families, and partly because private tutoring for test preparation is such a pervasive feature of the education system, especially in Asia where high-stakes testing plays a prominent role in resource allocation in education. We use a model to study policies that have been proposed to combat inefficient gaming in college admissions. Increasing university enrollment size can exacerbate gaming and worsen the selection outcome. Abolishing standardized tests for university admissions increases gaming targeting high school admissions and worsens the selection outcome, while eliminating high-school ability sorting may improve the university selection outcome under some cost conditions of gaming. Committing to a lower-powered selection scheme can improve the selection outcome by reducing gaming behaviors.
