17617620.label: Project Objectives
17617620.value: To develop a highly-accessible, personalised intervention to provide timely psychological support to stroke family caregivers; Despite the availability of both private and government-subsidised support services in Hong Kong (HK), stroke caregivers experience barriers to accessing these services. Existing services are mainly centre-based services, which are less accessible to stroke family caregivers who either continue to work, care for their patients full-time, or live in rural areas. Additionally, caregivers need to pay for access to private services, while government-subsidised services are limited compared to the demand and tend to have long waiting lists. Without timely access to psychological support services, stroke family caregivers can feel increasingly isolated and their psychological distresses will go unmanaged, negatively affecting their ability to provide stroke care. In this research, the proposed intervention will be delivered through instant messaging applications (e.g. WhatsApp) according to their preferences. As mobile device penetrance in HK is high, most caregivers will be able to access psychological support as and when they need it, from any location they might be in. Access barriers to psychological support are thus minimised, increasing its practical implications. Moreover, as there is no need for a separate platform to deliver the intervention as instant messaging applications are used, costs incurred in the development of the proposed intervention will be minimal. This enhances the cost-effectiveness and scalability of the proposed interventions. To carry out a randomised controlled trial (RCT) to determine the effectiveness of the proposed intervention in reducing stroke family caregivers’ psychological distress; The number of stroke caregivers required to provide care in the community is rising due to a growing number of stroke survivors in the context of global ageing populations and improved mortality rates. The WHO has recommended provision of caregiver support in combating the challenges of ageing populations. In HK, where there is a significant ageing population, stroke caregivers are dominantly family members. Stroke family caregivers undergo a lot of psychological distress additional to the physical burdens of caregiving, such as cultural expectations, financial burdens, societal pressures and emotional strain. Recent local studies have shown that a significant number of family caregivers experience depressive symptoms and are at high risk of burnout. This can lead to poorer health outcomes for both stroke patients and caregivers, resulting in increased total hospitalisations and therefore, increased health burden. In this research, stroke family caregivers will receive support and learn how to self-manage their psychological distresses, thereby enhancing the sustainability of the effects of the intervention. Through a RCT research design, the effectiveness of the proposed intervention in reducing psychological distress can be determined by comparing the outcomes between the Intervention group and the Control group. Establishing the effectiveness of the intervention will have implications for practical application in service delivery and facilitate policy development. To generate evidence on an innovative brief psychological support intervention; iCBT as a psychological intervention and EMI as an intervention framework have both individually been proven as effective strategies to support psychological well-being, however they have rarely been used together. The proposed intervention is designed as an innovative approach of brief psychological intervention, an approach recommended by the WHO to ensure intervention scalability. By delivering brief iCBT through EMI, caregivers receive personalised psychological support in the form of informative text messages, and real-time chat-based services. This is the first research that will investigate and evaluate the delivery of iCBT through EMI for family caregivers to stroke patients. We will also conduct cost-effective analysis of the iCBT-based EMI to produce evidence of its practical applicability. This pioneer research will be a valuable opportunity to generate evidence of a novel intervention that can be utilised for further research and practical applications. To inform future research design on EMI through post-trial qualitative interviews; Due to the novelty of the proposed intervention (i.e., iCBT-based EMI), we will qualitatively explore stroke family caregivers’ experiences of intervention including their compliance of the intervention. The findings will be used to further improve the proposed intervention, accordingly maximising its effectiveness. The understanding of how caregivers adjust and use the psychological intervention (i.e., caregivers’ compliance to the intervention) will also inform other mobile intervention projects in HK and globally targeting not only stroke caregivers, but all caregivers to patients with long-term care needs (e.g., dementia and cancer).

17617620.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17617620.value: Many stroke patients require long-term care in the community. In Hong Kong (HK), most stroke caregivers in the community are family members, and many require psychological support for caregiver stress. However, along with existing studies, our pilot survey showed that these caregivers have difficulties accessing existing centre-based services due to varying work and care responsibilities, and therefore require alternative support services to meet their unique needs and schedules. Evidence shows that internet-delivered cognitive behavioural therapy (iCBT) is effective in managing psychological distress including depressive symptoms, especially when guided by healthcare professionals. Ecological momentary intervention (EMI) is an innovative and cost-effective intervention ‘framework’ that utilises mobile messages to deliver personalised psychological interventions. The proposed trial aims to deliver iCBT-based EMI through instant messaging applications (e.g. WhatsApp) to provide personalised and real-time psychological support led by nurses. No similar trial has been found in PubMed, Cochrane Library or Clinicaltrials.gov, except for our pilot feasibility trial (NCT04143763). Screened stroke caregivers with Patient Health Questionnaire-9 (PHQ-9) scores ranging from 5 to 19 (mild to moderately severe depressive symptoms) will be recruited from community centres, rehabilitation centres and outpatient clinics in HK. They will then be individually randomised into the Intervention group (n=128) or Control group (n=128). The Intervention group will receive the iCBT-based EMI for 12 weeks, which includes instant messages sent at the times and frequencies of the participants’ choosing, and chat-based psychological support led by nurses to enhance effects of iCBT through real-time counselling and practical advice. The control group will only receive instant messages on general mental health information and reminders to participate in follow-up surveys. The primary outcome is PHQ-9 scores at 24 weeks. Secondary outcomes will include anxiety, perceived stress, caregiver burden, caring experience, spiritual well-being and quality-of-daily-life. We will strictly follow the CONSORT-EHEALTH checklist. A post-trial qualitative study will be conducted to understand the participants’ experience of and compliance with the EMI. This trial will provide the first evidence on the effectiveness of iCBT-based EMI for reducing psychological distress in stroke caregivers in HK and elsewhere. The intervention will be highly applicable for all caregivers requiring psychological support and will be one step further in meeting the World Health Organization’s recommendations in supporting caregivers in the context of global ageing populations. Abstract 摘要 社區中有很多需要長期照顧的中風患者。在香港社區中，大部分中風患者的照顧者為患者的家庭成員，當中有許多需要心理支援以緩解照顧壓力。可是，連同現有的研究，我們的先導計劃問卷調查結果顯示由於這些照顧者需要應付不同工作與照顧上的責任，尋求服務單位協助對照顧者尤為困難。因此，他們需要能夠符合他們獨特需要及日程的支援服務。 證據顯示線上傳遞的認知行為治療（iCBT）能有效處理情緒困擾，包括抑鬱症狀，而其效果則在專業醫護人員的引導下更佳。生態瞬間介入（EMI）是一個創新及具成本效益的介入「框架」，其內容為透過手提電話訊息傳遞個人化的心理治療。本計劃旨在透過即時通訊軟件（例如：WhatsApp）傳遞建基於線上認知行為治療的生態瞬間介入，以及由護士提供個人化及實時心理支援。除卻我們的先導計劃（NCT04143763），PubMed、Cochrane Library 或 Clinicaltrials.gov上並沒有類似的試驗。 我們將從香港的社區中心、康復中心及門診招募參加者。在病人健康狀況問卷-9（PHQ-9）中得到5-19分（輕微至中度抑鬱徵狀）的中風患者照顧者將被邀請參與本計劃。然後他們分別會被隨機分配到試驗組（n=128）或對照組（n=128）。試驗組會接受為期12星期建基於線上認知行為治療的生態瞬間介入，當中訊息傳遞的時間及頻率將以參加者的偏好為依據。護士將傳遞以聊天為基礎的心理支援，以通過提供實時諮詢及實際建議提升線上認知行為治療的效果。對照組僅會接收到一般心理健康資訊和提醒參與後續問卷調查的訊息。本項研究的主要指標為參加者在第24週時的病人健康狀況問卷-9分數。次要指標則包括焦慮、感知壓力、照顧者負擔、護理經驗，靈性安適及生活質素。我們會嚴格跟從CONSORT-EHEALTH的指引。為了解參加者的生態瞬間介入使用體驗及其依從性，我們會在試驗完成後進行一項質性研究。 本項試驗研究會為建基於線上認知行為治療的生態瞬間介入對減輕香港與各地中風患者照顧者的情緒困擾的成效提供首個證據。此項介入將高度適用於所有需要心理支援的照顧者，並將更符合世界衛生組織（WHO）提出在全球人口老齡化的情況下支援照顧者的建議。

17618320.value: 綠色建築認證（GBC）旨在通過向客戶傳達建築物的綠色信息，從而使他們能夠做出更明智的決定，來提高建築物的可持續性。信譽良好的第三方認證還可協助政府制定政策，以促進綠色建築的發展，從而創造可持續的生活環境。 以前的大多數研究發現具有GBC的辦公樓比沒有辦公樓的租金/價格更高（綠色建材溢價或GBP）。 為什麼存在這種溢價的研究卻不多。其中一個原因是，許多大公司的企業社會責任（CSR）政策都要求租用物業必需有綠色認証。可是，其他因素，例如環境意識，實際收益（節省能源和維護成本），營銷策略等也可能是促成因素。 研究住宅綠色認証可以消除CSR效應的影響，這使我們可以研究GBP的成恩。在研究住宅市場GBP的少數研究中，他們的主要重點是估算平均GBP，而沒有分析此類溢價的根本成因。通過檢視GBP的時空變化，我們可以推斷出GBP的成因。 從實用的角度來看， GBP的時間變化對用戶，開發商，政策制定者和評級機構的角度來看很重要。對於用戶而言，GBP隨時間增加（或不減少）表明GBC不僅僅是開發高營銷工具。對於開發商而言，GBP趨勢可以幫助他們做出有關綠色建築的開發和投資決策。對於政府而言，GBP趨勢的下降表明，推廣相關的GBC可能不值得。對於評級機構，GBP的下降趨勢可能表明需要重新評估GBC的評估工具的有效性。 這項研究還調查了經濟狀況較好的家庭是否更願意支付更高的GBP。 結果將有助製定促進綠色建築政策，評估GBC的有效性以及做出房地產投資/開發決策具有重要意義。 儘管住宅建築總存量巨大，但有關綠色住宅建築的研究卻很少。例如，在香港，住宅建築物的總建築面積約佔所有類型建築物總建築面積的80％以上。 “由於建築物總存量龐大，建築物的可持續性的小幅改善可能會對溫室氣體排放和經濟中的能源效率產生重大影響”（Eichholtz，Kok和Quigley，2013年）。因此，在住宅市場研究GBP的另一個重要原因是對環境的潛在的長遠影響。

17618320.label: Realisation of objectives
17618320.value: The objectives have been achieved by a review of related studies, formulation of the hypotheses in relation to each objective, design procedures for testing the hypotheses. Finally, data are collected and validated to test the hypotheses. The procedures for testing the hypotheses involve estimating the following hedonic price models with transaction prices of residential units in green (treatment) and comparable non-green (control) buildings. Two method of matching the green and non-green building pairs are used, i.e. Propensity Score Matching (PSM) and Mahalanobis Distance Matching (MDM) procedures for cross validating the results. For objective 1, the following hedonic price model is estimated: lnP= α0 + α1*GREEN+ βX+ ∑γm*Dm+ ∑δn*Tn +ε The dependent variable lnP denotes the natural log of the transaction price. GREEN, which is a dummy variable for HK-BEAM-certified residential buildings. X denotes an array of control variables including salable floor area (SFA), floor level (FL), building age on the transaction date (AGE), whether there is clubhouse in the development (CLUBHOUSE), whether the walking distance from the building to the nearest MTR exit is within 15 min (MTR), monthly household income (INCOME), the median of population age (MEDIAN_AGE), and the number of males per 1000 females (SEX_RATIO). Data for the Control variables INCOME, MEDIAN_AGE, and SEX_RATIO are obtained from the 2016 Population By-Census released by the Census and Statistics Department of Hong Kong. Dm and Tn are location and time dummies, subscript m denotes district m, subscript n denotes transaction time n, and ε is the error term. The data sample includes 36,605 (PSM procedure) and 33,125 (MDM procedures) over the period 2003 and 2022 have been collected. Objective 1 is achieved by estimating the coefficient of Green which show the Green Building Premium in residential properties. The results show that residential properties with green building certification (GBC) are transacted with a green building premium (GBP), i.e. at higher prices compared with similar properties without GBC. The results are similar for both matching procedures. Therefore objective 1 is achieved. For objective 2, the following hedonic price model is estimated: lnP= α0 + α1*GREEN+α2*GREEN*TIME+ βX+ ∑γm*Dm+ ∑δn*Tn +ε where TIME is number of years from 2003 (the earlies transaction year in the sample) to the year of the transaction. Objective 1 is achieved by estimating the coefficient of GREEN*(TIME) which show the time trend of the GBP. The results show that a2 is positive which suggest that the GBP has increase over time, i.e. the GBP can sustain in the long run. The results are similar for both matching procedures. Therefore objective 2 is achieved. For objective 3, the following hedonic price model is estimated: lnP= α0 + α1*GREEN+α2*GREEN*HI+ρHI+ βX+ ∑γm*Dm+ ∑δn*Tn +ε where HI is a dummy variable for the buildings located in high-income areas which are defined as areas with average household incomes above the territory-wide median level. The coefficient of GREEN*HI shows the average difference in GBP in high- and low-income areas, which is positive as estimated from our data sample using both the PSM and MDM procedure for selecting matching pairs. The results suggest that financially better off households are willing to pay a higher GBP. Therefore objective 3 is achieved. For objective 4, the following hedonic price model is estimated: lnP= α0 + ∑αg*GREENg + ρHI+ βX+ ∑γm*Dm+ ∑δn*Tn +ε where GREENg is the level of GBC as defined by the BEAM-Plus grades (i.e. Platinum, Gold, Silver and Bronze) which correspond to different level of greenness. The coefficients of GREENg show the GBP achieved for different level of GBC. The empirical results show that the GBP of different levels of GBC are not significantly different from each other, i.e. the GBP are similar for all levels of GBC. The results are similar using both PSM and MDM procedures for selection matching pairs. Therefore objective 4 is achieved. This model was estimated before testing the hypotheses related to objective 2 and 3 so that there was no need to differentiate different levels of GBC when testing these hypotheses. The above testing procedures and results are presented / published conference and journal papers

17618320.label: Major findings and research outcome
17618320.value: Objective 1: To investigate whether residential properties with green building certification (GBC) are transacted with a green building premium (GBP), i.e., at higher prices compared with similar properties without GBC. Findings: Residential properties are, on average, transacted at a higher price when controlling for all known factors affecting residential prices. This indicates the presence of a Green Building Premium (GBP) in residential properties. Unlike commercial properties, where institutional constraints such as Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) policies may compel organizations to occupy non-green buildings, the GBP observed in the residential market is entirely voluntary. Objective 2: Objective 2: To examine whether the GBP can sustain in the long run. Findings: The GBP is not only stable over time but is actually increasing. Therefore, the residential GBP can be sustained in the long run. Objective 3: Objective 3: To test whether financially better-off households are willing to pay a higher GBP. Findings: High-income households, on average, pay a higher GBP (as a percentage of housing prices) than lower-income households. This supports the prosperity or affluence hypothesis. Objective 4: Objective 3: To investigate the relationship between GBP and the corresponding level of GBC, which measures the level of greenness of a building. Findings: There is no significant difference in GBP between different levels of GBC. This may suggest that the fine grading of greenness according to the HK-BEAM plus assessment method may not be that useful in differentiating the level of greenness from a consumer’s perspective.

17618320.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17618320.value: The further development of this research will involve conducting similar studies in various cities that possess different characteristics. This approach aims to determine whether the results can be generalized across diverse urban environments. If generalization proves challenging, we will explore the reasons behind these differences, focusing on factors such as city-specific attributes, building types, demographic variations, and institutional characteristics. Additionally, we will examine the impact of different green building assessment methods on these outcomes. One area that warrants further investigation is the insensitivity of the Green Building Performance (GBP) metrics to the level of Green Building Certification (GBC). The HK-BEAM Plus assessment method, which evaluates the greenness of the production process, may not be a primary concern for property buyers. To address this, we propose the development of a sub-score GBC that excludes the greenness assessment scores related to the construction phase. This would allow us to focus on the occupancy greenness of buildings and assess whether the GBP is more responsive to these scores. By isolating the occupancy-related metrics, we can gain insights into how the perceived greenness of a building as indicated by the occupancy sub-scores influences its overall performance and market appeal.

17618320.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17618320.value: The results of this study show that green buildings (buildings that have green certifications) offer both tangible and intangible benefits to buyers. People are willing to pay more for green buildings, even when they don't have to because of company rules about being socially responsible. However, we found that there is not a big difference in how much people are willing to pay for different levels of green certifications. We found that higher-income individuals are especially willing to pay more for green buildings because they tend to care more about the environment, which is consistent with the theories suggesting that as people earn more, they become more aware of environmental issues. The study also revealed that people's willingness to pay for green building has not decreased over time, which means the extra cost is backed by long-term real benefits. The growing willingness to pay more for green buildings suggests that promoting green certifications is a smart move.

17618420.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618420.value: For millennia philosophers have debated the nature of our concept of truth. Can it be defined in terms of correspondence to a mind-independent reality, or perhaps in terms of coherence with one's total set of beliefs? Or does the concept of truth resist such definition altogether, either because it is a foundational concept that helps to define, but is not defined by, other concepts, or because it's a philosophical mistake to think truth is the sort of thing that needs such a definition? Far less attention has been paid to the question of what it is for a rational agent to possess a concept of truth, and therefore what the psychological implications are for when such an agent does or doesn't have the concept of truth. What are the empirical marks of someone possessing a concept of truth? What cognitive functions does such a concept enable one to perform? How does truth relate to various psychological states, such as belief and desire? And how does our relationship to truth affect our reaction to and interpretation of notions such as political propaganda? This project is an exploration into some of the under-explored questions that connect the philosophy of truth with cognitive psychology. The focus is on three questions: (1) How and when is a concept of truth acquired by a cognitive agent? (2) What is the relationship between psychological states such as belief and desire and the concept of truth? (3) How does the concept of truth relate to the nature of propaganda and influence the mind's reaction to it? In sum, this project builds on a longstanding body of theoretical work that has explored the nature of the concept of truth, and then seeks to apply it in more and more practical and concrete ways: first by seeing how the concept gets into our minds, then how it relates to other states of our minds, and then how it influences external information presented to our minds. My goal is to offer a broader account of not just what the concept of truth is, but how it plays a vital role in our psychological makeup.

17618620.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618620.value: Background: China’s past four decades of urbanization have created a massive 40.51 million left-behind children, many of whom live in rural hometowns with grandparents while their parents have migrated to work elsewhere. Extensive literature has found significantly higher mental health risks among these left-behind children than their peers, and the most commonly identified risk factors are their separation with parents and lack of parental care. Recent child mental health research has shifted its focus from vulnerability to resilience, stressing resources and strengths of children and their social environments. However, literature on Chinese left-behind children remains heavily focused on the risk brought by parental migration, while the potentially protective effect of grandparenting, which plays crucial roles in Chinese family culture, is rarely explored. Current research also primarily uses cross-sectional studies with large samples, while more focused, longitudinal data collection is needed. Method: This mixed-methods study will investigate whether and how grandparenting promotes Chinese left-behind children’s resilience and mental health, and test the mediating role of resilience. In Phase-I, 640 primary-school-age left-behind children will be recruited from Sichuan Province for a two-wave panel study over 12 months. Children and their grandparent will complete measures of grandparenting-related factors (grandparent-grandchild attachment, grandparent active coping, and grandparent’s own social support), child resilience, and child mental health (anxiety, depressive symptoms, loneliness, and subjective well-being), while controlling for risk factors (e.g. duration of parent-child separation) and potential confounding protective factors (e.g. peer support). We hypothesize that: 1) greater grandparent-grandchild attachment, active grandparent coping, and greater social support of grandparents predict higher resilience and better mental health in left-behind children; 2) resilience mediates the effects of grandparenting on child mental health. Phase-II seeks deeper understanding of the meaning of being raised by grandparents to left-behind children, and how grandparenting protects or promotes child well-being in daily family life. A total of 80 children who show either very high or very low resilience, or significant changes in resilience scores, will be invited for semi-structured interviews. Their primary grandparental caregiver will also be recruited as secondary informants. Content and thematic analysis will be used to look for emerging patterns. Significance: this study will investigate the protective effects of grandparenting in families with left-behind children, challenging the current focus on risks associated with grandparenting. We also explore how grandparenting fosters child resilience. The findings will provide further research directions and service recommendations to promote Chinese left-behind children’s mental well-being. 中國過去四十年的城市化進程中已出现了四千萬留守兒童，其中許多人與祖父母住在農村故鄉，而父母已移居到其他地区工作。大量文獻發現這些留守兒童的心理健康風險明顯高於他們的同伴，最常見的风险因素是與父母的分離、缺乏父母照顧。最近的兒童心理健康研究已經將其重點從脆弱性轉向了抗逆力，強調兒童及其社會環境的資源和優勢。然而，關於中國留守兒童的文獻仍然高度關注父母迁移所帶來的風險，而在中國家庭文化中起著至關重要的祖父母的潛在保護作用则少有探究。目前的研究也主要使用對大樣本的橫斷面研究，需要更聚焦的縱向數據收集。這項混合方法研究將調查祖父母是否以及如何促進中國留守兒童的抗逆力和心理健康，並測試抗逆力的中介作用。第一階段將從四川省招募640名小學適齡留守兒童，進行為期12個月的兩期追踪调查。儿童及其祖父母將回答與祖父母抚养相關的因素（祖父母與孫子女的依戀，祖父母的積極應對以及祖父母自身的社會支持等），孩子的抗逆力和孩子的心理健康（焦慮，抑鬱症狀，孤獨感和主觀幸福感）的測量，同時控制風險因素（例如親子分離的持續時間）和潛在的其他保護因素（例如同伴支持）。我們假設：1）祖父母與孫子女之間的依戀程度提高，祖父母的積極應對能力越强、以及祖父母的社會支持越多时，可以預測留守兒童的抗逆力和心理健康水平較高； 2）抗逆力可調節祖父母抚养對兒童心理健康的影響。第二階段尋求對祖父母撫養留守兒童的意義的更深了解，以及祖父母如何在日常家庭生活中保護或促進孩子的幸福。我们將邀請在追踪调查中表現出非常高、或非常低的抗逆力、或抗逆力分數顯著變化的兒童參加半結構式訪談。他們的主要祖父母照顧者也將被招募為补充访谈对象。這項研究將調查祖父母對留守兒童家庭的保護作用，挑戰當前對祖父母抚养相關風險的關注。我們還將探討祖父母如何提高兒童的適應能力。研究結果將提供進一步的研究方向和服務建議，以促進中國留守兒童的心理健康。

17618820.label: Realisation of objectives
17618820.value: Part 1. A qualitative study to explore the sustainable cues that are valued by participants when making sustainable food choice Hong Kong adults were recruited for the in-depth interviews. Subjects were recruited through community outreach. Purposive sampling was employed to maximize the heterogeneity of participants’ background and gain diverse views regarding the research topics. The in-depth interviews were audio-recorded and conducted one to one, over phone or face to face in 2021. Eventually, a total of 30 in-depth interviews were completed to reach data saturation. The qualitative data were transcribed verbatim, and all transcripts were coded independently by two researchers using QSR NVivo 12.0. All codes were constantly compared for similarities and differences and finally to develop themes related to public understanding about the linkages between food choice and environmental sustainability, and sustainable cues that facilitate sustainable food choices. Part 2. A randomized controlled trial nested within a discrete choice experiment Part 2 was a discrete choice experiment (DCE) to further measure the relative importance of these sustainability cues and their importance relatives to food price and taste. A randomized controlled trial was embedded to allocate participants into four groups: the control, health-benefit priming (HP), environmental-benefit priming (EP), and co-benefit priming (CP), before completing the DCE tasks, to test whether priming can change the relative importance of the sustainability cues. We also tested the modification effects of social orientation values on the priming effects in this part. Subjects were recruited by a local public poll institute from their online panel. We used quota sampling to ensure that quota of subjects sampled from each stratum of sex, age group (18-34 years, 35-54 years and ≥55 years) and educational attainment were comparable to the 2021 census data. Subjects were invited to participate in the survey via a message delivered to their mobile phone. Subjects were Hong Kong adults aged 18 years or above and able to read Chinese because the intervention materials were in Chinese. Subjects who were vegan or vegetarian, or those who followed special diets or were currently on diet were excluded. Eligible participants were randomized to each of the four conditions: control, HP, EP, and CP, using a ratio of 1:1:1:1. For the control, participants were asked to search venues that offered food among 16 venue options. For the three priming groups, participants were first given a brief introduction about what sustainable diets are. Then, participants were told that sustainable diets have many benefits for human health (for HP), the environment (for EP), or both human health and the environment (for CP). Participants were asked to search five among 16 provided options that were relevant to health benefits (for HP), environmental benefits (for EP), and co-benefits (for CP), of sustainable diets, according to their respective priming condition. Following the control or priming task, all participants were invited to complete the same DCE tasks. The DCE questionnaire included 8 choice sets for each of the three food categories: meat, vegetables, and dairy products. The key sustainability attributes for describing each food category were informed by the qualitative data and literature review. Specifically, we included “eco-friendly”, “organic”, “local”, “natural”, and “hormone-free” for meat products, “eco-friendly”, “organic”, “local”, “in-season”, and “packaged” for vegetable produces, and “eco-friendly”, “organic”, “local”, “natural”, and “GMO-free” for dairy products. Except the sustainability attributes, price and taste were also included as additional attributes for all food products. For each choice set, participants chose one product they preferred. Following the DCE, participants were invited to complete a short questionnaire to assess their social orientation value using the 14-item Portrait Value Questionnaire (PVQ) which measure their self-enhancement values and self-transcendence values. Mixed logit modelling (MLM) was conducted to assess the preference weight of each attribute or attribute level in determining food choice. The “logitr” package in R4.2.2 with multi-stat search was used to run MLM. MLM was ran separately for each food category. To test the priming effects, a dummy variable was first generated to represent each of the three priming conditions. Then, the interaction of each priming condition with each food attribute was created and additionally included in the models and tested with MLM. To determine whether the priming effects on preference for sustainable foods would be modified by participants’ social orientation value. We first created six three-way interaction terms among the priming condition, eco-friendly attribute, and self-enhancement/self-transcendence values. Then, for each food category, a mixed logit model was run to examine the effects of these six three-way interactions upon the main effects of food attributes on participants’ food choice. Part 3. Testing whether participants’ emotional reactions and attention to sustainable foods as a pathway for the effects of priming on sustainable food selection In this part, we conduct a randomized control trial combined with eye tracking to further examine the potential mechanism of the priming effects. Subjects were recruited using advertisements distributed through university campus and intranets to all university staff who were also encouraged to spread the study invitation through their social networks from March 2023 to October 2023. A total of 200 subjects were recruited for this part, with 50 in each of the four groups: health-benefit priming (HP), environment-benefit priming (EP), and combined-benefit priming (CP), and control group. Participants were invited to complete the study in a quiet laboratory room, starting with an online shopping simulation to assess baseline sustainable food preferences. They then completed a battery of computerized tasks to measure their executive function. Thereafter, the control group was asked to identify various food purchasing locations among several options that contained no goal priming content. For the three priming conditions, the participants watched the same standardized introduction on sustainable diets and the same eco-friendly logo designed by our team on the left side of the computer screen. On the right side of the computer screen, a word search task was presented, and participants were required to identify words that are relevant to health benefits, environmental benefits, or co-benefits of sustainable diets, depending on their priming condition. Following the intervention, participants reviewed and selected a set of food products during which their eye data were recorded by an eye tracker. They then completed an online questionnaire on personal values and demographics. The major outcome of sustainable food choice was determined by the number of selected items featuring an eco-friendly logo following the priming. Participants were instructed to select two food products from each of the four food categories, in total 8 food products. ANCOVA was used to compare the differences in sustainable choices between the four groups, with the baseline sustainable food choice scores included as a covariate. Additionally, ANOVA was conducted to compare eye data that indicates time dwelling on sustainable foods, and their pupil size that indicates emotional response with the basal pupil size as a covariate, across the four conditions. Mediation analysis was performed using PROCESS (Model 4) to test the mediation of eye data on the effects of priming.

17618820.label: Major findings and research outcome
17618820.value: The qualitative data revealed that the public had limited understanding about sustainable healthy diets (SHDs). Most participants were unsure about what SHDs mean. Important sustainability attributes of foods identified included “low carbon”, “natural”, “seasonal”, “no chemicals” (or “organic”), “not ultra-processed”, and “GMO-free”. The qualitative data also indicated that the environmental impact was not salient for consumers’ food selection. Especially, the environmental impact arisen from the intangible food life cycle such as food production, processing and packaging was not perceived by consumers. Price was identified to be an important and salient driver of food choice, but participants were also concerned about the quality of foods with low prices. The DCE study found that Health-benefit Priming (HP) didn’t change the relative importance of any food attributes except for increasing the importance of “eco-friendly” for choosing dairy products. In comparison, Environmental-benefit Priming (EP) consistently had a strong effect on increasing the importance of “eco-friendly” for choosing foods of all three categories. EP also increased the importance of “organic” for choosing meat products, and “local” for choosing dairy products. In addition, EP increased participants’ aversion to dairy products with a “GMO-free” label. Co-benefit Priming (CP) overall had a consistent effect on increasing the importance of “eco-friendly” for choosing foods of all three categories. CP also increased the importance of “organic” for choosing meat and vegetable products. Both EP and CP but not HP significantly reduced the importance of taste for choosing dairy products. Both EP and CP reduced the importance of price for choosing foods of all three products while HP only reduced the importance of price for vegetables. All three priming conditions were more effective for participants who are more pro-social but less promising for participants who are more pro-self. The randomized controlled trial revealed that CP significantly increased participants’ sustainable food choices in the simulated food shopping task. The mediation analysis suggests that CP increased participants’ attention (dwell time) to foods with an eco-friendly logo, but not the pupil size (which indicates emotional reaction), which subsequently increased sustainable food choices. Two manuscripts of this project are currently under review, one in Journal of Environmental Psychology and another in Cities.

17618820.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17618820.value: Our study highlights that consumers do value the environmental sustainability of foods. This supports the development of a holistic eco-labelling scheme for foods to facilitate consumer-driven transformation of sustainable food production. While consumers value the organic and eco-friendly attributes of foods, they can only make informed food choices assuming that there is no financial constraint in access. Hence, it is important to make sustainable food products available, accessible, and affordable for consumers. Our study also suggests that priming for environmental benefits or the combined benefits for health and the environment of sustainability diets compared with merely health benefit priming have stronger effects for promoting sustainable food choices and reducing taste-driven and price-driven food purchase. This highlights the importance of linking sustainable food choice to positive environmental change such as mitigating climate change in advocacy for sustainable food choices. Our study also indicates that priming with the goals of better health and environment have more promising effects for more pro-social consumers but less promising for consumers who prioritize egoistic goals. Future studies should test priming interventions that activate the more immediate benefits of sustainable food choices.

17618820.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17618820.value: We first conducted in-depth interviews with 30 Hong Kong adults to explore what sustainability attributes were value to determine their selection of foods. We found that participants valued whether the foods had lower carbon emissions and were organic (no use of chemicals in production), natural (not ultra-processed), in-season (for vegetables), and GMO-free. We further designed and conducted a food choice experiment to determine which attributes (organic, local, price) of foods are more important when they made food choices and whether priming with different goals of sustainable diets can change the relative importance of these food attributes. We found that participants valued the sustainability attributes such as being organic and eco-friendliness more after they were primed with the goal of eating for better environment or eating for both better environment and health. Finally, our randomized controlled trial found that after priming with the goal of eating for both environmental and health benefits, participants paid more attention to foods with an eco-label and thereafter were more likely to choose foods with an eco-friendly logo. Our study suggests that advocacy for promoting sustainable diets should link food choices to the goal of environmental benefits or the co-benefits for the environment and human health.

17619720.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619720.value: Urbanization is common in both developing and developed countries. According to the 2018 Revision of World Urbanization Prospects produced by the Population Division of the United Nations Department of Economic and Social Affairs (United Nations, 2019), 55% of the world’s population today lives in urban areas, and that proportion is expected to increase to 68% by 2050. In an increasingly populated and metropolitan world, the question of how crowding affects individuals’ thoughts, feelings, and behaviors deserves close scrutiny. We aim to examine how crowdedness influences objectification, which refers to treating others merely as things or tools for one’s goal achievement, denying their personhood (Holland & Haslam, 2013; LaCrois and Pratto, 2015). Our major research questions include: (1) whether crowding contributes to objectification, (2) how each of the two major aspects of objectification (i.e., denying others’ personhood and treating others as tools for one’s own goal attainment) is influenced by crowding, and (3) how to mitigate the influence of social crowding on objectification. Building on previous theoretical and empirical research, we propose that crowdedness influences two aspects of objectification through two distinct psychological processes. In particular, social avoidance triggered by crowding leads people to deprive others’ personhood, and the desire for control following crowding causes people to view others as instruments for their own goal attainment. Further, we propose that dispositional mindfulness and a brief mindfulness intervention can reduce the negative influence of crowding on objectification. We will systematically test our hypotheses using both experimental and correlational approach. This research will enrich the literature on objectification. Existing studies predominantly focus on sexual objectification, whereas our research has the potential of leading to a better understanding of non-sexual forms of objectification. Also, in all proposed studies, we will capture both defining features of objectification—the denial of personhood and instrumentality in interpersonal processes—a significant improvement from typical practice in the field, which exclusively focuses on one single aspect of objectification at a time. Further, the present research will provide a better understanding of how crowding influences interpersonal processes and suggest interventions to weaken the threat posed by crowding. Such knowledge may guide the development of intervention programs aiming to forge social bonds and reduce the negative influence of urban living. Thus, this research may benefit society by informing efforts to promote a positive social environment and providing guidance for facilitating social interactions among members of local and international communities, schools, and organizations. 城市化在發展中國家和發達國家普遍存在。根據聯合國經濟和社會事務部人口司發布的《 2018年世界城市化前景修訂版》（聯合國，2019年），當今世界，55％的人口生活在城市地區；這一比例預計將在2050年將達到68％。在人口日益稠密的都市中，擁擠如何影響個人的思想，感情和行為？我們的研究關注擁擠如何影響客體化，即將他人僅視為實現目標的工具，否認他人的人格（Holland＆Haslam，2013； LaCrois and Pratto，2015）。我們的主要研究問題包括：（1）擁擠是否提升客體化；（2）擁擠如何影響客體化的兩個主要方面（即否認他人的人格和將他人視為自己實現目標的工具）， （3）如何減輕社會擁擠對客體化的影響。 在先前理論和實證研究的基礎上，我們提出擁擠通過兩個不同的心理過程影響客體化。具體而言，擁擠引發的社會迴避行為會導致人們否認他人的人格，擁擠引發的控制需求導致人們將他人視為實現自己目標的工具。此外，我們建議，正念特質和簡短的正念干預可以減少擁擠對客體化的負面影響。我們將使用實驗方法和相關方法系統地檢驗我們的假設。 這項研究將豐富有關客體化的文獻。現有的研究主要集中在性客體化，而我們的研究有可能幫助理解更廣發形式的客體化。此外，在所有擬定的研究中，我們將捕獲客體化的兩個定義特徵-人際交往過程的工具化和對人格的否認。 此外，本研究將更好地了解擁擠如何影響人際交往，並建議採取乾預措施以減輕擁擠帶來的威脅。這些知識可以指導旨在建立社會紐帶並減少城市生活負面影響的干預計劃。因此，這項研究可以通過告知人們努力促進積極的社會環境並為促進本地和國際社區，學校和組織成員之間的社會互動提供指導，從而使社會受益。

17619920.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619920.value: The proposed project will investigate the accountability issues of the core mechanism of China’s Social Credit System (SCS), i.e. algorithm-assisted sanctions, and review ways to minimise the mechanism’s impact on citizens’ rights. The SCS was introduced in mainland China in 2014, and is expected to operate nationwide by the end of 2020. It is a far-reaching system of social and economic governance that harvests the power of datafication and algorithms. Concerns have been raised over the possibility that the SCS will become a social engineering project of unprecedented scale, affecting the lives and rights of over a billion citizens. This project constitutes a timely inquiry into the evolution and accountability of the system, and thus is of profound theoretical and practical significance. It will produce a comprehensive and critical account of an essential mechanism of the system, i.e. algorithm-assisted sanctions. That mechanism consists of two elements: profiling and sanction. Profiling refers to the rating of the ‘trustworthiness’ of individual citizens based on the datafication and analysis of their compliance with various state-endorsed rules, including but not limited to legal norms and ethics. Different punishments are then determined and imposed concurrently by various authorities according to the rating results as sanctions against untrustworthiness. Often called ‘combined punishment’ in policy documents, the algorithm-assisted sanction mechanism plays a pivotal role in the SCS. My project, which will be carried out in three work packages, will situate the sanction mechanism and its technological support in the context of administrative law. First, using the theoretical framework of algorithmic regulation and carrying out empirical investigation, it will outline and categorise the roles played by algorithms in the profiling and sanction of individuals. It will then examine the compatibility of different types of algorithm-assisted sanction with administrative law principles concerning the legality and reasonableness of decision-making. Second, based on a sizeable and representative sample of cases, it will review the adequacy of judicial remedies offered to individuals affected by algorithm-assisted sanctions. Finally, it will offer proposals for reforming doctrines and judicial review approaches to better safeguard individual rights under the SCS, on the one hand, and identify the structural issues of the SCS that need to be addressed by legislation, on the other. The key project output will include research articles on law & technology studies and doctrinal public law and submissions in response to public consultations on SCS-related legislation at the central and local levels. 借助演算法確定制裁是中國社會信用體系的關鍵機制，本項目研究此項機制產生的問責性問題，探討如何減少其對公民權利的影響。社會信用體系自2014年開始建設，預期將於2020年末在全國實施。它運用數據化和演算法的力量，是一個影響深遠的社會和經濟治理系統。它也可能成為一項規模空前的社會工程，波及十多億人的生活和權利，由此引發了人們的憂慮。本項目將對社會信用體系的演進及其問責進行及時調查，為「演算法輔助制裁」這一社會信用體系的關鍵所在提供全面和批判性的說明，具有理論與實際的雙重意義。演算法輔助制裁含有側寫和制裁兩個要素。側寫指的是將公民個人遵守各項國家規定的情況——包括但不限於法律規範和道德標準——轉化為數據加以分析，並據此評價每個人的「守信」程度。「失信」的個人將受到制裁，即由多個公權力機關同時根據評價結果確定和實施懲戒。此類制裁被相關政策文件稱為「聯合懲戒」，在社會信用體系中發揮樞紐作用。 本項目從行政法的角度分析上述制裁機制及其技術基礎，分為三個部分。第一部分結合有關演算法監管的理論框架，對演算法在側寫和制裁中的角色進行實證調查和分類，分析不同類型的演算法輔助制裁是否符合有關行政決定之合法性與合理性的行政法原則。第二部分蒐集相當數量及有代表性的行政訴訟案件，檢視受演算法輔助制裁影響的個人是否獲得的充分的司法補救。第三部分提出改革建議，一方面涉及如何改善行政法理論和司法覆核方法，以增強社會信用體系中個人權利的保障，另一方面指出須通過立法解決的社會信用體系結構性問題。本項目擬發表涉及法律與科技、公法教義學等領域的學術論文，以及針對社會信用系統的相關各級立法提出諮詢建議。

17620020.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620020.value: Housing prices have been important indicators in many economies. Various residential property price indices (RPPIs) have been compiled to facilitate better understandings of the dynamics in the housing markets. RPPIs also provide information to formulate market policies (Eurostat, 2013). In HK, the most popular RPPIs are published by the Rating and Valuation Department (RVD) and Centaline Agency. In last century, both index series reached their local maxima in 1997, which were referenced subsequently by the media and government officials whenever intervention measures were called for. Despite of rocketing housing prices, it was not until November 2010 that the HK Government started intensifying a series of anti-speculation measures, only a quarter before the RPPIs surpassed their previous peaks in 1997. The methodology underpinning the RVD and Centaline indices can be construed as hedonic price models (HPM). Questions have been raised against the accuracy of HPM based indices. Systematic download biases will be resulted if the building age effects are not fully revealed in the models. Based on an empirical study of one of the largest constituent housing estates in HK, taking account of building age effects, Choy, Ho and Wu (under review) found that the real housing prices in October 2009 could have already surpassed the previous peaks in 1997, which was about 18 months ahead of the suggested timing of the RVD and Centaline indices. It suggests that a delay in responses to rocketing housing prices through public policies such as government intervention and increase housing supply etc. could have been resulted because of the structural biases in the published housing indices. Utilizing age-adjusted hedonic price models, this study attempts to reconstruct a series of housing price indices of around 100 housing estates in HK from 1992 to 2020. The performance of the reconstructed indices will be compared against the RVD and Centaline RPPI series. To evaluate the timeliness of housing policies, a reduced form equilibrium model (Ho & Ganesan, 1998) will be deployed to fit the variables of hypothetically timely housing policies. The simulated housing prices between 2003 and 2020 will be compared with the actual ones. Through some pilot studies, this study will also explore and evaluate the efficacy of some state-of-the-art computing techniques such as machine learning and geostatistics etc. to coup with building age effects in the construction of RPPIs. As a major stakeholders of RPPIs in HK, Centaline Agency will be engaged in this study. 房價已成為許多經濟體的重要指標。很多地區已經編制了各種住宅房地產價格指數，以促進對房地產市場動態的更好理解。在香港，最受歡迎的房地產價格指數分别由差餉及估價署和中原地產代理計算及發佈。在上個世紀，這兩個指數係列均在1997年達到了當地的最大值，隨後在需要採取樓價措施時，媒體和政府官員都將其作為參考。儘管房價飛漲，直到2010年11月，香港政府僅在這些房地產價格指數超過1997年的峰值之前的一季才開始採取一系列反投機措施。差餉及估價署和中原地產代理的房地產價格指數是建基於特徵價格模型（HPM），是次硏究對HPM的準確性提出了疑問 - 如果模型中未充分體現建築年齡效應，則會導致系統性偏差。如果考慮到建築年齡的影響，我們發現早於2009年10月的實際房價可能已經超過了1997年的峰值 ，比差餉及估價署和中原地產代理指數的建議時間提前了18個月。這表明，由於已公佈的住房指數存在結構性偏見，可能導致通過公共政策（如政府反投機措施和增加住房供應等）來應對房價飆升的延遲。本研究利用年齡調整後的特徵價格模型，嘗試重建一系列1992年至2020年香港約100個房地產屋的房價指數。將所重建的指數的表現與差餉及估價署和中原地產代理房地產價格指數系列進行比較。為了評估住房政策的及時性，將採用簡化形式的均衡模型來適應假設適時住房政策的變量。將2003年至2020年的模擬房屋價格與實際價格進行比較。通過一些先導研究，本研究還將探索和評估一些最新的計算技術（例如機器學習和地統計學等）去解決房地產價格指數時應對建築年齡效應的問題。作為香港地區房地產價格指數的主要開發者，中原地產代理將參與這項研究。

17620020.label: Realisation of objectives
17620020.value: All objectives have been achieved successfully. Detailed elaborations are as follows: Objective 1: To evaluate the theoretical framework of age-adjusted hedonic price model-based method to produce more accurate and efficient property price indices. A thorough literature review has been conducted in Choy & Ho (under review). Two theoretical models of property-age adjusted price indexes were developed, of which the multiplication of building structure and property age of the premises was incorporated. A building age adjusted price model to explain the rent gaps of subdivided units (SDUs), an informal housing in Hong Kong, was also developed in Leung, Choy and Chau (2022a). However, in Leung, Choy and Chau (2022b), it is argued that building age is not a significant contributor to the electricity surcharge of SDUs due to the low correlation between electricity usage and building conditions. Objective 2: To construct a new series of age-adjusted price indices of about 100 selected housing estates enlisted in the RVD’s Selected Popular Developments Urban Area Indices and Centaline’s Centa-City Indices. The performance of the price index series will be compared. We have compiled a property database with 166 unique housing estates enlisted in the Rating and Valuation Department (RVD) and Centaline CentaCity Index (CCL). Between 1997 and 2021, we use more than 450,000 transactions of these estates to construct the property-age adjusted indexes in Choy and Ho (under review). It is found that age adjustments amount to about 0.67% per annum in the property price indexes. In the property-age adjusted rent gap model of Leung, Choy and Chau (2022a), units with higher building ages are more probable to be converted to SDUs although no compelling effects showing positive relationship between rent gaps and ages of buildings. In Leung, Choy and Chau (2022b), there is no evidence to show a positive relationship between electricity surcharge and building age in the SDU market. Objective 3: To evaluate the timeliness of government policies by simulating the outcomes of hypothetically timely actions through the construction of a reduced form equilibrium model. We have produced three graphs in Choy and Ho (under review) showing the differences between the housing price gaps and spikes of the property-age adjusted and prevailing market price indexes. Evidently government’s ant-speculative measures was delayed for 1 to 2 quarters respectively in 2010 and 2018. Objective 4: To carry out pilot studies in selected districts in HK so as to evaluate the deployment of some state-of-the-art computing techniques such as machine learning to tackle building age effect in the construction of RPPIs. In Choy and Ho (2023) three machine learning models were deployed to compare with the performance of OLS hedonic price models, of which multiplication of building structure and property age was a significant factor. About 25,000 transactions were used in this pilot study. By measuring the effective R squares, it was found that the three machine learning models achieve higher explanatory powers than OLS models from 6.62-12.9%.

17620020.label: Major findings and research outcome
17620020.value: Three refereed journal articles (Choy & Ho 2023, Leung, Choy and Chau 2022a, Leung Choy and Chau 2022b) have been published, and one referred journal paper is under review (Choy & Ho under review). The major findings of these articles are manifold. First, new theoretical models suggest that physical depreciation of premises causes structural biases to hedonic based housing prices. Second, empirical studies on more than 450,000 transactions between 1997 and 2021 in those estates covered by the Rating and Valuation Department and Centa-City indices reveal that age adjustments amount to about 0.67% per annum downward bias. Third, the downward bias of housing price indices render delay in response to government’s anti-speculative measures for 1-2 quarters. Fourth, in the informal housing market in Hong Kong dominated by subdivided flats, while property age is positively related to rent gap and hence market supply, it is not a contributing factor to capture economic rent through excessive unities surcharges levied by the landlords. Fifth, a comparison between learning machine methods to conventional OLS estimations on the effects of building ages to housing prices, the former outperform the later by 6.62-12.9% in term of R square explanatory powers.

17620020.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17620020.value: The comparisons of machine learning and conventional OLS methods have laid the framework to evaluate the effectiveness and efficacy of key housing attributes to predict housing prices. Further work using the framework can be carried out on other factors such as, inter alias, areas, views, orientations and floor levels etc. Furthermore, how changes of taste / values on the housing attributes over time by the buyers may cause structural biases to hedonic price based indices are worthy of further investigations. For instance, nano flats were popular products in 2010s while losing attractiveness in the 2020s. Structural biases in housing price indices induced by the change of taste in the market can be studied, and hence policy implications to be revealed.

17620020.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17620020.value: This study investigates the structural biases of housing price indices caused by overlooking the effects of increasing building ages of properties over time. With reference to over 450,000 transactions of over 100 property estates covered by the Rating and Valuation Department and Centa-City housing indices between 1997 and 2021, this study reveals a 0.67% per annum downward bias caused by the building age factor. It means that if property ages were adequately reflected, the real housing prices would be higher than that indicated by the popular housing price indices. It also caused delay in response by the government to implement anti-speculative measures for 1-2 quarters. This study also investigates the use of advanced tools such as machine learning to predict housing prices. It is found that machine learning methods can better explain the changes of housing prices by 6.6-12.9%, compared to the conventional approaches.

17620420.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620420.value: 青少年突發性脊柱側彎是一種脊柱的三維畸形，影響百分之三至五的兒童。此病在青少年的青春期間發展及惡化。嚴重且未能適時治療的脊柱側彎會導致背痛，心肺功能的損害，平衡不良及外觀上的影響。早期篩查及使用腰架治療可以防止惡化至手術介入。確診青少年突發性脊柱側彎後，病人需要定期跟進直至骨齡成熟為止，在治療期間亦需要面對出現惡化的可能性及焦慮等不明因素。 脊柱側彎的診斷，對身體外貌的影響及其治療會是患者和其家人在情緒及心理上的重大困擾。青少年突發性脊柱側彎是誘發抑鬱症的獨立風險因素，有至少百分之四十的患者及其家人在早期的治療階段均表示感到弧立，痛苦及否認患上此病。照顧者的壓力及父母教導行為亦會影響患者的心社狀況及對治療的遵從。不過，現時並沒有前瞻性的研究進行在上述的命題上，以往的研究也只專注於應用在病人上的特定治療方法而沒有進行縱貫性研究。 我們的計劃目的是透過為期兩年以上的縱貫性研究基於治療組別的形式去調查青少年突發性脊柱側彎的患者及其家人的心理上困擾 (包括焦慮和抑鬱狀況)。所有病人由本港學生健康服務的脊柱側彎篩查計劃轉介至專科診所將會被招募。數據會在四個檢測點收集及與透過由具代表性的問卷收集到的本地平均數據作出比較。此研究計劃主要集中三個範疇：(1) 青少年突發性脊柱側彎患者及其家人的焦慮和抑鬱程度；(2) 患者及其家人對脊柱側彎誤解的程度，及與其心理困擾和治療遵從的關聯性；(3) 患者及其家人的心理困擾與預測可變因素包括社會支援，精神狀態及治療遵從的二元關係。混合線性模式及調節模式將會基於不同治療組別去分析患者及其家人在確診後兩年間的心理健康的變化，亦會分析對脊柱側彎的誤解，心理困擾及治療遵從因素三者之間的互動變化，以及二元數據之間的相互依賴性。 是此研究結果將會以縱貫性方式提供有關對青少年突發性脊柱側彎患者及其家人所承受不同程度的心理影響的實證數據。研究結果亦會提供策略性的方向去重新調整本港現時處理脊柱側彎的治療模式。

17620520.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620520.value: One challenge facing Hong Kong mainstream education today is providing effective intervention programs for an increasing number of students with autism spectrum disorder (ASD) who have shown specific impairments in reading comprehension and advanced theory of mind (ToM) tasks, such as using subtle social cues to interpret the mental representations of others (Tong et al, 2019). According to the first wave of our on-going 3-year longitudinal study (2018-2021) of 240 children in grades 3-4, such impairments in reading comprehension and advanced ToM can be attributed to their weaknesses in pragmatic language comprehension (PLC), i.e., the ability to utilize social context to infer and predict communicative intentions of a protagonist, and executive function (EF), i.e., the ability to execute goal-directed behaviors, such as planning, shifting, updating, and inhibitory control (Tong & Chan, submitted). To improve the reading comprehension and advanced ToM of children with ASD, we will develop and evaluate child-parent-dyad EF and PLC intervention programs that emphasize facilitative teaching of multifaceted cognitive and language skills. Using a longitudinal, randomized controlled trial design, 90 children with ASD in grades 4-5 and their parents from our on-going 3-year study (2018-2021) will be selected and randomly assigned to three-intervention conditions: 30 EF, 30 PLC, and 30 waiting-list controls. The EF and PLC groups will receive 12 weeks of intervention for two consecutive years. Using multifactorial behavioral and neurophysiological measures (i.e., event-related potentials (ERPs)), the relative effectiveness of these two interventions on behavioral changes in four key domains—EF, PLC, ToM, and reading comprehension—will be evaluated over short- (1-year) and long-term (2-year) periods. Additionally, the effects of behavioural EF and PLC interventions on brain activities within these four domains will be examined before and after two years of interventions. Findings of the proposed study will further clarify the roles of EF and PLC in contributing to specific impairments in ToM and reading comprehension among school-age children with ASD, which may assist in guiding clinical diagnosis and treatment. Also, our comparison of the relative efficacy of the EF and PLC intervention programs will inform evidence-based practice for effectively ameliorating social communication and reading comprehension difficulties of those children with ASD. Additionally, linking behavioral intervention with brain responses will not only provide a novel approach to quantify social communication and reading comprehension impairments in ASD, but also yield insight into the neural circuits underpinning EF, PLC, ToM, and reading comprehension that characterize ASD. 為自閉症學童提供有效治療是現時香港主流教育面臨的挑戰之一。以往研究表明，自閉症學童的語用理解和執行功能較弱，因此影響他們在閱讀理解和心智解讀的表現 。有見及此，本研究將發展親子執行功能訓練和語用理解訓練，並比較兩個治療方法對促進多方面認知和語言技能的成效。 本研究將招募90名四至五年級的自閉症學童及其父母， 並隨機分配至執行功能、語用理解和等待名單對照的組別，連續兩年接受12週的治療訓練。我們會以行為和神經生理測試，評估治療方法對執行功能、語用理解、心智解讀和閱讀理解的短期（一年）及長期（兩年）相對成效和對大腦活動的影響。 是項研究將闡明執行功能和語用理解如何導致自閉症學童心智解讀和閱讀理解的障礙。此外，對比兩種治療方法的效果能為循證實踐提供依據，以助改善自閉症學童的社交和閱讀理解困難。同時，結合行為治療及腦電波信息這兩種研究方式，有助量化自閉症學童的社交溝通和閱讀理解困難及揭示自閉症的神經網絡基礎。

17620820.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17620820.value: 中国反家暴个人安全保护令

17620820.label: Project Objectives
17620820.value: Unlike previous studies that have relied on doctrinal analysis, legal regulations, sporadic interviews, published judgments, media reports, and anecdotal accounts to study the Protection Order in China, this study employs a new method – directly examining the dynamics between the judges and the applicants and respondents. Through this methodology, our Project will examine both offenders’ and victims’ cultural norms toward domestic violence in marital or cohabitation relationships, and political and bureaucratic considerations regarding social stability and case backlogs, respectively. This will form the basis for understanding the developing norms on justice and the operational patterns of Chinese divorce law practice. On the doctrinal and legislative levels, the Protection Order has been expected to reduce domestic violence in China. Our Project explores its limitations at the level of implementation. It will shed light on the hidden problems created by a system that values self-protection over rights and the delivery of justice. It thus raises important questions about China’s divorce law procedures. Additionally, our Project will provide policy recommendations for future reform. By examining under what circumstances the application for the Protection Order is invoked and how it is negotiated in China, this Project will provide a story on the relationship between law, culture, politics, and justice in China’s context. Law has long been regarded as a cultural intervention to shape the self with masculinity and femininity (Merry 2001). How does this process unfold in China where the traditional culture is incongruent with the law? Exploring the forces underneath the interactions in the application of the Protection Order in China, our Project will enrich the literature on comparative studies of cultural and justice, which has drawn the most from the experience of societies and jurisdictions other than Mainland China. The Protection Order is regarded as a typical tactic in spatial governmentality, striving to reduce the risk of violence via space separation. In the last decade or so, the site has changed from Women’s Federation Associations to the courts, and the strategies have changed from discipline to space. To what extent has the state switched to this spatial tactic, or still relied on corporal punishment or soul discipline? By examining empirical evidence of the evolution of the state’s strategies in China, our project will enrich the idea of governmentality (Foucault 1991), which has been developed primarily based on liberal democracies.

17620820.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620820.value: While the Personal Safety Protection Order has been regarded as a key mechanism in combating domestic violence in Mainland China, the existing literature has yet to examine its implementation process and effectiveness. To fill the gap, this Project expands our preliminary study to four courts with their representative profiles of different levels of caseload, economic and institutional development, cultural tradition, political pressures, and judicial professionalism. Drawing upon court ethnography and interviews with relevant judges, applicants and respondents, our Project will be the first to explore the following questions: What are the counts’ operational processes in granting applications for Orders? How do applicants and respondents view the mechanisms, and to what extent are the mechanisms effective? The findings of our Project are critical to understanding how justice is exercised in Chinese courts. This focus on the actual practices of the Protection Order in turn facilitates exploration into how the patterns of divorce law practice affect the realization of legal rights and the underlying political and cultural forces shaping this practice. The Project will also examine how legal intervention has changed the behaviour pattern of both victims and offenders, and how this process has shaped their cultural conceptions of domestic violence in China. Using this as a case study, it will also illustrate the state’s social control strategies and tactics. The Project will not only generate policy recommendations for reforming Protection Order implementation in China, but will also provide evidence for broader theoretical debate about the relationship between law, culture, politics, and perceptions of justice. 本项目研究中国反家暴中的人身保护令的实施及效果。法院颁布保护令的程序如何？当事人如何看待这些机制，以及这些机制是否有效？法律的实施是否改变了当事人的行为？人们对家暴的看法是否改变？这个个案中，国家对社会控制的如何改变？法律、文化、政治、以及对正义的看法之间的关系如何变迁？

And how is it related to the paramount concerns for social stability? The research sheds light on the law’s interactions with political concerns and cultural belief during the age of globalisation. 17620820.label: Major findings and research outcome
17620820.value: Through examining the implementation of domestic violence protection orders in two lower-level Chinese courts, I argue that the interpretation of gender violence in light of the political concern for social stability plays a key role in the law’s varied effectiveness. In a court situated in an urbanized coastal area, the judges believe that gender violence is a direct threat to social stability. To maintain social stability, they swiftly and decisively handle the claims against gender violence. In contrast, in a rural court, the judges interpret gender violence as a direct threat to family stability. As such, they repress the claims against gender violence. This study suggests that as the content of global discourses is reformulated, new forms of cultural and political appropriation are generated. It thus reveals the complexities when law, culture, and politics are intertwined in the process of law and globalization.

17620820.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
17620820.value: more research can be done on how to improve the implementation in the remote areas.

17620820.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
17620820.value: The research finds that how the law is interpreted by the local courts is a key to understand its implementation. Such interpretation is closely related to the judges’s cultural belief on marriage and their take on the relationship between the marriage and social stability. In places where they find domestic violence is a threat to social stability, they implement the law seriously. In other places they find that a divorce may threat social stability, they are reluctant to implement the law. The research sheds light on the law’s interactions with political concerns and cultural belief during the age of globalisation.

17620920.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620920.value: Rampant socio-economic development and urbanization have caused rapid deterioration in air qualities across many parts of the world, including Beijing, one of the most rapidly developing metropolitans in China. Despite the ongoing introduction of stringent air pollution control policies to improve air qualities in China, evaluating the effectiveness of these regulations has remained a daunting task, with the constraints posed by the existing statistical models. This may negatively affect the credibility of evaluations concerning whether certain policies/regulations should be continued/ replaced in the future. Existing statistical methods that evaluate the causal effects of policy interventions often fail to capture the complex non-linear relationships across a high-dimensional dataset. Although recent advancements in deep-learning models have made statistical claims concerning the correlation of variables within a high dimensional dataset possible, it remains a huge challenge for causal inference to be properly developed from deep-learning techniques. Further, existing deep-learning-based models deployed for policy evaluations are yet to account for any plausible confounding bias, while the certainty and interpretability of our causal estimations, and hence the reliability and accountability of our policy evaluations based on such models, are subject to further discussions. To address these issues, we propose a Bayesian deep-learning model that accounts for the causal relationships across the variables and apply it for the evaluation of the performance of air pollution control regulations on air qualities over the long- and the short-term period in Beijing, China. Our proposed model can provide interpretable causal estimations with well-calibrated uncertainties, thus allowing the general public or policy-makers to identify any influential regulations or socio-economic factors that have resulted in any good/bad performance in air quality, and deserve attentions for social good. Using Beijing as a case study, we adopt our proposed method to examine the long-term aggregate effects of air pollution control regulations, and the short-term effect of a particular air pollution control measure introduced in Beijing. Our proposed interdisciplinary methodology brings forth a new and an important area of research that bridges big data and deep-learning studies with social science and policy studies. The results generated from this causal inference and policy evaluation deep-learning model can deepen our understanding of what measures can substantially reduce air pollution in Beijing to inform environmental planning and policy-making. Our novel deep-learning driven interdisciplinary methodology can be easily transferable to other areas/topics where evidence-based policy-making are seriously pursued by the policy-makers. 社會經濟發展和城市化已導致世界許多地方的空氣污染迅速增長，包括北京，中國發展最快速的城市之一。儘管中國正在出台嚴格的空氣污染控制政策以改善空氣質量，但在現有統計模型的限制下，評估這些法規的有效性仍然艱難重重。這對未來是否應繼續/替代某些政策/法規的評估信譽可能會產生負面影響。 現有的評估政策干預因果關係的統計方法通常無法捕獲高維數據集中覆雜的非線性關係。 儘管深度學習模型的最新進展使有關高維數據集內變量相關性的統計成為可能，但從深度學習技術角度適當應用因果推理仍具挑戰。此外，現有用於策略評估基於深度學習的模型尚未考慮任何可能出現的混淆性偏見。因此，我們的因果估計的確定性和可解釋性，以及基於此類模型的政策評估的可靠性問責性，有待作進一步研究。為解決這些問題，我們提出一個貝葉斯深度學習模型，以考慮各個變量之間的因果關係，並將其用於評估中國北京市長期和短期內空氣污染控制法規對空氣質量的績效。我們提出的模型可以校準不確定性，並提供可解釋性的因果估計，從而使政策制定者/公眾能尋找能左右空氣質量之法規或社會經濟因素，改善社會生活質素。研究將聚焦北京，以有關方法論評估空氣污染防控法規對空氣質量的長期影響，並指定空氣污染防控措施對空氣質量的短期影響。我們提出的跨學科方法開闢了一個全新的領域，將大數據和深度學習研究與社會科學和政策研究接連。這種因果推理和政策評估深度學習模型所產生的結果，可以加深我們對何種措施能大幅度減少北京空氣污染的理解，從而為環境規劃和政策制定提供依據。我們所提出的深度學習驅動型跨學科方法可以用於其他以實證為本涉及決策的重要領域/主題。

18300720.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18300720.value: Active scalar equations are well-known and important topics in mathematics. They have numerous physical applications which include fluid mechanics, magnetohydrodynamics, atmospheric science and geophysics. Tremendous progress has been made by various mathematicians on the analytical theories of active scalar equations, yet due to the nonlinear nature of the equations, many problems remain as open and challenging. In this research project, the PI proposes to deepen our understanding of active scalar equations with emphasis on the vanishing viscosity limit and long time behaviour of a family of active scalar equations, as a key step in studying some physical models which include the magneto-geostrophic equation and incompressible porous media Brinkman equation. The first topic in this proposal focuses on different scenarios when some viscosity type parameters tend to zero in the finite or long time regimes. The modes of convergence of solutions, existence of certain types of attractor as well as the associated properties will be carefully addressed. Such proposed problem is difficult because the long time inviscid limits of many forced systems in fluid mechanics are not fully understood, and the success of this problem will shed lights on understanding some ideally conserved quantities such as kinetic energy and enstrophy. The second topic in this proposal applies the results from the general classes of active scalar equations to different physical models including magneto-geostrophic equation and incompressible porous media Brinkman equation. Such problem is challenging due to the highly singular limits of different vanishing viscosities and the drastic changes in the correlation between velocity field u and the corresponding scalar function θ. The success of this problem will significantly extend and strengthen the results for magneto-geostrophic equation and incompressible porous media equation from the literature. In the long run, this project may lead to discoveries of new techniques from the fields of analysis and partial differential equations which enrich our knowledge about fluid mechanics. On the other hand, our project can attract undergraduate and graduate students to such theoretical area of applied analysis and nurture their future developments. 活性標量方程是數學上眾所周知的重要課題。它具有很多物理學上的應用，包括流體力學、磁流體動力學、大氣科學和地球物理學。數學家在活性標量方程的分析理論上已經取得了巨大的進步，但是由於方程的非線性性質，許多問題仍然是開放且具有挑戰性的。在此研究項目中，PI嘗試加深對活性標量方程的理解，重點包括研究消失的粘度極限和探索一系列活性標量方程的長時間行為，這是研究物理模型如地磁方程和不可壓縮的多孔介質布林克曼方程的關鍵步驟。本專題項目的第一個主題研究當某些粘度類型參數在有限或長時間範圍內趨於零時的不同情況，並會仔細解決不同情況的收斂方式、某些類型的吸引子的存在以及相關的屬性。由於現在我們尚未能充分理解流體力學中許多強制系統的長期無形極限，因此這個主題具有難度，如能成功解決這主題將為理解一些理想的守恆量（例如動能和位渦擬能）提供參考。本專題項目的第二個主題將對活性標量方程所得到的結果應用於不同的物理模型，包括地磁方程和不可壓縮的多孔介質布林克曼方程。由於不同消失粘度的高度奇異極限以及速度場u和對應的標量函數θ之間的相關性有着急劇變化，因此這個主題具有挑戰性，如能成功解決這主題將能夠擴展和加強文獻中有關磁地磁方程和不可壓縮多孔介質方程的結果。從長遠來看，本專題項目可有助發展分析和偏微分方程等數學領域的新技術，從而豐富了我們對流體力學的知識。另一方面，本項目可以吸引其他學生進入這種應用數學分析的理論領域，並培養他們的未來學術發展。

18300720.label: Realisation of objectives
18300720.value: The objectives of the project have been fully addressed, various general classes of active scalar equations have been studied with emphasis on the inviscid limiting behaviour in the long time regime, and we further applied the general results for active scalar equations to physical models including magneto-geostrophic (MG) equation and incompressible porous media Brinkman equation. Specifically, as described in Part C Section 8, the research outcome has been written in three papers, which have been published in Archive for Rational Mechanics and Analysis, Pure and Applied Functional Analysis and Journal of Mathematical Fluid Mechanics. The first objective of this project was to study general classes of active scalar equations with emphasis on the inviscid limiting behaviour in the long time regime, as a first step in realising the problem, we investigated the properties of an abstract family of advection diffusion equations in the context of the fractional Laplacian, which included and generalised the MG equation. We successfully proved the existence of global-in-time H^s -solutions to the general system when nu greater than 0, where nu is a non-negative parameter resembling some physical diffusion parameters. Based on the global-in-time existence results established, we obtained the long time behaviour of solutions to the general active scalar problem and proved the existence of a unique global attractor. By defining the solution operator pi^nu(t) on H^1 for the initial value problem with respect to the general active scalar problem, we considered the long-time dynamics of pi^nu(t) on the phase space H^1 by establishing the existence of global attractors for pi^nu(t) in H^1. The existence of global attractors for pi^nu(t) in H^1 can be done in the following steps: 1) we first showed the existence of an L^infty-absorbing set by using a bound (in terms of the initial data and the external forcing term) on ||theta(t)|| for t greater than or equal to 1. 2) we then a priori estimate in C^alpha-space with some alpha in (0,1), which would be used for showing the existence of an C^alpha-absorbing set. 3) we further showed the existence of an H^1-absorbing set by establishing an a priori estimate for initial data in H^1 cap C^alpha, which allowed us to improve the regularity of the absorbing set to H^{1+gamma/2} with gamma greater than 0. 4) The existence and regularity of the global attractor could then be concluded by applying an argument in semigroup theory. We also proved various properties for the global attractors G^nu, namely a) G^nu is fully invariant with respect to pi^nu(t) b) G^nu is maximal in the class of H^1- bounded invariant sets 3) G^nu has finite fractal dimension. This gave the complete picture for the inviscid limiting behaviour in the long time regime for such general classes of active scalar equations. The second objective of this project was to apply the general results for active scalar equations to physical models including MG equation and incompressible porous media Brinkman equation. For the MG equation, in a previous work, we had proved that there exists a compact global attractor A in L^2 when nu=0. In the current project, when nu is varying, we successfully related the global attractors G^nu with A and proved that G^nu converges to A in the sense of L^2 norm, that means sup{phi in G^nu} inf{psi in A} ||phi - psi|| in L^2 converges to 0 as nu tends to 0. Moreover, for any nu0 in [nu^a,nu_a] with nu_a being positive, we proved that the collection {G^nu}{nu from [nu^a,nu_a]} is upper semicontinuous at nu0 in the sense that sup{phi in G^nu} inf{psi in G^{nu0}} ||phi - psi|| in L^2 converges to 0 as nu tends to nu0. To prove the later result, we proved that i) there is a compact subset U of H^1 such that G^nu is a subset of U for every nu in [nu^a,nu_a], and ii) for all positive time t, pi^nu[theta0] is continuous on [nu^a,nu_a], uniformly for theta0 in compact subsets of H^1. For the incompressible porous media Brinkman equation, when nu is greater than 0, if theta0 in W^{s,2} with s greater than 0, then there exists a unique global-in-time solution theta^nu in W^{s,2} for all positive time t. Moreover, if theta is the solution to incompressible porous media Brinkman equation with nu=0, then theta^nu converges to theta as nu tends to 0. In terms of analytic solutions, we proved that the incompressible porous media Brinkman equation has local-in-time analytic solutions for all nu greater than or equal to 0, and such analytic solutions can be extended to global-in-time solutions when the initial data is small in terms of analytic norm. We also proved that the analytic solution converges as nu tends to 0. Overall, these results deepened our understanding on these physical models and further extended our study on other important physical models which included SQG equations. Due to the outbreak of Covid 19, it was very hard to recruit full-time Senior Research Assistant and Post-Graduate Students for the project, which were requested in the original budget. One part-time Research Assistant, Li Jiaxin, was recruited for the project in Summer 2022. She was also offered a full-time contract for Senior Research Assistant in 2023 yet she declined the offer as she continued her study in University of Cambridge in the direction of Applied Mathematics. For the Post-Graduate Student, a PhD student, Mr Qasim Khan, was recruited in Fall 2022. Mr Khan was awarded the Ernst Mach Grant for undergoing exchange research activities at University of Gratz from Sept 2023 to May 2024. His work was partially supported by this project.
